article.articleHeadline: RDC : les personnes sourdes sensibilisées aux risques liés à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Deaf people made aware of the risks associated with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola Virus Disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) centered in Ituri Province, with Kisangani highlighted as a current intervention site. Government figures report 7,541 confirmed cases and 3,639 deaths, with 1,823 recoveries. The outbreak is described as the deadliest of the DRC’s 17 Ebola episodes; the WHO warns it could exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa toll of over 11,000 deaths. In Kisangani, teams conducted a deaf-awareness session, using sign-language interpreter Gilbert Kazingufu to help participants recognize Ebola symptoms and avoid under-diagnosis due to communication barriers. No laboratory-confirmation details or infection-source data are provided in the article. The emphasis remains on public awareness and early symptom identification to curb transmission and improve care for vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラのリスクについて聴覚障害者への啓発活動
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7,541症例・3,639死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、WHOが2014-2016年西アフリカ流行の死者数を超える可能性を警告するなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: DRCの17回目のエボラ流行の中で史上最悪規模とされ、WHOが過去最大流行（西アフリカ2014-2016）の死者数超過の可能性を警告している重大事例。既に大規模流行として認知されている可能性が高く、続報および既存のRRA状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Penularan Influenza Tinggi di Musim Kemarau, Berikut Penjelasannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High Influenza Transmission During the Dry Season, Here’s the Explanation.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 September 2026, Indonesian experts note that influenza transmission remains high during the dry season, despite drier air generally reducing virus survival. Crowding in indoor spaces and limited sunlight inflate transmission risk. In urban settings with air pollution, closed rooms without adequate ventilation further sustain spread. Daycare centers are particularly vulnerable, where several children sharing a room can rapidly propagate infection and cleaning of contaminated surfaces may be insufficient. A single influenza case can, on average, infect about three others, with the exact rate influenced by environmental conditions, weather, and how densely people gather indoors. The explanation emphasizes indoor transmission dynamics and the role of ventilation and sun exposure in mitigating spread during Indonesia’s dry season.

article.articleHeadline: 安特羅簽泰國腸病毒疫苗經銷合約　待獲藥證將出貨
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Antro Signs Distribution Agreement for Thai Enterovirus Vaccine; Shipments to Begin Upon Receipt of Drug License.
article.articleSummary: Antro Biotech announced an exclusive Thai distribution agreement with Biogenetech for its self-developed Enterovirus 71 vaccine. Thailand’s FDA registration was filed in August 2025; approval is expected by Q2 2027, with shipments planned in Q3 2027 after licensing. The initial Thai market targets about 3 million children aged 0–4, focusing on self-pay vaccination and public-tender opportunities. Biogenetech will handle local marketing, sales, distribution and post-licensing regulatory obligations upon approval. Macau already holds a license, with shipments planned for November 2026. Licenses for Vietnam and Indonesia are being pursued, with expected progress by year-end 2026 for Vietnam and next year for Indonesia. Biogenetech’s cold-chain logistics and government-tender experience are anticipated to speed access to Thai hospitals and vaccination channels.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tunisia sends medical aid to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to combat the Ebola outbreak | Today's Press - a general daily newspaper
article.articleSummary: As of 23 September 2026, Tunisia dispatched a shipment of aid to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to support its Ebola outbreak response. The operation was coordinated by the ministries of Foreign Affairs, Migration and Tunisians Abroad, National Defense, Health, and Social Affairs, together with the Tunisian Red Crescent and the Tunisian Union for Social Solidarity, under instructions from President Kais Saied. The consignment includes substantial medicines and medical and para-medical supplies, moved by a Tunisian military aircraft to Kinshasa International Airport. The mission responds to an African Union appeal urging member states to bolster the DRC’s health system amid Ebola spread. The Tunisian Embassy in Kinshasa will oversee the handover to the relevant Congolese authorities. No patient counts are provided in the report.

article.articleHeadline: 46 người nhập viện sau ăn bánh mì: Nhiều mẫu thực phẩm dương tính Salmonella spp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 46 people hospitalized after eating bread: Many food samples test positive for Salmonella spp.
article.articleSummary: 46 people were hospitalized after eating bread at a bakery in Cam Lộ Commune, Cam Lộ District, Quảng Trị Province, Vietnam, in mid-September. Laboratory results from the Pasteur Institute Nha Trang showed Salmonella spp in 9 of 11 food samples, including beef sausage, fish sausage, vegetables, braised meat, sweet-sour pickles, cucumber, bread, sandwich, and a beverage. Among 13 patient specimens, 11 tested positive for Salmonella spp, with one also carrying Staphylococcus aureus. The outbreak began from meals at the bakery on September 14–15; by September 15, Cam Lộ Regional General Hospital had admitted 46 patients with abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, fever, diarrhea, and dehydration. By September 22, the patients were stabilized and discharged. Authorities suspended the bakery pending investigation and are reviewing links between the implicated foods and illnesses.

article.articleHeadline: 6 người ở Vĩnh Long tử vong do chó cắn, phát hiện 4 ổ dịch dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six people in Vĩnh Long died from dog bites; four rabies outbreaks detected.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreaks and dog-bite deaths in Vĩnh Long, Vietnam, dominate the 2026 update. In the first nine months of 2026, six people died from dog bites across Tân Xuân, Hiệp Mỹ, Châu Hưng, Bến Tre, Ba Tri and Tân Thủy. Four animal rabies outbreaks were detected in Phước Mỹ Trung, Lộc Thuận, Đồng Khởi and Thạnh Phước, all identified through vaccination-site surveillance. Since January, health authorities shared over 600 warning signals via Zalo from vaccination centers to veterinary services; more than 20 samples were reviewed, with four canine samples testing positive for rabies. From 2022–2025, the province recorded 24 rabies deaths, with outbreaks localized and controlled; 2025 had zero deaths. Contributing factors include free-roaming dogs/cats, low vaccination coverage, and public complacency after bites. About 333,000 dogs/cats are kept mostly in small, roaming households; authorities aim for >80% vaccination and 100% testing of suspected animals, expanding safe zones and public awareness.

The excerpt does not provide specific case or death counts. Public health authorities are monitoring outbreak dynamics and movement to identify potential imported or exported cases, highlighting the ongoing regional threat and the need for sustained containment measures across affected and neighboring countries.

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis cases up 38% as DOH reports epidemic threshold breached | Claudeth Mocon-Ciriaco
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases in the Philippines rose to 10,936 suspected as of September 16, 2026, 38% above the 7,931 for the same period in 2025, with cases in the last 3–4 weeks 116% higher than 5–6 weeks prior, breaching the epidemic threshold. Forty-six PHIS facilities in 10 regions have crossed threshold, led by NCR, Region II, and Calabarzon. Flooding and continuous rains drive transmission, accounting for 66% (7,242) of cumulative cases. Males predominate (79%), totaling 8,640, median age 33, reflecting exposure to floodwaters. Cumulative case fatality rate (CFR) 5.1%, down from 10.55% in 2025; 42% of deaths occurred during weeks when threshold breached. DOH urges early medical consultation after floodwater exposure and treatment for clinically suspected cases even without lab confirmation. Response enhancements include patient navigation, hospital referrals, Unified Leptospirosis and Dengue Case Tracker, bed occupancy monitoring, and prepositioning doxycycline for post-exposure prophylaxis in flood-prone areas.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症症例が38%増加、DOHが流行閾値の突破を報告
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンでレプトスピラ症が流行閾値を突破し前年比38%増、複数地域で閾値超過とCFR5.1%の死亡例が確認されており、WPRO基準を複数満たし政府（DOH）の関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Crisis: WHO Puts 20,000 Ervebo Doses To Test Against Deadly Bundibugyo Strain
article.articleSummary: DRC faces the Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak, with Ituri Province as epicenter, now expanding to seven provinces and 63 health zones amid insecurity and a wider humanitarian crisis complicating response. Ituri has accounted for more than 80% of confirmed cases as of early September. As of Sept 20, WHO data show 7,733 confirmed Bundibugyo virus cases and 3,732 deaths (case fatality ratio 48.3%). Dungu Health Zone in Haut-Uélé is area affected, signaling potential cross-border spread. In response, WHO has allocated 20,000 Ervebo doses for a Phase 3 trial among health workers and others engaged in the response, to test cross-protection against Bundibugyo; this follows an initial allocation of 70,000 doses (20k for trial, 50k for frontline staff). Ervebo is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus and WHO-prequalified for that strain; there is no licensed Bundibugyo-specific vaccine. SAGE recommends using Ervebo within research protocols, and vaccination must not replace established outbreak control measures.

triage.headline_ja: DRCエボラ危機：WHOがブンディブジョ株に対しエルベボワクチン2万回分の試験投与を実施
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブジョ株エボラが7州63保健区に拡大し、致死率48.3%と高く、国際的な対応（WHOによるワクチン試験）が行われているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 既存のZaire株用ワクチン（エルベボ）をBundibugyo株に対して交差防御効果を検証する臨床試験が実施中であり、治安不安と人道危機が対応を複雑化させている点にも留意。国境を越えた拡大の可能性（Dungu, Haut-Uélé）も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD Terbanyak di Gunungkidul Ada di Ponjong, Capai 64 Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Highest Dengue Fever Cases in Gunungkidul Are in Ponjong, Reaching 64 Cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Gunungkidul Regency, Indonesia, reached 216 from January through September 2026, with Ponjong Subdistrict recording the highest 64 cases (58 at Ponjong Health Center 1 area, 6 at Ponjong Health Center 2). Other clusters include Paliyan and Wonosari 2 areas with 22 cases each. The outbreak spans 18 subdistricts; Ponjong accounts for almost one-third of total. As of September 2026, no dengue deaths were reported. January was the peak month (over 60 cases), while July–September averaged fewer than 10 per month. In 2025, Gunungkidul reported 1,167 cases, indicating a downward trend. Public health measures emphasize vector control under PSN 3M Plus, with a target ABJ of at least 95%, plus Germas/PHBS education, routine larval monitoring, and ovitrap-based surveillance. Citizens are urged to cover water containers, drain standing water, and remove potential mosquito breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: グヌンキドゥル県のDBD（デング熱）症例、最多はポンジョン地区で64件
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの地方自治体レベルでの季節性デング熱発生報告であり、死亡例なく前年比で減少傾向にある地域の定例的な公衆衛生モニタリング情報のため。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアの風土病で毎年季節的に発生。本記事は前年比で症例数が減少傾向（2025年1,167件→2026年1-9月216件）にあることを示しており、既存の地域ベクター対策プログラム（PSN 3M Plus）が機能している状況。死亡例もなく、通常の公衆衛生活動報告の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-RDC : MSF pilote une étude sur la vaccination des soignants de première ligne - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: MSF pilots a study on vaccinating frontline healthcare workers - ACP
article.articleSummary: DRC—MSF and Epicentre launched a six-month prospective study, Bravo, vaccinating 20,000 frontline health workers in Ituri and North Kivu against Ebola virus disease amid the Bundibugyo outbreak. Initiated Sept 19, 2026 at the WHO staff training center in Bunia, the study aims to document and evaluate Ervebo, the only vaccine deployed at scale with an established safety profile, in a real-world outbreak setting. Although Ervebo targets Zaire ebolavirus and not Bundibugyo, preliminary data suggest some cross-protection that could reduce severe disease and deaths. The trial underscores that vaccination is voluntary and supplementary, not a replacement for proven infection prevention and control measures. The Bundibugyo strain remains circulating in DRC with no specific vaccine or treatment; meanwhile, other Bundibugyo-targeted vaccines are under development. Nord-Kivu has seen an unprecedented surge and the outbreak recently spread to a seventh province.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行下のコンゴ民主共和国：国境なき医師団(MSF)が最前線医療従事者へのワクチン接種に関する研究を主導
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ株エボラの流行が北キブ州で前例のない拡大を見せ、第7の州にまで拡大している中、特異的ワクチン・治療法が存在しない深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念があるため。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には既存ワクチン(Ervebo)は本来対象外だが交差防御の可能性を検証する試験段階。流行はコンゴ民主共和国内で第7州に拡大しており、既に大規模流行として継続中の事案。国境を越える拡大リスクについては記事中に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Jakarta Pusat Gencarkan Tracing Tuberkulosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Jakarta City Government Steps Up Tuberculosis Tracing
article.articleSummary: TB tracing is intensified by Central Jakarta City Government through integrated Free Health Checks (CKG) in Kwitang. On 18 September 2026, in RW 08, Kelurahan Kwitang, Kecamatan Senen, Jakarta Pusat, health teams conducted direct community outreach to detect tuberculosis early. Jakarta Pusat Administrative and Welfare Assistant Nurhidayat stated the effort targets not only identifying residents with TB but also verifying health status of family members at risk by offering examinations. The approach aims to prevent TB transmission by early diagnosis and timely access to health services for those indicated, strengthening ongoing community surveillance. By engaging households in the tracing process, the program seeks to uncover latent risks, enable prompt treatment, and safeguard public health across Central Jakarta.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタ中央市政府、結核の追跡調査を強化
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に対する通常の公衆衛生対策（早期発見・追跡調査）の一環であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による通常のTB対策プログラムの報道であり、感染急増や異常発生を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : 900 écoles ciblées par l'Unicef pour renforcer la prévention - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: 900 schools targeted by UNICEF to strengthen prevention - ACP
article.articleSummary: 900 schools in Ituri province, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, are targeted by UNICEF to strengthen infection prevention and control (IPC) against Ebola. Yvon Muke, director of EDU-NC Ituri 1, says UNICEF will progressively equip these schools with IPC measures, with other partners also joining to shield students and staff. Support has already begun, including handwashing facilities installed before holidays. UNICEF's involvement aided preparations for the 2025-2026 school-year certification exams, enabling them to proceed under the Ebola context. Muke called for sustained support from additional partners to bolster protection of pupils and educational personnel across Ituri. The effort underscores the broader Ebola response and the need for continued investment in school-based infection prevention and health-related infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州でのエボラ出血熱：ユニセフが予防強化のため900校を対象に支援
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州における進行中のエボラ出血熱流行に関する記事であり、疾病の重篤性・地域拡大リスクが高いため、継続監視及びフルリスク評価の対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事自体は学校での感染予防対策（ユニセフ支援）に関する内容であり新規症例報告ではないが、イツリ州における既存のエボラ流行が継続していることを示唆しており、感染症の重篤性から監視継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: EBOLA: Nigeria on high alert
article.articleSummary: New Ebola alert: Nigeria on high alert as DRC reports outbreak. Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) placed the country on heightened surveillance after an update on Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Travellers arriving from countries with active Ebola transmission are advised to complete Health Declaration Form as part of enhanced monitoring. The advisory, signed by NCDC Director-General Jide Idris, notes preparatory activities and reviews based on evolving situation, informed by a Dynamic Risk Assessment and consultations with public health experts and the Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare. Nigerians are urged to stay vigilant for Ebola symptoms and promptly seek medical attention, providing travel or exposure history when relevant. The alert follows thousands of confirmed DRC cases and related deaths; as of Sept 20, 2026, DRC recorded 7,672 confirmed cases and 3,699 deaths. NCDC remains committed to surveillance, preparedness and response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリア、高度警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で7,672例の確定症例・3,699人の死亡という大規模なエボラ出血熱流行が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでの大規模エボラ流行であり、ナイジェリアは越境リスクに備えた監視強化の段階（ナイジェリア国内での症例確認は未報告）。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: RDCongo.- El brote de ébola deja ya cerca de 7.800 casos y más de...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo - The Ebola outbreak has already left nearly 7,800 cases and more than ...
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists as of Sep 23, 2026, with 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths (case fatality 48.4%), and 1,935 recoveries. Declared in mid‑May in eastern DRC, the outbreak is the deadliest in the country’s history. Cases span seven provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and Lower Ubangi—affecting 63 of 167 health zones. Surveillance reports 84.5% of contacts followed. The DRC, having faced more than a dozen Ebola outbreaks since 1976 near Yambuku on the Ebola River, recently noted the Kasai outbreak ended in December 2025, underscoring its extensive experience with the virus. Ongoing transmission emphasizes sustained vigilance, laboratory confirmation, and rapid public health response to reduce mortality in this large, persistent outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 - エボラ出血熱の流行、感染者数約7,800人、死者数3,750人以上に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行が7州・63保健地区に拡大し、国内史上最も死者数の多い流行となっており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確に認められる。
triage.notes: 2026年5月中旬に東部DRCで宣言された流行で、同国史上最多の死者数を記録。7州63保健地区に拡大し、接触者追跡率は84.5%。カサイ州の別流行は2025年12月に終息済み。継続的な監視と対応強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ayam Katsu Terindikasi Jadi Penyebab 17 Siswa dan Guru di Jepara Keracunan MBG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chicken katsu suspected to be the cause of MBG poisoning among 17 students and teachers in Jepara.
article.articleSummary: Seventeen students and teachers from three Jepara schools fell ill with stomach pain, diarrhea, and nausea after MBG meals on 16 September 2026. Laboratory tests on leftover MBG foods from SPPG Karangkebagusan detected bacteria in chicken katsu, specifically Staphylococcus aureus and Salmonella species; the accompanying vegetables (cabbage and carrot) and mentai sauce were also contaminated. Water samples showed total coliforms exceeding standards, with drinking water >200 colonies. Officials say cross-contamination may have occurred, and some raw chicken portions arrived in poor condition and were processed with other chicken, then served as katsu. The investigation suggests the chicken katsu contained bacteria from the raw poultry, spreading to other items through preparation, leading to suspected food poisoning.

triage.headline_ja: 鶏カツがジェパラの生徒・教員17人のMBG給食食中毒の原因と特定される
triage.triage_reason: 単一の学校給食施設における食中毒事案であり、病原体（Staphylococcus aureus、Salmonella）による局所的な食品汚染事例で、国際的拡大やヒト-ヒト感染のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 疾患名にParatyphoid/Typhoidとあるが、記事内容はStaphylococcus aureusおよびSalmonella属菌による給食（MBGプログラム）の食中毒事例であり、腸チフス・パラチフスの発生ではない。学校給食施設での衛生管理不備（生鶏肉の交差汚染、飲料水の大腸菌群基準超過）が原因とされる局所的事案。

article.articleHeadline: 'பங்கேற்கவில்லை ; வக்கில்லை' டெங்கு பாதிப்பு குறித்து அமைச்சர் அருண்ராஜ் மீது எடப்பாடி பழனிசாமி சரமாரி தாக்கு..!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "'Not participating; not appearing' — Edappadi Palaniswami launches a scathing attack on Minister Arunraj over dengue infection."
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is spreading rapidly in Tamil Nadu with hospitals overwhelmed. As of 21 September 2026, the health department reports 17,348 confirmed dengue cases and 4,653 scrub typhus cases, with 71 dengue cases detected in a single day on that date. AIADMK general secretary Edappadi Palaniswami released a statement accusing the Tamil Nadu government of negligence and inaction. He criticized Health Minister Arunraj for not attending a health department meeting and for promoting a dengue awareness video during campaigning. Palaniswami urged a war-footing vector-control response: door-to-door surveys to identify and remove mosquito-breeding sites, universal larviciding, and ensured access to medicines, beds, doctors, and mobile medical camps. He claimed the Amma regime had started mosquito control early, and demanded intensified dengue-prevention measures under the current administration.

triage.headline_ja: 「参加しない、恥知らず」―デング熱対応をめぐりエダパディ・パラニサミ氏がアルンラージ保健大臣を痛烈批判
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱1.7万件超・つつが虫病4,600件超と大規模な感染拡大があり、病院が逼迫、政治的関心も高まっているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主に政治批判の内容だが、デング熱・つつが虫病の大規模流行と医療体制逼迫が報告されており、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。国際的拡大や渡航制限の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Barabanki News: कागजों में सिमटा संचारी रोग नियंत्रण अभियान, गांवों में गंदगी से बढ़ा संक्रमण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Barabanki News: Communicable disease control campaign confined to paperwork; infections in villages have increased due to unsanitary conditions.
article.articleSummary: Barabanki district reports rising dengue and malaria infections amid deteriorating sanitation, with four deaths and a growing fever caseload. Officials say vector-control campaigns remain largely on paper as regular cleaning and anti-larvae spraying falter, while garbage piles and water stagnation from city to village fuel mosquito breeding. In Suratganj town, despite waste-disposal claims, dumps near the fish market and the BRC office emit odors and hinder movement; similar debris problems persist elsewhere. In Masouli block’s 56 Gram Panchayats, blocked drains and heaps of grass, straw, and litter leave standing water after rain, heightening mosquito risk. The Barabanki CHC at Badgaon is seeing crowded fever clinics, with many patients visiting informal practitioners. Reported are suspected dengue, malaria, and fever cases, underscoring that unsanitary conditions are driving ongoing transmission rather than effective outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: バラバンキ・ニュース：伝染病対策活動が書類上に終始し、村々では不衛生により感染が拡大
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州バラバンキ地区における季節性のデング熱・マラリア流行のローカル報道であり、死亡例や患者増加はあるが国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクは見られず、社会的関心も限定的なため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: インドの複数州で毎年発生するデング熱・マラリアの季節性流行に関するローカルニュース。衛生管理の不備を指摘する地方行政批判記事であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いと判断されるが、死者数や患者数の推移について続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: 9 tháng đầu năm, Vĩnh Long ghi nhận 6 trường hợp tử vong do bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the first nine months of the year, Vĩnh Long recorded six rabies deaths.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a public health concern in Vĩnh Long Province, Vietnam. In the first nine months of 2026, six human rabies deaths were recorded across Tân Xuân, Hiệp Mỹ, Châu Hưng, Bến Tre, Ba Tri and Tân Thủy, with four animal outbreaks (Phước Mỹ Trung, Lộc Thuận, Đồng Khởi, Thạnh Phước) detected via Early Warning and Surveillance System (EBS) and Infectious Disease-Cluster Management (IBCM). From 2022–2025, the province reported 24 rabies deaths, with 2025 reporting zero fatalities. Post-exposure vaccination for people is expanding, approaching 100,000 individuals annually. Nine-month 2026 data show 54,581 human vaccine doses administered. Over 600 alerts via Zalo and more than 20 samples reviewed, with four dog samples testing positive. About 333,000 dogs and cats exist, many roaming; authorities aim to raise animal vaccination coverage above 80%, strengthen surveillance, and promote responsible pet ownership and rapid response, including testing and culling per regulations.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年の最初の9カ月間、ヴィンロン省で狂犬病による死亡者6名を記録
triage.triage_reason: ヴィンロン省では狂犬病が毎年発生している風土病であり、既存のサーベイランス・ワクチン接種体制下での定例報告と見られるが、人の死亡例が継続しており動物への曝露が続くため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムの風土病であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はないため国際的拡大リスクは低い。既存のIBCM/EBSシステムによる監視・ワクチン接種活動が進行中であり、地方当局主導で管理可能とみられる。継続的な動物由来曝露（放し飼いの犬猫約33万頭）がある点は留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola deja ya cerca de 7.800 casos y más de 3.750 muertos en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has already left nearly 7,800 cases and more than 3,750 deaths in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has resulted in nearly 7,800 reported cases and more than 3,750 deaths as of 2026-09-23. The report does not include granular details on clinical symptoms, laboratory confirmation, transmission chains, or current containment measures. No information is provided on case distribution by province, vaccination efforts, or public health interventions. The article’s Spanish content references a separate civil-legal matter in Pontevedra, Spain, unrelated to the outbreak, and provides no new health data. Based on the data presented, the situation indicates ongoing transmission with significant mortality, but no updates on response strategies or international involvement are described.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、感染者約7,800人、死者3,750人以上に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSpain/Galicia/Pontevedraが含まれるが、記事内容は無関係な民事訴訟の言及であり、実際の感染症発生地はDRCのみ。症例数・死亡者数の規模から見て極めて深刻な流行だが、詳細な臨床情報・対応状況は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : à Beni, des prestataires de la riposte contre Ebola en grève depuis deux jours réclament quatre mois d'arriérés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: In Beni, Ebola response contractors on strike for two days are demanding four months of back pay.
article.articleSummary: Ebola response contractors in Beni, the provisional capital of North Kivu, launched a two-day strike starting September 21, 2026, over unpaid allowances. The workers—communications, community engagement, psychosocial teams, and community relays—demand three to four months of back pay that they say remains unsettled. They gathered outside the Beni Health Zone office, posted banners, erected barricades, and lit a fire at the entrance to the coordination office; police extinguished the blaze, but the strike halted work. They call on response authorities to resolve salary arrears and accuse the authorities of failing to disburse funds despite government claims. In Bunia, Ituri, in July, Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba said delays were not due to funds shortfalls, citing an “Ebola Business” controversy and pledging harmonization of primes for clinicians, community workers, and relays, with a budget extension anticipated in the revised finance law.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ベニでエボラ対応の契約職員が2日間のストライキ、4か月分の未払い賃金を要求
triage.triage_reason: エボラ対応職員の未払い賃金によるストライキで対応活動が一時停止しており、感染管理能力への影響が懸念されるが、新規症例や感染拡大に関する直接的な情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ対応スタッフの未払い賃金によるストライキと運営上の資金問題に焦点を当てており、エボラ自体の新規感染拡大に関する情報は含まれていない。対応活動の中断が続けば感染管理に支障をきたす可能性があるため、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : MSF lance une étude sur le vaccin ERVEBO contre le virus Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: MSF launches a study on the ERVEBO vaccine against Bundibugyo virus.
article.articleSummary: MSF launched BRAVO study in Bunia, Ituri, DRC, to document use of ERVEBO vaccine against Bundibugyo virus among 20,000 frontline workers exposed to the disease during the eastern DRC outbreak. The six-month study began 19 September 2026, with three months dedicated to vaccination. It covers Ituri and North Kivu provinces. The aim is to collect real-world data on vaccination use and potential effectiveness; participation and vaccination are voluntary. Vaccination is a supplementary protective measure and does not replace existing infection prevention and control measures. The study is carried out with the DRC Ministry of Health, Africa CDC, and scientific partners. Bundibugyo virus causes a viral hemorrhagic fever and is distinct from Ebola Zaire; ERVEBO was developed for Ebola Zaire. Vaccines specific to Bundibugyo are under development, with ERVEBO used provisionally in BRAVO.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：国境なき医師団（MSF）がバンディブジョウイルスに対するERVEBOワクチンの研究を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でのバンディブジョウイルス（エボラ属の一種）による出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中であり、2万人規模のワクチン研究が開始されるなど、公衆衛生上重大な事案として国際機関（Africa CDC等）が関与している。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のバンディブジョウイルス・アウトブレイクに対するワクチン研究開始の報告であり、新規発生報告ではない。ただし出血熱の継続的な曝露リスクとフロントラインワーカー2万人規模の研究であることから、フルRRAでの詳細確認が推奨される。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限に関する情報は記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 3 Hal Penting yang Wajib Diketahui Orang Tua soal Influenza Anak Menurut IDAI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 3 Important Things Parents Must Know About Pediatric Influenza According to IDAI
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's IDAI cautions parents that fever reduction does not mean recovery for pediatric influenza. Three key indicators to monitor are activity, intake, and output. After fever subsides, observe whether the child resumes normal activity, remains engaged, continues drinking, and keeps urinating. If fever declines only due to antipyretics or cooling, true improvement may be lacking. Seek urgent care if the child is difficult to wake, unusually irritable, experiences seizures, rapid breathing, blue-tinged skin, or bleeding. Dehydration risk rises in hot, dry weather; maintain hydration and check urine output every four hours, seeking medical advice if no urination for six hours. Nutritional needs should include animal protein and carbohydrates, with fruits as a supplement, not a substitute. This guidance aids Indonesian parents in home management and early detection of complications during influenza in children.

triage.headline_ja: IDAIによる小児インフルエンザに関して保護者が知っておくべき3つの重要事項
triage.triage_reason: 通常の小児インフルエンザに関する家庭内ケアの啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報がないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザの一般的な家庭内ケアガイダンスであり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常な感染拡大について報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bandung Fokus Pantau Influenza A di Puskesmas Padasuka, Pasien Bergejala Akan Di-swab
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bandung Health Office Focuses on Monitoring Influenza A at Padasuka Community Health Center; Symptomatic Patients Will Be Swabbed.
article.articleSummary: Bandung health authorities are focusing influenza A surveillance at Puskesmas Padasuka, where symptomatic patients with influenza-like illness are swabbed. According to Bandung Health Office head Soni Adam, every patient presenting influenza-like symptoms at Puskesmas Padasuka will be swabbed, with samples sent to Jakarta for confirmation of the influenza strain. Current data indicate detections of Influenza A, Influenza B, and Covid, though there are no Covid cases at present. Officials emphasize that Influenza A is endemic to Bandung, but the Puskesmas Padasuka surveillance does not reflect the entire city's circulation. City officials note many ED visits involve fever and flu-like symptoms, and stress careful monitoring rather than alarm. Mayor Muhammad Farhan says services must remain accessible and that no patient should be turned away, while authorities continue nationwide Covid vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: バンドン保健局、パダスカ保健センターでのインフルエンザA監視に注力、有症状患者はスワブ検査へ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの地域内サーベイランス強化に関する通常の公衆衛生活動であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: インフルエンザAはバンドンの風土病的存在とされ、地元保健当局が通常のサーベイランス強化を実施している段階。重症例やアウトブレイクの報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Rio confirma caso de raiva em cão que teve contato com morcego
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro confirms a case of rabies in a dog that had contact with a bat.
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in a dog in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, after contact with a bat. The case underscores that rabies remains a public health concern and vaccination is essential. The 2026 Rabies Vaccination Campaign for dogs and cats is scheduled for Saturday, September 26, coordinated by SES-RJ with guidance from CRMV-RJ. Pet owners should keep vaccinations up to date, leash dogs, and keep cats indoors; avoid free roaming. Do not handle bats—contact municipal zoonoses for removal. In bites, scratches, or mucous membranes or skin contact with any mammal, wash the area immediately and seek health care for rabies vaccination assessment and, if indicated, immunoglobulin. Domestic dogs/cats involved in aggression should be observed for 10 days; inform health services if illness or behavioral change occurs. Bats are ecologically important and legally protected.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロでコウモリと接触した犬が狂犬病陽性と確認
triage.triage_reason: 犬1頭の単発症例であり、ヒトへの感染や集団発生の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性・異常性は認められない。ワクチン接種キャンペーンの案内が主目的の記事。
triage.notes: 動物（犬）1例の狂犬病症例で、ヒト感染は報告されていない。地域の年次ワクチン接種キャンペーン告知が主な内容であり、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes DIY Pastikan Tak Ada Lonjakan Kasus Influenza A, Warga Diminta Terapkan Pola Hidup Bersih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DIY Health Office Ensures No Spike in Influenza A Cases, Residents Urged to Adopt Clean-Living Habits
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases in the Special Region of Yogyakarta (DIY), Indonesia, reach 18 at sentinel ILI/SARI sites as of 23 September 2026. Routine surveillance shows four weeks of decline in overall acute respiratory infections (ISPA) in DIY after a prior uptick, with no need for mass-testing expansion. DIY Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan DIY) emphasizes sentinel-based surveillance via designated primary care (ILI) and hospital (SARI) facilities, noting transmission remains controlled. Mitigation focuses on continuous public education and promotion of healthy living, including handwashing with soap and running water, cough etiquette, mask use when coughing, and covering the mouth. Plans include collaborative outreach through multiple media and a forthcoming influenza webinar with cross-sector partners. No imported/exported case data are reported.

triage.headline_ja: DIY保健局、インフルエンザA型患者数の急増はないと確認、住民には清潔な生活習慣の実践を要請
triage.triage_reason: 当局が感染拡大なし・状況管理下にあることを明確に発表しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず、社会的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常のサーベイランス報告であり、患者数18例で減少傾向、当局は感染拡大なしと明言している。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola : à Butembo, la hausse des cas confirmés met les centres de traitement sous pression | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: In Butembo, the rise in confirmed cases puts treatment centers under pressure.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues to strain treatment facilities in Butembo, North Kivu. At the Kitatumba Ebola Treatment Center, medical director Dr. Kakule Kihasaki Samson reports rising confirmed cases, with about a dozen daily in the Butembo health zone, shifting beds from suspected to confirmed cases. Two new centers were recently opened, bringing Butembo's total CTEs to four; the Matanda center, inaugurated September 21, has 30 beds, 20 for confirmed cases. The director warns of deaths occurring in inadequately equipped facilities, heightening exposure risks for staff and patients. In Nord-Kivu, as of September 19, 1,402 confirmed cases and 850 deaths (case fatality 60.6%), across 16 of 34 health zones. Nationally, the DRC reported 7,614 confirmed cases, 3,676 deaths, 1,864 recoveries across seven provinces as of September 22. MSF cautions against premature containment conclusions; new cases persist in underprepared areas, including Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ブテンボで確認症例が急増し、治療センターが逼迫
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC北キブ州で拡大を続けており、致死率60.6%と高く、複数州に及ぶ大規模アウトブレイクであるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 北キブ州ブテンボおよびイトゥリ州を含む複数州で症例増加、全国で7,614例確認・3,676死亡（2026年9月22日時点）。MSFは封じ込め完了の判断は時期尚早と警告。

article.articleHeadline: La Tunisie envoie une cargaison de médicaments et d'équipements médicaux à la RDC pour faire face à l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tunisia sends a cargo of medicines and medical equipment to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to confront the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On Sept 22, 2026, Tunisia sent a cargo of medicines, medical and paramedical supplies to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to support the Ebola response, following an African Union appeal. The shipment, loaded onto a Tunisian military aircraft, arrived in Kinshasa and will be handed to authorities under supervision of the Tunisian embassy. The operation is coordinated by multiple Tunisian ministries—foreign affairs, migration, national defense, health and social affairs—with the Tunisian Red Crescent and the Tunisian Union of Social Solidarity. As of Sept 20, 2026, the World Health Organization reports 7,733 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,732 deaths in the DRC, across 63 health zones in seven provinces. The outbreak has expanded to new areas, including Dungu in Haut-Uélé near the Sudanese border, heightening concerns of cross-border spread and maintaining a very high internal and border risk.

triage.headline_ja: チュニジア、エボラ流行に対応するためコンゴ民主共和国に医薬品と医療機器を輸送
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7,733症例・3,732人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続し、スーダン国境付近の新地域（Dungu）にまで拡大しており、国際支援も動員されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: スーダン・チュニジアは記事に登場するが、感染発生国はDRCのみであり対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。国境付近（Dungu, Haut-Uélé）への拡大はスーダンとの国境近接によるクロスボーダーリスクを示唆しているが、スーダンでの症例発生は明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Balloon Juice - Plagues & Pandemics Update - September 23, 2026
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains the largest on record, with over 7,000 cases since May and about 50% mortality, according to government data compiled by the WHO. Ongoing violence and mass displacement hinder contact tracing and isolation, and distrust of outside aid workers complicates response efforts. A vaccine trial, Ervebo, has launched in the Ebola-affected DRC, targeting the Zaire strain, with hopes of cross-protection against Bundibugyo despite ongoing challenges. In the United States, COVID-19 hospitalizations are rising: as of Sept 16, 2026, 27 states show growth, 13 decline, and 10 remain unchanged. The CDC has not yet announced when COVID shots for low-income children will be available.

triage.headline_ja: バルーン・ジュース - 疫病・パンデミック最新情報 - 2026年9月23日
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるブンディブギョ・エボラ流行は7000症例超・致死率約50%と記録的規模で、暴力・避難民により対応が困難化しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのブンディブギョ・エボラ流行とアメリカのCOVID-19入院動向の2トピックを扱うが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC alcanza 7.800 casos y supera los 3.750 fallecidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC reaches 7,800 cases and surpasses 3,750 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) declared in May has reached 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths (case fatality 48.4%), with 1,935 recoveries. Latest INSP bulletin notes 84.5% of contacts traced. The eastern outbreak spans seven provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and Ubangi (Ubangi/Bas-Uele region)—affecting 63 of 167 health zones. The DRC, with a long Ebola history since 1976, references a Kasai outbreak that ended in December 2025. The virus was first identified in 1976 near Yambuku on the Ebola River. Control measures emphasize epidemiological surveillance, selective vaccination, and community outreach campaigns to curb transmission across these regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、7,800症例に達し死者3,750人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラ流行が7州・63保健区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: DRCは1976年以来エボラの流行を繰り返している地域であり、既存の流行病であるため異常性はNoと判断したが、規模・致死率・拡大範囲から公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事案としてPICKUP判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox au Kasaï : neuf zones de santé touchées, et des décomptes officiels qui ne concordent pas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox in Kasaï: Nine health zones affected, and official counts that do not match.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Kasaï province affects nine health zones with 77 suspected, 16 confirmed cases and 3 deaths (Sept 20, 2026). Luebo remains the epicenter with 38 suspected, 13 confirmed and 3 deaths; Mushenge 13/3; Kanzala 11; Mikope 6; Kalonda Ouest 3; Kamuesha 2; Kitangwa 2; Ndjoko-Punda 1; Tshikapa 1. On Sept 17, the provincial government named five zones (Mushenge, Kanzala, Dekese, Luebo, Ilebo) as affected, while a separate briefing lists nine zones; Dekese and Ilebo are absent from the provincial tally, overlapping with only three names. The Sept 10 count for Luebo showed 74 cases and 8 deaths; the discrepancy with Sept 20 totals is unexplained. Lab confirmation is pending; samples have been sent to INRB. Response includes medicine shipments, rapid-response teams from Sept 10, expanded surveillance, and vaccination considerations; cholera and suspected yellow fever co-circulation reported (11 suspected).

triage.headline_ja: カサイ州のMpox：9つの保健地域が影響を受け、公式集計に不一致
triage.triage_reason: DRCカサイ州で複数の保健地域にわたるMpox（サル痘）流行が拡大し、死亡例・確認例が増加、加えてコレラ・黄熱病の共circulationも報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にKenyaが記載されているが、記事本文はDRCカサイ州の状況のみを扱っており、Kenyaでの発生に関する記述はないため除外した。ラボ確認は保留中（INRBへ検体送付）で、州政府とブリーフィングの集計に不一致がある点が信頼性上の懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Super Flu Bikin Tubuh Tumbang: Ketika Influenza Menyerang hingga ke Mata
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Super Flu Causes the Body to Collapse: When Influenza Attacks Even the Eyes.
article.articleSummary: A personal account describes a severe influenza-like illness labeled 'super flu,' not a distinct diagnosis, linked to influenza A(H3N2) subclade K of seasonal H3N2. Symptoms include fever, widespread body aches, extremely painful sore throat with speech difficulties, bitter taste, vomiting, extreme fatigue, and eye-related complaints. The piece notes that influenza can be more acute than a common cold, aligning with CDC-listed symptoms such as fever, myalgia, fatigue, cough, sore throat, and headache. WHO identifies subclade K as part of seasonal A(H3N2), having evolved from subclade J.2.4 and been identified and spreading across various regions since 2025. The article raises questions about severity and ocular involvement but provides no laboratory confirmation or specific case counts. Published 2026-09-23.

triage.headline_ja: スーパーフルが体を蝕む：インフルエンザが目にまで襲いかかるとき
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H3N2サブクレードKに関する個人体験記事であり、症例数や検査確認情報がなく、集団発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す具体的根拠が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は個人の闘病体験記であり、臨床データ・症例数・公的機関の発表は含まれていない。季節性H3N2サブクレードKは世界的に報告されているが、本記事単体では公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す証拠は不十分。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : 348 élèves sensibilisés aux mesures barrières à Mambasa - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 348 students sensitized to barrier measures in Mambasa - ACP
article.articleSummary: 348 students from Complexe Scolaire La Victoire in Gabon village, Mambasa health zone, Ituri province, North-East Democratic Republic of Congo, were trained on Ebola virus disease barrier measures on 23 September 2026. The session, led by Socico, aimed to empower pupils to act as community sensitizers within their families, neighborhoods, and villages. Key guidance included regular handwashing, avoiding contact with bodily fluids of a sick person, and maintaining physical distancing; participants were urged not to touch bodies of the deceased in communities or health facilities, but to alert response teams, notably the dignified and safe burials (EDS) pillar. Marie-Noëlle Anotane, Socico coordinator, said the training provided practical clarifications and encouraged proactive outreach to curb transmission. The program emphasizes community engagement to break the Ebola transmission chain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：マンバサで348人の生徒がバリア対策について啓発を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州マンバサ地域で進行中とみられるエボラ対応活動（住民啓発）に関する記事であり、新規症例数や死亡者数など具体的な疫学情報が示されていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ対応活動（学校での予防啓発）を報じたものであり、新規発生や症例数の情報は含まれていない。ガボンは記事本文中で言及される村名（Gabon村）であり、国としてのガボンの発生は確認されないため対象国リストにも含まれず除外。

article.articleHeadline: Africa-Europe research consortium targets evidence gap keeping young children out of parasite control programs
article.articleSummary: IVM-KIDS aims to close a safety-evidence gap for ivermectin use in children under 15 kg (roughly under five years) across Africa and Europe. The four-year project (Sept 2025–Aug 2029) involves Ghana (Accra meetings), Kenya, Tanzania, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with partners LSHTM (UK), KNUST/KCCR (Ghana), KEMRI (Kenya), INRB (DRC), Liconsa and Mundo Sano (Spain), DNDi, and Swiss TPH. It will generate clinical, pharmacokinetic, safety, and regulatory data to determine whether ivermectin can be safely and effectively extended to children 5–15 kg, for use against onchocerciasis, lymphatic filariasis, scabies, and soil-transmitted helminths (including Trichuris trichiura). A new 3 mg orodispersible pediatric formulation will be evaluated alongside generic ivermectin. Existing data (2021 review of >1,000 children) showed no serious adverse events, but larger trials are needed to inform policy and potentially reach >250 million children globally in endemic regions.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ・欧州の研究コンソーシアムが、幼児を寄生虫対策プログラムから排除している証拠不足の解消を目指す
triage.triage_reason: これは研究プロジェクト(IVM-KIDS)の立ち上げに関する発表であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の風土病（オンコセルカ症、リンパ性フィラリア症、疥癬、土壌伝播蠕虫症）に対する薬剤（イベルメクチン）の小児向け安全性・有効性を検証する多年次研究プロジェクトの発表であり、アウトブレイクシグナルではないためDISMISSと判定。対象国（ガーナ、DRC等）での活動が記載されているが、疾病発生報告ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Pastikan Kesiapan Faskes Antisipasi Lonjakan Influenza A, Pemkot Surabaya Warga Jangan Panik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ensure Health Facilities Are Ready to Anticipate an Influenza A Surge; Surabaya City Government: Residents, Do Not Panic.
article.articleSummary: Surabaya, East Java, Indonesia, is preparing health facilities for an anticipated surge of Influenza A. The Surabaya City Government instructs hospitals to coordinate with authorities and ensure adequate medical staff. Despite higher acute respiratory infection (ARI) and flu activity, the increase is not attributed to Influenza A alone, with ARI/flu admissions up about 10–15% from January–August to September. Hospital bed occupancy is reportedly full, but not due to a surge in severe influenza cases requiring intensive care; treatment remains standard flu care, without excessive strain-strain differentiation akin to Covid-19. Authorities urge the public to maintain immune health, use masks in crowds or enclosed spaces, and consider vaccination against influenza at nearby facilities. Citizens with ARI symptoms—cough, sneezing, fever, and fatigue—should rest and seek care at the nearest Puskesmas if symptoms persist, not panic.

triage.headline_ja: 医療機関の準備を確保しインフルエンザA型の急増に備える、スラバヤ市政府:市民はパニックにならないように
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ様症状(ARI)の増加が報告されているが、重症化や集中治療を要する症例の急増はなく、通常の診療範囲内であるため、現時点で明確な異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はスラバヤ市の季節性インフルエンザ対応準備に関する行政広報であり、重症例増加やヒト-ヒト感染拡大の明確な兆候はない。ただしARI/インフルエンザ患者数が10-15%増加している点は継続監視の対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : l'épidémie reste hors de contrôle, forte hausse des cas au Nord-Kivu (OMS)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: the outbreak remains out of control, sharp rise in cases in North Kivu (WHO).
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains out of control, with 7,733 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths. Between Aug 31 and Sep 20, cases fell about 26% in Ituri and 15% in Upper Uele, but rose 73% in North Kivu, underscoring divergent transmission across seven affected provinces. The WHO warns the epidemic continues to pose a significant risk to regional and global health security. Children under five have a case-fatality rate over 60%, vs about 40% in adults. Contact tracing is near 88%, yet many new infections lack known epidemiological links, revealing surveillance gaps. The response must focus resources on high-risk zones while maintaining essential health services, consolidate gains in Ituri, strengthen North Kivu and other hotspots, improve early detection, reduce community deaths, and sustain cross-border preparedness. This is the largest and deadliest outbreak in DRC, and the second largest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ出血熱：流行は依然として制御不能、北キブ州で症例が急増（WHO）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ満たし（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WHOが地域・世界の健康安全保障への重大なリスクと警告している大規模流行であるため。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州・北キブ州を含むDRC国内7州にわたる大規模流行。DRC史上最大・最も死亡率の高い流行であり、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行に次ぐ世界第2位の規模。5歳未満の致死率60%超と極めて高い。サーベイランスギャップと国境を越えた伝播リスクが指摘されており、国際的な支援継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue-Swine Flu Alert : जींद में स्वाइन फ्लू और डेंगू का डबल अटैक, दोनों बीमारियों के 13-13 मामले; स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट - dainiktribuneonline.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue-Swine Flu Alert: In Jind, a double attack of swine flu and dengue, 13 cases each of the diseases; Health Department Alert.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 September 2026, Jind district in Haryana reports 13 swine flu (influenza) cases and 13 dengue cases. A 33-year-old man from Dahola village died at PGI Rohtak during treatment; another swine flu patient is admitted in a hospital in Hisar. No dengue deaths are reported. Health authorities have intensified surveillance, with district malaria officer Dr. Bijender Dhanda noting mass fever surveys to identify fever cases and test suspected patients. With seasonal change, monitoring is heightened for fever illnesses, and dengue prevention focuses on identifying and addressing mosquito breeding sites. Emphasis is on early detection, timely treatment, and containment to prevent spread, and the public is advised to seek care for fever, cough, cold, or breathing difficulties.

triage.headline_ja: デング・スワインフル警報：ジンドで13例ずつの二重発生、保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: インド・ハリヤナ州の一地区における季節性のデング熱・スワインフルの小規模発生であり、地元当局が通常の監視・対応を行っている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められず、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱・スワインフルの流行で、症例数も少なく(各13例)、地方の地区レベルでの通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。1名の死亡例があるが、大規模なアウトブレイクや異常な事態を示す証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia records 175,000 respiratory infections as wildfires rage
article.articleSummary: Indonesia reports about 175,000 acute respiratory infections (ARI/ISPA) from August 18 to September 21 across 63 districts in six provinces affected by forest and land fires, per Health Ministry spokesman Berton Panjaitan. Of these, 40,363 involve children under five. Fires, raging since June, have spread through Sumatra and Kalimantan, causing haze and deteriorating air quality that also affects Malaysia and Singapore. In response, Indonesia deployed 64 aircraft and 54,394 personnel since August; Japan contributed three CH-47 Chinook helicopters and about 180 personnel to assist water-bombing in Kalimantan aboard the JS Kunisaki. The report notes ARI/ISPA cases; laboratory confirmation details were not provided.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア、森林火災の悪化に伴い呼吸器感染症17万5000件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 本事案は森林火災による大気汚染に起因する急性呼吸器症状（ARI/ISPA）の増加であり、病原体によるヒト-ヒト感染や感染症アウトブレイクではないため、感染症シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本事案は森林火災による煙害・大気汚染に起因する呼吸器症状の増加であり、感染症病原体の関与は示されていない。国際支援（日本の航空機派遣）は既に実施済みで対応中。マレーシア・シンガポールへの影響は大気汚染（ヘイズ）の越境であり、感染症の国際拡大ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: تونس توجّه شحنة مساعدات طبية إلى جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية دعما لجهود مكافحة فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tunisia dispatches a shipment of medical aid to the Democratic Republic of the Congo in support of efforts to combat the Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: On 22 September 2026, Tunisia dispatched a humanitarian aid shipment to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to support Ebola response efforts. Coordinated by the Tunisian Ministries of Foreign Affairs and Migration, Defense, Health, and Social Affairs, along with the Tunisian Red Crescent and the Tunisian Solidarity Union, the consignment comprises medicines and medical and para-medical supplies to bolster Kinshasa authorities’ capacity to curb Ebola transmission. The shipment was transported by a Tunisian military aircraft to Kinshasa International Airport, under Defense Ministry supervision. The Tunisian embassy in Kinshasa will oversee delivery to the relevant Congolese authorities. This initiative follows an African Union appeal urging member states to assist Congo in reinforcing its healthcare system amid the Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: チュニジア、エボラウイルス対策支援としてコンゴ民主共和国へ医療援助物資を輸送
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対し、アフリカ連合の要請を受けてチュニジアが医療支援を行っている状況であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念があり国際的な支援体制が動いていることから、進行中の重大イベントとしてフルRRAで状況確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCの既存エボラアウトブレイクへの国際支援（チュニジアからの医療物資輸送）に関する報道であり、新規感染状況データは含まれていない。DRCにおけるエボラの現状（症例数・死亡数・地理的拡大状況）について別途最新情報の確認が必要。チュニジアは支援提供国であり発生国ではないため対象国リストに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Indonezija bilježi 175.000 slučajeva respiratornih infekcija dok bjesne šumski požari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesia records 175,000 cases of respiratory infections as wildfires rage.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia reports 175,000 acute respiratory infections (ARI/ISPA) in areas affected by wildfires and land fires, recorded from August 18 to September 21 across 63 districts in six provinces. Of these, 40,363 cases are in children under five. Prolonged fires and a dry season since June have intensified spread across Sumatra and Kalimantan. Indonesia deployed 64 aircraft and more than 54,000 personnel since August to fight the blazes. Japan contributed three CH-47 Chinook helicopters and about 180 military personnel to air support operations from the JS Kunisaki, positioned off Ketapang, Kalimantan. The fires have produced thick haze and degraded air quality in Indonesia, with smoke also affecting Malaysia and Singapore.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア、森林火災が猛威を振るう中で呼吸器感染症17万5千件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 本事象は森林火災による煙害（大気汚染）に起因する急性呼吸器症状の増加であり、病原体による感染症拡大やヒト-ヒト感染のリスクは認められないため、EBSの感染症シグナルとしては該当しない。
triage.notes: 本事象は感染性病原体によるものではなく、森林火災由来の煙害（ヘイズ）による大気質悪化が原因の急性呼吸器感染様症状（ISPA）の増加。感染症としての伝播性はなく、環境イベントとしての対応（消火活動・国際支援）が中心。マレーシア・シンガポールへの煙拡散は言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: सहजन में फैले बुखार के दृष्टिगत सीएमओ ने किया निरीक्षण, मृतकों के परिजनों से की मुलाकात
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In view of fever spreading in Sahjan, the CMO conducted an inspection and met the families of the deceased.
article.articleSummary: In Sahjan village, Mohammadi block, Lakhimpur Kheri district, Uttar Pradesh, fever cases and two deaths triggered a health alert on 23 Sept 2026. Chief Medical Officer Dr. Santosh Gupta, village officials, and health teams conducted a ground inspection. Archana, 23, died 28 Aug 2026; preliminary cause: typhoid and infection. Pratibha, 17, developed fever on 13 Sept 2026 and died en route to Shahjahanpur after 13–14 Sept deterioration; preliminary diagnosis: acute abdomen. Sanitation issues identified: drinking water lines passing through drains, a dirty pond nearby, and a pig enclosure outside the village, potentially fostering infections. Immediate actions: cleaning and sanitation, fogging for vector control, and door-to-door surveys with vaccination; CHC supervisor to collect samples for malaria, dengue, typhoid, and Japanese encephalitis. Residents told to boil water or use government handpump water. A health camp treated 156, with 130 tested (1 malaria, 1 typhoid); chlorine tablets distributed; a follow-up camp planned for Thursday.

triage.headline_ja: サハジャンで蔓延する熱病を受け、CMOが視察を実施し遺族と面会
triage.triage_reason: 単一村落レベルの熱病クラスターで死亡2例が発生し、地方保健当局が調査・対応中だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められず、情報も限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 村落レベルの発熱・死亡例で、原因はチフス・急性腹症などが疑われ、マラリア・デング・日本脳炎の検査も実施中。衛生環境（汚染水路、養豚場等）が感染要因として指摘されている。地方当局が既に消毒・啓発活動を開始しており、外部支援の必要性は現時点で不明。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: PHL hammering out ASF regionalization deal with UK | Ada Pelonia
article.articleSummary: ASF regionalization talks between the Philippines and United Kingdom aim to sustain pork trade by permitting exports from areas proven free of African swine fever (ASF) even amid outbreaks elsewhere in the Philippines and/or UK. At the second Joint Economic and Trade Committee (JETCO) meeting, DTI Undersecretary Allan Gepty and UK Trade Minister Anas Sarwar highlighted collaboration with DA and DEFRA to develop Philippines ASF regionalization guidelines. This approach avoids a country-wide ban, preventing price spikes and supply disruptions; UK pork exports to the Philippines totaled 19,918 metric tons in 2025. The partners plan a memorandum of understanding on agriculture, trade, and cooperation, and will pursue capacity-building in precision breeding, antimicrobial resistance, fisheries, and food safety. Manila-London regionalization would safeguard market access while expanding cooperation in aquaculture, biotechnology, animal/plant health, and climate-resilient agriculture.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン、ASF地域区分に関する協定を英国と協議中
triage.triage_reason: 記事はASF（アフリカ豚熱）に関する貿易・地域区分の政策協議であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や感染拡大情報を含まないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はASF（動物疾病）の貿易規制・地域区分に関する外交協議が主題であり、ヒトへの健康被害情報は含まれない。英国(UK)は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 中秋国庆假期 注意防范手足口病、诺如病毒病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day holidays: Be vigilant to prevent hand, foot, and mouth disease and norovirus infection.
article.articleSummary: During the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day holidays in China, health authorities warn that hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) and norovirus infections can recur; prior infections do not guarantee immunity. With travel and gatherings increasing, emphasize hand hygiene, food safety. Key measures: wash hands with soap and running water for at least 20 seconds after using the restroom and before meals; norovirus is not fully inactivated by alcohol-based sanitizer; avoid raw or undercooked foods and ensure seafood is cooked through. If vomiting or diarrhea occurs, clean and disinfect contaminated areas; patients should not prepare food for others. Ensure ventilation in indoor spaces and consider masks in crowded or poorly ventilated venues. Flu vaccination is advised for elderly, children, and those with chronic diseases; protection develops in 2–4 weeks. Seek care for fever, rash, vomiting, or diarrhea and report travel/exposure. HPV vaccine should be completed for 13-year-old girls per arrangements.

triage.headline_ja: 中秋節・国慶節の連休：手足口病とノロウイルス感染症への注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の一般的な公衆衛生啓発記事であり、異常な流行や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 季節性の休暇に伴う一般的な予防啓発情報であり、具体的な流行拡大や異常事態の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Phase II Clinical Trial of NV-387 as a Treatment for Monkeypox (MPox) Has Begun in DRC, Announces NanoViricides
article.articleSummary: Phase II clinical trial of NV-387 for mpox has begun in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Lodja, Sankuru province), enrolling first patients. The adaptive, international, multi-center, randomized, open-label Phase II (IIa/IIb) evaluates NV-387 oral gummies versus standard of care in patients with clinical mpox signs and laboratory-confirmed or presumptive hmpxv infection (PACTR202609506749917). Principal Investigator is Prof. Vivi Maketa Tevuzula (University of Kinshasa/IMABE). On-site collaboration includes Om Sai Clinical Research Pvt. Ltd. in a remote, resource-poor area where mpox Clade I is endemic. There is no approved mpox drug; tecovirimat and brincidofovir have faced efficacy/toxicity questions elsewhere. NV-387 could become a go-to pandemic drug if licensed; US SNS stockpiling of smallpox drugs underscores potential market value. NV-387 has sought US FDA Orphan Drug Designation.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでNanoViricides社のNV-387、サル痘（Mpox）治療薬として第II相臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は既知のDRCにおけるmpox Clade I流行に対する治療薬の臨床試験開始を報じるものであり、新規の感染症発生や流行拡大を示す疫学的シグナルではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は治験開始の発表であり、新規アウトブレイクや症例急増の報告ではない。DRCのmpox Clade I流行自体は既知の継続的公衆衛生上の懸念事項だが、本記事単体では新規シグナルとしての価値は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Auraiya News: डेंगू-मलेरिया का बढ़ा खतरा, जलभराव में पनप रहे मच्छर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Auraiya News: Increased risk of dengue and malaria, mosquitoes breeding in waterlogged areas.
article.articleSummary: Auraiya district in Uttar Pradesh faces rising dengue and malaria risk amid monsoon-driven waterlogging. Hospitals report fever cases; diagnostics indicate dengue and malaria, but the government portal lists only five dengue cases, raising concerns about undercounting. Stagnant, dark water in vacant plots, drains, and roadside areas provides mosquito breeding grounds, with limited cleaning and drainage. Patients present with high fever, headaches, body pains, weakness, and low platelets; several seek care in Kanpur, Etawah, and other cities after local treatment. Official counts exclude private labs’ results until laboratory-confirmed, delaying inclusion. Municipalities are urged to conduct regular cleaning, drainage, spraying, and fogging; however, campaigns are criticized as cursory and inner-community neglect persists. Without timely action, dengue and malaria cases could rise in Auraiya.

triage.headline_ja: アウラヤ・ニュース：デング・マラリアのリスク増加、水たまりで蚊が繁殖
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州の一地方における季節性（モンスーン時期）のデング・マラリア発生報告であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクはなく、通常の季節性感染症報道の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 地方メディアによる季節性のデング・マラリア報道。政府統計との不一致（過小報告の可能性）が指摘されているが、行政による対応（清掃・薫蒸等）で管理可能な地域内事象と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Antrean Pasien di IGD RSUD Bandung Kiwari Tak Semua Kasus Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patients Line Up in Bandung Kiwari Regional General Hospital Emergency Department: Not All Cases Are Influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Bandung Kiwari Regional General Hospital in Bandung reports that the surge in Emergency Department visits is not solely due to Influenza A. In children, cases include high fever, diarrhea, and dehydration; in adults, pneumonia is a common complaint. Hospital Director Arief Budiman notes there is no influenza data because the hospital does not perform swab testing for the disease. Overall, the ED crowd does not yet reflect a single pathogen. The hospital’s bed occupancy rate stands at 74% of 333 beds, indicating inpatient capacity remains, though patient transfers from ED to wards are being staged. Stable patients are encouraged to be discharged home with follow-up at outpatient clinics. The hospital seeks additional staffing, calling for more nurses and general physicians in the wards to speed up admissions and discharges.

triage.headline_ja: バンドン・キワリ地域総合病院の救急外来で患者が列をなす:全てがインフルエンザAの症例ではない
triage.triage_reason: 病院の救急外来混雑に関する報告であり、スワブ検査未実施のためインフルエンザ確定例もなく、単一病原体による異常な流行の証拠がないため。
triage.notes: インフルエンザA確定診断はなく、病院側もスワブ検査を実施していないため病原体不明。病院の人員・病床逼迫に関する報道であり、感染症アウトブレイクの明確な証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: பரவிவரும் டெங்கு காய்ச்சல்; மக்களின் உயிரோடு விளையாடும் தவெக அரசுக்கு இபிஎஸ் கண்டனம்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spreading dengue fever; IPS condemns the government that toys with people's lives.
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu faces a dengue outbreak with 17,348 dengue infections and 4,653 Scrub Typhus cases confirmed as of Sep 21, per the health department; 71 dengue cases were recorded on Sep 21 alone. Hospitals, both public and private, are reported full. IPS condemns the government for lax action, while AIADMK general secretary Edappadi Palaniswami accuses authorities of endangering lives. He calls for wartime dengue control, including door-to-door surveys to identify and eliminate mosquito breeding sites, intensified vector control, and ensuring medicines, beds, and medical staff. He urges immediate dengue prevention advisories and public awareness. The article criticizes the health minister for absence at planning meetings and campaign-style messaging, urging a return to aggressive vector-control efforts during the rainy season to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 拡大するデング熱；人々の命をもてあそぶ政府をEPS（エダッパディ・パラニサミ）が非難
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱1.7万件超、つつが虫病4,653件が確認され病院が満床となるなど公衆衛生への深刻な影響とベクター媒介感染の拡大リスクがあり、政治・社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: デング熱・つつが虫病は季節性の風土病だが、今回は症例数が非常に多く病院が満床になるなど医療体制への負荷が顕著。政治的批判記事だが感染規模データは具体的で信頼性あり。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak toll exceeds 3,700 deaths
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak toll has surpassed 3,700 deaths after more than 130 days. WHO notes a mixed trajectory: in the last 21 days, cases fell ~26% in Ituri and ~15% in Haut Uele, but rose ~73% in North Kivu, indicating uneven transmission across seven affected provinces with the Bundibugyo strain. Ongoing response expands to nearly 1,400 treatment and isolation beds across 49 Ebola treatment centres and 25 laboratories capable of 2,500 tests daily. A major concern remains many deaths occurring in the community before reaching care—about one in three new infections identified only after death at home. Children under five have the highest case fatality rate (>60%, vs ~40% in adults), and detection in this group is especially challenging. WHO emphasizes decentralizing the response to remote villages to close surveillance gaps, improve early detection, and interrupt transmission, while maintaining broad tests and contact tracing (~88%). EbolaFacts: transmission from wildlife to humans and human-to-human spread with CFR around 50% on average.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者数が3700人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が7州に拡大し死者3700人超、致死率60%超の地域もあり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを有するためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 北キブ州で症例が73%増加するなど地域差があり、コミュニティ内での死亡（在宅死後の感染確認）が3分の1に上るなどサーベイランスの課題が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Palaniswami slams TVK-led regime for not taking steps to curb spread of dengue
article.articleSummary: Dengue spread in Tamil Nadu is criticized by AIADMK leader Edappadi K. Palaniswami, who accuses the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam-led government of not taking sufficient steps to curb dengue. He notes the government’s alacrity in attributing an Anna University student’s death to scrub typhus, but not acting swiftly on dengue despite warnings. He points to the absence of Health Minister K.G. Arunraj at a Director of Public Health review meeting and disputes claims that dengue’s impact is lower this year, arguing the burden is higher than last year. Palaniswami urges intensified awareness campaigns and preventive measures. The article also mentions AMMK leader T.T.V. Dhinakaran criticizing the Chief Minister over other governance issues such as power shortages and crime against women.

triage.headline_ja: パラニスワミ氏、デング熱の拡大阻止に向けた対策を取らないTVK主導政権を非難
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はタミルナードゥ州における既知の季節性デング熱流行を巡る政治的批判・論争が主題であり、新規の公衆衛生上の異常事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は政治家間の非難合戦を報じるもので、デング熱・ツツガムシ病の具体的な感染者数・死亡者数・臨床データは提供されていない。既存の季節性流行に関する政治的論争であり、フルRRAの対象とはしない。続報でデング熱の実際の規模拡大が確認されれば再評価を検討。

article.articleHeadline: Conectividade entre viveiros eleva risco de doenças na piscicultura
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Connectivity between hatcheries increases disease risk in aquaculture.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian researchers at Embrapa Pesca e Aquicultura, in partnership with Italy's IZSVe, applied an Italian GIS-based methodology to map areas vulnerable to waterborne disease spread among aquaculture operations. They show that connectivity among hatcheries within the same watershed increases disease dissemination risk, prompting development of high/medium/low contamination maps to guide rapid response in emergencies. The protocol, originally developed for animal health surveillance and calamities such as avian influenza, was adapted to study the acantocéfalo (acanthocephalan) parasite affecting tambaqui (Colossoma macropomum). The parasite's eggs in fish feces reach ostracods (intermediate hosts); healthy fish become infected by feeding on contaminated ostracods, with the full cycle lasting about two months. Infected fish may lose up to 20% of potential weight, imposing economic costs. The study, triggered by a 2015 Rondônia outbreak, suggests GIS-informed risk zoning can strengthen surveillance and be applied to other species.

triage.headline_ja: 養殖池間の接続性が水産養殖における疾病リスクを高める
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は魚類養殖における寄生虫（鉤頭虫）による経済的被害とGISリスクマッピング手法の研究に関するものであり、鳥インフルエンザは過去の方法論適用例として言及されているに過ぎず、実際のヒト感染症イベントではない。
triage.notes: 記事は水産養殖分野における寄生虫病（鉤頭虫、タンバキ魚に感染）とGISベースの疾病リスクマッピング研究の紹介であり、鳥インフルエンザ自体の発生報告ではない。ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的関連性はなく、トリアージ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Tunisia sends medical aid to DRC to support Ebola response
article.articleSummary: Tunisia sent medicines and medical equipment to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to support the Ebola response. The aid, transported by a Tunisian military aircraft to Kinshasa International Airport, was provided in response to an African Union call to bolster the DRC's health capacity amid the outbreak. The World Health Organization says the Ebola outbreak in the DRC remains uncontrolled, although infections have modestly declined nationwide, with transmission shifting geographically toward an international border. The DRC has reported 7,733 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,732 deaths as of Sunday. This international assistance underscores ongoing cross-border support to strengthen outbreak response capabilities in Kinshasa and affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: チュニジア、DRCのエボラ対応支援のため医療援助を派遣
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行は制御不能とされ、感染者7,733人・死者3,732人に達しており、国際的な支援が動員されている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はチュニジアからDRCへの医療援助に関する内容だが、背景として進行中の大規模エボラ流行（未制御、国境地域への感染拡大）が言及されており、既存のアウトブレイクの重要な進展として評価対象とする。チュニジア自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: ‎Kisangani : une société civile recommande le renforcement de la sensibilisation communautaire contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: a civil society organization recommends strengthening community awareness about Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Urgent call for strengthened community awareness to limit Ebola virus disease transmission in Kisangani, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, within Tshopo Province. With confirmed Ebola presence in Kisangani and rising case numbers, the civil society coalition Forces vives de la RDC / coordination of Tshopo advocates intensified local outreach on hygiene and adherence to barrier measures. Ongoing proximity sensitization continues in areas exposed to population movements from neighboring provinces. A recent mission by the structure’s secretary-executive to Bafwasende territory included sessions in Kondolo, Bekeni, and Bafwasende-Centre, extending toward the Haut-Uele border. The effort underscores a targeted community engagement approach to curb transmission in Kisangani and surrounding districts.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ:市民社会団体がエボラに対する地域啓発の強化を提言 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国キサンガニでエボラ確定症例が増加しており、地域社会への感染拡大リスクが懸念されるため、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を満たしフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にChad（Logone Oriental等）が含まれるが、記事本文はDRCキサンガニ及びツショポ州、バフワセンデ地域のエボラ流行に限定されているため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns DR Congo Ebola outbreak still uncontrolled as cases surge in North Kivu
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak remains uncontrolled, with North Kivu experiencing a sharp surge while Ituri shows some improvement. As of the DRC health authorities’ tally, 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths have been reported. Between Aug. 31 and Sept. 20, cases declined about 26% in Ituri and 15% in Haut-Uele, but North Kivu rose 73%. Seven provinces are affected, each with distinct transmission patterns; the outbreak is not under control and continues to threaten regional and global health security. Children under five have a case-fatality rate above 60%, compared with about 40% among adults. Contact follow-up is near 88%, yet many new infections lack a known epidemiological link, highlighting surveillance gaps. Response priorities: consolidate gains in ITuri, strengthen North Kivu and other hotspots, detect cases earlier, reduce community deaths, and maintain cross-border preparedness. Declared in May, this is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC and the second-largest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCのエボラ出血熱流行が依然として制御不能と警告、北キブ州で症例急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準中3つ該当し、致死率が高く越境拡大リスクが明示されている大規模・深刻なエボラ流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（北キブ、イトゥリ、オートウエレ州等7州）の流行のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Infografis: 'Super Flu' Terdeteksi di 13 Provinsi RI, Ini Sebarannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infographic: 'Super Flu' Detected in 13 Indonesian Provinces, Here Is Its Spread.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 September 2026 (Week 37), Indonesia's Influenza and COVID-19 Case Surveillance Report shows the 'Super Flu' detected in 13 provinces. The term refers to influenza A(H3N2) subclade K, not a new virus, but a mutated lineage within H3N2. Dr Nastiti Kaswandani of the Indonesian Pediatric Society's Respirology Working Group notes that influenza A, including H3N2 and subclade K, can cause more severe illness in high-risk groups. By age, the high-risk groups are toddlers and the elderly. She stated this during an online press conference of IDAI on 29 December 2025. The article summarizes the spread but provides no lab-confirmation details, infection source, or imported/exported-case specifics beyond the national surveillance update.

triage.headline_ja: インフォグラフィック：「スーパーフル」がインドネシア13州で検出、その拡散状況
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H3N2)の変異株（subclade K）がインドネシア13州で検出されたとのサーベイランス報告だが、重症例数・死亡者数等の具体的な深刻度データがなく、新規病原体でもないため緊急性は限定的。ただしメディアで「スーパーフル」として注目されており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: H3N2 subclade Kは新規ウイルスではなく既存H3N2の変異系統。国のインフルエンザ・COVID-19サーベイランス報告に基づく記事で、検査確定や感染源、重症例数の詳細は記載なし。センセーショナルな「Super Flu」という呼称による社会的関心の高まりに注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: NSCDC places Nigeria on high alert following Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-23, Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts Nigeria's NCDC to place the country on high alert. An interim public health advisory states some international travellers arriving from countries with active or relevant EVD transmission may be required to complete a Health Declaration Form for enhanced surveillance; travellers from unaffected countries remain exempt for now. Nigerians are urged to watch for EVD symptoms—fever, weakness, muscle pain, headache, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhoea, and, in severe cases, bleeding—and seek prompt medical care with travel or exposure history. The measure follows an assessment of the DR Congo outbreak and consultations with public health authorities, with ongoing preparedness activities nationwide and potential adjustments as the outbreak evolves. The article notes Nigeria's 2014 outbreak (20 confirmed cases, eight deaths) as historical context.

triage.headline_ja: NCDC、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを受けナイジェリアを厳重警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは重篤かつ異常な公衆衛生事象であり、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限措置（健康申告書要求）が確認されるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、ナイジェリアは予防的警戒措置を取っているのみで実際の発生国ではないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。ナイジェリアは対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: कानपुर में डेंगू प्रभावित क्षेत्र का निरीक्षण,... | UNI Varta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Inspection of dengue-affected area in Kanpur, ...
article.articleSummary: On 23 September 2026, in Kanpur, health authorities inspected dengue-affected areas under directives from the Chief Medical Officer. Nodal Officer for Vector-Borne Diseases Dr. Rajeshwar Singh, District Malaria Officer Arun Kumar Singh, and PATH Regional Coordinator Dr. Shivkant inspected the laboratory at Kanshiram Combined Hospital and Trauma Centre and issued guidance. A surprise inspection of the DTC Harjinder Nagar Fever Help Desk followed after a dengue case was detected in Safipur Ward 1 in Harjinder Nagar. The team conducted fever surveys, diagnostic testing, source reduction, and larvicidal spraying, among other measures, to curb transmission and prevent further cases. The report highlights ongoing surveillance and targeted vector control in the dengue-affected Kanpur area.

triage.headline_ja: カンプールのデング熱発生地域を視察
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域における通常のデング熱対策・監視活動の報告であり、異常性や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱は例年インドで季節的に発生する疾患であり、本記事は地方自治体による定例的な媒介動物対策・監視活動の報告に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: DRC: Humanitarian needs surging as Ebola spreads and El Niño looms
article.articleSummary: As of 23 September 2026, Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with the virus appearing in South Ubangi more than 1,000 km from its outbreak origin in Ituri province, straining an already stretched health system amid displacement and poor access to clean water and sanitation. CARE International warns that El Niño could cause up to 10,000 deaths in the DRC over the next six months due to heat, floods and drought, exacerbating humanitarian needs. Overcrowding, insecurity, and weak transport links hinder exposure tracking, case detection, and access to care, increasing transmission risk. Women and girls bear the highest burden through caregiving, water collection, and food acquisition, with rising gender-based violence linked to displacement. Urgent scale-up of prevention, surveillance, and community-based response is needed, with guaranteed humanitarian access and increased investment; coordination with the Ministry of Health continues.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ拡大とエルニーニョ現象の懸念で人道的ニーズが急増
triage.triage_reason: エボラがイトゥリ州の発生源から1,000km以上離れた南ウバンギ州にまで拡大しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: エボラが発生源のイトゥリ州から遠く離れた南ウバンギ州まで拡大しており、人道危機・インフラ脆弱性・エルニーニョによる複合災害リスクが重なっている点に留意が必要。
