article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Deteksi Kasus Super Flu di RI, Ini Sebaran Wilayahnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Detects Super Flu Cases in Indonesia, Here Is Its Regional Distribution.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A (H3N2) subclade K, dubbed 'super flu', has been detected in 13 Indonesian provinces since January 2026, according to the Ministry of Health. Cumulative data up to September 2026 show East Java and South Kalimantan leading with 18 cases each (about 24% of total). Other provinces reporting cases include West Java (12), DKI Jakarta (11), Sumatera Selatan (5), Sumatera Utara (3), with smaller counts in Bali, Nusa Tenggara Timur, Nusa Tenggara Barat, North Sulawesi, Central Java, Sulawesi Selatan, and DI Yogyakarta. Subclade K is a genetic mutation of influenza A that spreads more easily due to faster replication and higher viral load in the upper respiratory tract. Symptoms commonly include fever 39–41°C, severe muscle pain, intense headache, extreme fatigue, and dry cough, with longer illness duration than seasonal flu. Seek medical care if symptoms worsen or persist beyond 3–5 days.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア保健省、国内で「スーパーフル」症例を検出 ― 地域別感染状況
triage.triage_reason: 新規変異株（H3N2 subclade K）がインドネシア13州に拡大し、感染力増強と重症化傾向が報告されており、政府・メディアの関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: H3N2 subclade Kは複製速度と上気道でのウイルス量増加により感染力が高いとされる新変異株。死亡・入院データは記事に記載なく、重症度の定量評価は不明。続報でのRRA実施が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: அரசின் சுணக்கத்தால் தமிழகம் முழுவதும் டெங்கு பரவல் அதிகரிப்பு" - பழனிசாமி சாடல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in dengue spread across Tamil Nadu due to government's negligence — Palaniswami slams.
article.articleSummary: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, 21 Sept 2026: Dengue fever is spreading across Tamil Nadu amid allegations of government negligence by AIADMK's Edappadi Palaniswami. He stated lax preventive measures and delays in issuing dengue explanations and safety guidelines have caused a steady rise, with the health department reporting 17,348 dengue cases in Tamil Nadu up to 21 Sept 2026, and 4,653 chikungunya cases. On 21 Sept 2026 alone, 71 dengue cases were detected. Palaniswami criticized the DMK government for inaction, citing the death of an Anna University student and alleging attention was diverted to scrub typhus. A high-level meeting under the Public Health Department director discussed containment, but the health minister did not attend and released only an awareness video. Palaniswami urged door-to-door mosquito-control drives, adequate hospital beds, medicines, and field spraying to eliminate breeding sites and reassure the public.

triage.headline_ja: 「政府の怠慢によりタミルナードゥ州全体でデング熱の拡大が増加」―パラニサミ氏が批判
triage.triage_reason: タミルナードゥ州でデング熱17,348例・チクングニア熱4,653例と大規模発生し死亡例も報告されており、政治的・社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: デング熱は季節性流行の側面があるが、症例数の多さ・死亡例・政治問題化していることからPICKUP判定。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Endonezya'da yangın bölgelerinde 175 bin solunum yolu enfeksiyonu vakası görüldü
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Indonesia, 175,000 cases of respiratory tract infections were observed in the fire-affected areas.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health reported about 175,000 acute respiratory tract infection (ARI) cases in wildfire-affected areas across 63 districts in six provinces since August. From 18 August to 21 September, ARI activity was recorded in the 63 districts under fire impact. Children under five are the most affected, with 40,363 ARI cases in this age group. Prolonged drought since June and fires across Sumatra and Kalimantan have accelerated exposure to smoke and respiratory infections. In response, authorities have deployed about 64 aircraft and 54,394 personnel since August to fight the fires. Smoke and degraded air quality have caused regional haze, impacting neighboring Malaysia and Singapore. The report centers on ARIs and does not provide death counts or laboratory-confirmed details, while firefighting operations continue in the affected Indonesian regions.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの火災地域で17万5000件の呼吸器感染症が発生
triage.triage_reason: 森林火災の煙害による急性呼吸器感染症(ARI)の増加であり、感染性病原体によるヒト-ヒト感染ではなく季節性の環境要因事象であるため、感染症シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 本イベントは感染性病原体ではなく森林火災による煙害・大気汚染に起因する急性呼吸器感染症(ARI)の増加報告。ヒト-ヒト感染性はなく、毎年発生する季節性の環境健康問題であるため感染症危機管理上のシグナルとしての優先度は低い。ヘイズはマレーシア・シンガポールにも影響しているが、これは大気汚染の拡散であり感染症の国際伝播ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Controle de Zoonoses mantém alerta contra a dengue e prevenção em Foz do Iguaçu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zoonoses Control Remains Vigilant Against Dengue and Prevention in Foz do Iguaçu.
article.articleSummary: Foz do Iguaçu's Center for Zoonoses Control (CCZ) intensified dengue prevention city-wide. The latest Dengue Epidemiological Bulletin (22 Sept) records 44 confirmed dengue cases in 2026, with 3,892 notifications and 3,710 discarded; no dengue deaths in 2026 or 2025. Chikungunya shows 139 suspected and 2 confirmed; no Zika cases. Among dengue patients, 63.6% are female and 36.4% male, with the 20–29 age group most affected; the Northern Health District reports 15 confirmations. Prevention includes home visits, school educational activities reaching 9,683 students, and El Niño-fueled rainfall raising transmission risk. The Wolbachia-method stage two began in August, releasing Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti in 28 neighborhoods with goal of full municipal coverage. Mutirões de zeladoria (clean-up drives) in the Northeast region run through the week, distributing about 40 dumpsters to remove potential breeding sites and engage the community in vector control.

triage.headline_ja: 人獣共通感染症対策センター、フォス・ド・イグアスでデング熱対策と予防を継続
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・フォス・ド・イグアスにおける通常のデング熱サーベイランス・予防活動の報告であり、死亡例なし、症例数も特段の異常増加は見られず、既存の対策（Wolbachia法、清掃活動）が順調に進行している定例的な内容。
triage.notes: デング熱死亡例なし、チクングニア熱は疑い139件・確定2件のみ、ジカ熱は0件。El Niñoによる降雨で媒介リスク上昇の指摘はあるが、地域の通常対応（Wolbachia法拡大、清掃活動）で管理可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Pre-monsoon anti-dengue operations gain momentum in districts
article.articleSummary: Rising dengue cases in Tirunelveli and Tenkasi prompt intensified anti-dengue operations with the Northeast Monsoon expected mid-October. In the past 45 days, dengue admissions have risen across hospitals, including Tirunelveli Government Medical College Hospital, with Aedes aegypti breeding in stagnant rainwater. Tirunelveli Corporation has boosted inspections, waste segregation and drainage; fines for water stagnation include ₹5,000 at a hotel and ₹3,000 at a private building with a hospital worker staying. Fogging has begun and will be intensified. Tilak Nagar, Madurai, saw Aedes aegypti larvae in stagnant water in a vacant plot and in a hotel water tank, prompting ₹3,000 fines. In Tenkasi, door-to-door inspections and fogging are ordered; health centres should create dengue wards and monitor fever patients' platelet counts, reporting daily. Three suspected dengue deaths in Kadayanallur area, including two from the Boganallur Sri Lankan refugee camp, reported within four weeks; a camp was held at the refugee camp.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン前の抗デング熱対策活動が各地区で本格化
triage.triage_reason: インド・タミルナドゥ州で季節的なデング熱症例増加と対策強化が報じられているが、地域的流行の兆候であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、既存の公衆衛生対応で管理可能とみられる。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱流行対策に関する地方自治体の記事。スリランカ難民キャンプでの疑い死亡例3件が報告されているが詳細な重症度データは不明。モンスーン季節に伴う毎年の傾向とみられ、地域保健当局が主体的に対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : présence opérationnelle des partenaires dans la réponse à l'épidémie d'Ebola(MVE-BVD )Au 22 septembre 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Operational presence of partners in the response to the Ebola outbreak (MVE-BVD) as of September 22, 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of September 22, 2026, 57 organizations support the Ministry of Health's Ebola virus disease (EVD) incident management system for the outbreak in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. The coalition comprises 29 national NGOs, 20 international NGOs, 4 UN agencies, 2 government bodies, and 2 observer organizations. Partners back Infection Prevention and Control (IPC), Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH), patient care and nutrition, epidemiological surveillance, active case finding and contact tracing, entry-point surveillance, laboratory services, and integrated data management and analysis, plus deployment of human resources. They also cover coordination, logistics, training, financing, environment, security and protection, mental health and psychosocial support, gender-based violence care, research, community engagement and Protection from Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA), and continuity of essential services. The accompanying map shows partner distribution by health zones at risk and affected zones. Data come from the DRC Health Cluster 3W and MVE datasets updated to Sept 22, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 北キヴォ：2026年9月22日時点のエボラ出血熱（MVE-BVD）対応におけるパートナーの活動状況
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キヴォ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱流行に対し57団体が支援体制を敷いており、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大性と支援継続の必要性が明確であるため、フルリスク評価対象とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のエボラ流行に対する多機関対応の状況報告であり、新規感染拡大等の情報は含まれていないが、エボラという疾病特性上、継続的なリスク評価・監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia records 174,000 respiratory cases as haze from Borneo and Sumatra fires worsens -- over 40,000 cases in toddlers | The Independent Singapore
article.articleSummary: Indonesia reported 174,694 acute respiratory infections (ARIs) from Aug–Sep 21, 2026 across seven haze-affected provinces, totaling over 174,000 ARIs with more than 40,000 cases in toddlers. The fires in Borneo, Sumatra, and Papua produce toxic PM2.5-rich smog, prompting health ministry interventions including oxygen concentrators, oxygen canisters, and masks. Public guidance urges reduced outdoor activity when air quality worsens and hydration, as cases surge from ongoing forest and land fires intensified during the dry season (July–October). The blaze-linked respiratory health burden coincides with forecasts of the strongest El Niño in four decades, alongside climate change and long-term forest degradation and slash-and-burn practices. The pollution also affected neighboring Malaysia and Singapore, with several stations recording unhealthy to hazardous air quality.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア、ボルネオ島・スマトラ島の森林火災による煙害で呼吸器疾患17万4000件を記録――幼児の症例が4万件超
triage.triage_reason: 感染症ではなく森林火災由来のヘイズ(大気汚染)による急性呼吸器感染症の増加であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や病原体の異常性は認められないが、症例数の多さと越境的な大気汚染の広がりから継続的な観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本事案は感染症ではなく森林火災由来の大気汚染(ヘイズ)による急性呼吸器感染症の増加であり、Unknown Illnessという疾患分類は病原体不明を意味するものではない。マレーシア・シンガポールへの煙害拡大は言及されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。感染症としてのフルRRAの必要性は低いが、大気質と症例数の推移を継続的に監視することが望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Sinop mantém ações preventivas e casos de dengue apresentam redução
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sinop City Hall Maintains Preventive Measures as Dengue Cases Decline.
article.articleSummary: Sinop, Brazil—The City Hall's Health Secretariat maintains continuous prevention and control of Aedes aegypti, the dengue, chikungunya, and Zika vector, through the Centro de Combate às Endemias and the Cidade Limpa Operation. Neighborhood visits identify and eliminate breeding sites and provide guidance to residents. Dengue cases declined from 79 in May to 44 (June), 33 (July), and 12 in August, an approximate 85% reduction from May to August; from January through August 2026, no dengue deaths were reported, based on Sinan Online data updated September 8. Separately, 16 chikungunya and six Zika cases were recorded in the same period, with no alarm-sign, severe cases, or deaths. Ongoing outreach and the integration of cleaning, maintenance, and health prevention in neighborhoods aim to sustain control, emphasizing avoiding standing water and proper disposal of potential breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: シノップ市役所、予防策を継続し、デング熱症例は減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱の症例数はむしろ減少傾向にあり、死亡例もなく、既存の予防対策が奏功している通常の公衆衛生活動の報告であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・マトグロッソ州シノップ市における感染症予防対策の継続とデング熱症例の顕著な減少を報告する内容であり、危機的な状況ではない。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS ve los "primeros signos alentadores de progreso" en la lucha contra el ébola de RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO sees the first encouraging signs of progress in the fight against Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports early signs of progress in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). In the past three weeks (Aug 31–Sep 20), cases fell about 26% in Ituri (east, epicenter) and 15% in Haut-Uélé (northeast), but rose 73% in North Kivu (east), showing divergent transmission across seven affected provinces. The outbreak spans 63 health zones across Ituri, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, South Kivu, and South Ubangi. As of Sep 21, there have been 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths; 1,935 recoveries; 839 patients hospitalized or in isolation; case fatality rate 48.4%. The outbreak began May 15 in eastern DRC and is described as the second-deadliest and most contagious globally, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak in the region; the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak caused about 11,000 deaths and 28,000 cases. Challenges include staffing, decentralizing response, detecting in young children, and reducing community deaths before care. Officials expect further declines in coming weeks.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱対策で「進展の最初の明るい兆し」を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（7,773症例、致死率48.4%）が7州63保健区に拡大しており、地域により感染動向が悪化（北キブ州+73%）するなど深刻かつ継続的な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため。

article.articleHeadline: Reconciling Ebola response and community needs to prevent transmission
article.articleSummary: Delay of safe and dignified Ebola burial in Mutumbi, Ituri province, DRC, for more than 24 hours due to family resistance to body bags used in burial protocols. Kennedy Muhindo Wema, risk communication and community engagement (RCCE) specialist deployed via GOARN, led community dialogue to reconcile health measures with local rites. After nearly an hour of negotiations with local teams, youth leaders, and traditional chiefs, a compromise allowed the burial while preserving safety. Wema, an expert from the Bernhard Nocht Institute for Tropical Medicine (BNITM), supported listening and feedback mechanisms, rumor management, and surveillance, and helped establish two community watch brigades in Lita and Mangala (~30 trained members) to report concerns and facilitate dialogue, expanding to Beni. He also helped dismantle myths about Ebola treatment centers through guided visits for community leaders. GOARN deployments across DRC strengthen cross-border preparedness and outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応とコミュニティのニーズの調和による感染拡大防止
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラアウトブレイク対応に関する記事で、葬儀慣習をめぐる感染リスクとGOARNによる国際支援の必要性が示されており、疾患の重篤性からフルRRA対象と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれるRomania(Lita, Cluj)やAustralia(South Australia)は地名の同名衝突によるノイズであり、記事の主題はDRC・イツリ州のエボラ対応活動である。既知の継続中アウトブレイクへの対応活動報告であり、新規発生シグナルではないが疾患の重篤性からPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Democratic Republic (DR) Congo Ebola outbreak toll exceeds 3,700 deathsDR Congo Ebola outbreak toll exceeds 3,700 deaths
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola disease outbreak toll has exceeded 3,700 deaths, per WHO update dated 23 September 2026. In the past 21 days, cases fell about 26% in Ituri and 15% in Haut Uele, but rose 73% in North Kivu, indicating that the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has a distinct transmission profile across seven confirmed provinces. About one in three new infections are detected only after patients die in the community, heightening transmission risk via families and traditional burial practices. Children under five have the highest case fatality rate, over 60%, compared with roughly 40% in adults, complicating early detection in this group. Contact tracing is about 88% complete. Response expansion includes nearly 1,400 treatment and isolation beds across 49 Ebola treatment centres and 25 laboratories processing up to 2,500 tests daily. WHO stresses decentralising to remote villages to close surveillance gaps and interrupt transmission, as the outbreak persists in DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者数が3,700人を超える

article.articleHeadline: OMS ve avances en lucha contra el ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO sees progress in the fight against Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows early signs of progress, according to the World Health Organization. As of Sep 21, 2026, the epidemic has 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths, with 1,935 recoveries and 839 patients hospitalized or in isolation. Since May 15, when the outbreak was declared in eastern DRC, seven provinces across 63 health zones are affected: Ituri (epicenter) and Haut-Uele (northeast) have seen declines of about 26% and 15% in new cases over Aug 31–Sep 20, while North Kivu in the east has a 73% rise, highlighting divergent transmission patterns. Challenges include staffing shortages, decentralizing the response to rural areas, and detecting disease in young children and deaths in communities before hospital care. If trends persist, more sustained decreases in treatment centers and community transmission may follow in coming weeks. It remains the second-deadliest and most contagious Ebola outbreak globally, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa crisis.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ流行対策に進展を確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で拡大中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（史上2番目に致死率が高い流行）であり、死者数・症例数が甚大で公衆衛生上重大な影響があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 7773例確認・3759例死亡、7州63保健地区に拡大中。イトゥリ州・オートウエレ州では減少傾向だが北キブ州で73%増加と地域差あり。人員不足・農村部対応・小児検出の課題が続く。

article.articleHeadline: ഡെങ്കിപ്പനിയെ പ്രതിരോധിക്കാൻ 'ക്യൂഡെംഗ'; ഇന്ത്യയിലെ ആദ്യ ഡെങ്കി വാക്സിൻ 2027-ഓടെ വിപണിയിലെത്തും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To prevent dengue fever with 'Kyudeng'; India's first dengue vaccine will hit the market by 2027.
article.articleSummary: Dengue vaccine Kyudeng, developed by Japan's Takeda, is set for India's market by early 2027, via a partnership with Dr. Reddy's Laboratories. Kyudeng induces immunity against all four dengue virus serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4) and is approved for individuals aged 4 to 60 years. The two-dose schedule (0.5 ml per dose) is given three months apart, with no prior dengue infection testing required. Clinical data show 80.2% efficacy against dengue illness one year after the second dose and 90.4% efficacy in preventing dengue-related hospitalization. CDSCO granted approval in July 2026. Monsoon and post-monsoon seasons drive dengue transmission in India, and private-sector rollout in early 2027 is expected to bolster public health defenses against dengue fever.

article.articleHeadline: Período de estiagem não impede que Aedes aegypti se reproduza - Conexão Tocantins - Portal de Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The drought period does not prevent Aedes aegypti from reproducing.
article.articleSummary: Dengue risk persists in Palmas, Brazil, despite a drought, as Aedes aegypti remains active ahead of the rainy season. The August 31–September 4, 2026 Rapid Index Assessment (LIRAa) yielded a 0.2% Predial Infestation Index (IIP) and 0.2% Breteau Index (IB), considered low due to dry conditions and reduced standing water. Health officials warn the interepidemic period is a strategic window for vector control because Aedes eggs laid in containers can remain viable for months without water. Breeding sites include bottle caps, outdoor toys, pet water bowls, refrigerator trays, unused drains, gutters, and tarpaulin folds. The complete egg-to-adult cycle can take 7–10 days, prompting weekly domestic inspections. In a central Palmas building, larvae and pupae were found in drainage; chemical larvicides are ineffective against pupae, so elimination of breeding sites is essential. Residents should remove, cover, or discard containers to prevent water accumulation.

article.articleHeadline: Banda Lumpi Virus| Banda Lumpy Skin Disease| Lumpy Virus in Banda| Banda News| UP Lumpy Disease Case | Banda News: बांदा में लंपी वायरस का कहर, टीकाकरण पर उठे सवाल; कचरे में मिली दवाएं, जांच के आदेश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Banda Lumpi Virus| Banda Lumpy Skin Disease| Lumpy Virus in Banda| Banda News| UP Lumpy Disease Case| Banda News: Lumpy virus wreaks havoc in Banda, questions raised on vaccination; medicines found in garbage, orders for investigation
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) is spreading through cattle in Banda district, Uttar Pradesh, India, with affected animals showing nodules, wounds, bleeding, fever, nasal/eye discharge, and reduced appetite or milk production. Officials report vaccination campaigns underway, with about 33,000 of a target exceeding 100,000 animals vaccinated, claiming vaccines are sufficiently stocked but noting staffing shortfalls. Farmers allege vaccination irregularities and say actions are recorded only on paper. The situation worsened after medicines were found discarded in garbage outside the Lama Veterinary Hospital, prompting a government investigation and the formation of a committee to determine how medicines ended up there and whether immunization lapses occurred. District authorities promise urgent action and continued vaccination, stressing isolation of affected animals. The investigation results will determine accountability and future steps.

triage.headline_ja: バンダ発:ランピースキン病ウイルスが猛威、ワクチン接種に疑問;ゴミの中から薬剤発見、調査命令

article.articleHeadline: சருமத்தில் சிறிய கருப்புப் புள்ளி இருக்கிறதா? உண்ணிக் காய்ச்சல் எச்சரிக்கை!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Are there small dark spots on the skin? Typhoid fever alert!
article.articleSummary: Scrub Typhus, caused by Orientia tsutsugamushi and transmitted by chiggers, is a cause of prolonged fever in rural Indian children. Exposure occurs in scrubby grass, gardens, paddy field margins, and neglected areas. Early symptoms include sudden fever, headache, body and muscle pains, malaise, chills, and vomiting; some have lymphadenopathy and rash. An eschar at the bite site can occur but is not universal. If fever lasts beyond five days, doctors consider scrub typhus along with dengue, malaria, and typhoid. Severe disease may cause pneumonia, meningitis, myocarditis, kidney and liver injury, and multi-organ failure; warning signs include breathing difficulty, confusion, drowsiness, reduced urine, persistent vomiting, bleeding, or shock, requiring hospitalization. Diagnosis is clinical, supported by blood tests; empiric antibiotics are started when suspected. There is no vaccine; prevention focuses on protective clothing and hygiene after outdoor exposure. Parents should report fever persisting after outdoor play and any dark skin lesions.

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak recorded 7,700 cases, 3,700 deaths: WHO
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 7,733 confirmed cases and 3,732 deaths as of September 20, across 63 health zones. Declared 131 days ago, with Ituri (-26%), Hoveli (-15%) late August to Sept 20, and North Kivu (+73%) showing divergent transmission patterns. One-third of new infections identified after death in communities, raising transmission risk through family and burial practices. Children under five face >60% case fatality vs ~40% in adults. Response expanded to ~1,400 treatment/isolation beds across 49 Ebola treatment centres and 25 laboratories capable of 3,500 tests daily; contact follow-up ~88%. Challenges include human resource shortages and decentralizing to rural areas, delaying referrals. Early declines in North Kivu offer cautious optimism; sustained improvement needed.

article.articleHeadline: В Нигерии объявили высокий уровень готовности из-за вспышки Эболы в ДРК
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria declared a high level of readiness due to the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's National Center for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) declared a high level of readiness on 23 September 2026 due to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The NCDC issued enhanced epidemiological surveillance and public-health preparedness, including health-declaration forms for travelers arriving from countries with active or potential Ebola transmission; travelers from other countries are exempt. Citizens are advised to remain vigilant for Ebola-like symptoms and to seek prompt medical care, providing travel history or possible exposure. Recommendations are based on dynamic risk assessments conducted with public health experts and the Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare. As of 20 September, the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) reports 7,672 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,699 deaths in the DRC.

article.articleHeadline: Suspected food poisoning: Health officials inspect beverage outlet in Kannur
article.articleSummary: Suspected food poisoning linked to a popular beverage outlet at Caltex in Kannur. On September 21, seven members of a Kannur family who drank cocktails from the outlet developed health problems and sought treatment at Kolachery Primary Health Centre. Health and Food Safety officials inspected the outlet on September 23 after the complaints. Several others, including children, reportedly sought medical care and are under observation. Samples from the outlet will be sent for laboratory testing to identify the cause. The cases were reported to the Health department, and authorities are monitoring the situation as investigations continue; no laboratory-confirmed diagnosis is reported in the article. Updates will follow pending test results to determine infection source and any need for public health action.

article.articleHeadline: La Tunisie envoie une aide médicale en RDC pour soutenir la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tunisia sends medical aid to the DRC to support the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Tunisia shipped medicines and medical equipment to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to bolster its Ebola response, announced by the Tunisian Foreign Affairs Ministry. The aid, routed by a Tunisian military aircraft to Kinshasa International Airport, follows an African Union appeal urging member states to strengthen DRC's health capacity to fight Ebola. The World Health Organization notes the outbreak in the DRC remains uncontrolled, despite a slight national decline in infections, as transmission shifts geographically and edges toward an international border. Congolese health authorities reported 7,733 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,759 deaths as of Monday. International support for outbreak containment continues as the epidemic persists across borders.

article.articleHeadline: Број заражених еболом достигао 7.700
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola has reached 7,700.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 September 2026, Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo, reports an Ebola outbreak with 7,700 confirmed cases (up about 1,500 in the past month) and 3,759 total deaths, according to the National Institute for Public Health. In the last 24 hours, 40 new cases and 27 deaths were recorded, bringing the running total to 7,773 cases. The outbreak is attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or established treatment protocol. The report underscores ongoing transmission and the public health challenge posed by this strain in Kinshasa and the surrounding region. No additional details on the infection source or imported/exported cases are provided.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la RDC compte plus de 1 900 cas de guérison
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the DRC records more than 1,900 recoveries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows seven provinces and 63 health zones affected as of Sept 22, 2026. Ituri Province comprises Aru, Bunia, Damas, Drodro, Gety, Kilo, Komanda, Lita, Mambasa, Mangala, Mongbwalu, Nyankunde, Tchomia and others; North Kivu includes Beni, Goma, Katwa, Butembo, Oicha, Lubero, Mabalako and more; South Kivu is represented by Miti-Murhesa; Haut-Uele lists Boma Mangbetu, Dungu, Gombari, Isiro, Pawa, Rungu and Wamba; Bas-Uele includes Buta, Viadana and Ganga; Tshopo includes Bafwasende, Kabondo, Lubunga, Makiso-Kisangani, Mangobo, Wanie-Rukula and Tshopo; Sud-Ubangi includes Bulu. Cumulative confirmed cases total 7,773; patients in isolation or hospital 839; recoveries 1,935; deaths among confirmed 3,759; case fatality rate 48.4%; contact tracing completion 84.5%. The Matanda Ebola Treatment Center in Katwa and an ITAV laboratory in Butembo have opened, boosting capacity. Forty motorcycles were allocated to Musienene, Butembo, Katwa and Beni to support response teams. In Buta, Bas-Uele, 542 school principals were sensitized and 47 youth committee members trained for early detection ahead of the school year.

article.articleHeadline: 国庆中秋双假将至，长沙疾控提醒：重点关注这三类传染病防控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival holidays approach, Changsha CDC reminds: focus on the prevention and control of these three categories of infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: During the National Day and Mid-Autumn holidays, Changsha City CDC urges focus on three infectious-disease categories as travel and gatherings rise. Mosquito-borne diseases: Dengue fever and Chikungunya fever, transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes. Dengue often presents with high fever, myalgia, abdominal symptoms and possible bleeding; Chikungunya with moderate fever and prominent small-joint pains. Prevention centers on avoiding bites (long clothing, air-conditioned or screened lodging, DEET or pyrethroid repellents, bed nets) and vector control (remove standing water, refresh water in potted plants every 3–5 days, cover water containers). Enteric diseases: Hand-foot-mouth disease and norovirus gastroenteritis, spread via fecal-oral contact and close contact; symptoms include rash on hands/feet/mouth and vomiting/diarrhea. Prevention emphasizes handwashing for 20 seconds, safe cooked food, regular cleaning and ventilation, and use of chlorine-based disinfectants for contaminated surfaces; use PPE when handling vomitus or excreta. Respiratory infections: Influenza and RSV, spread through droplets and contact; symptoms include fever, sore throat, cough. Vaccination is encouraged (influenza and pneumonia vaccines); Changsha began the new flu season vaccination in September with a target by end of October; mask use and prompt medical care when symptomatic are advised.

article.articleHeadline: Supaul News: सुपौल : ग्रामीण चिकित्सकों को मिला संक्रामक रोगों की रोकथाम का प्रशिक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Supaul News: Supaul: Rural Doctors Receive Training in the Prevention of Infectious Diseases.
article.articleSummary: On 23 September 2026, Ragho Pur Referral Hospital in Supaul organized a one-day training for rural doctors on identifying, preventing, and promptly reporting infectious diseases. Dozens of rural physicians from across Supaul district attended. The program aimed to equip participants to recognize early symptoms at the local level and relay information to the health department quickly to curb disease spread. Trainer Sumir Kumar Singh outlined identifying early signs, reporting suspected cases, and urgently referring severe patients to the nearest government hospital; BVDS Sanjit Kumar Singh noted that timely detection and reporting substantially aid containment. Emphasized warning signs such as fever, cough, breathing difficulty, skin rashes, and specifically kala-azar (visceral leishmaniasis) and filariasis. Emphasis on personal hygiene, safe drinking water, handwashing, and community education, including awareness about both infectious and non-communicable diseases. Officials and many rural doctors attended, urged to implement measures locally and report suspected cases without delay.

triage.headline_ja: スパウルニュース：スパウルで農村医師向けに感染症予防に関する研修が実施される
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生・アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、農村医師向けの感染症予防研修に関する記事であり、緊急のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の疾病発生報告ではなく、カラアザール（内臓リーシュマニア症）やフィラリア症などを含む感染症の早期発見・報告に関する研修プログラムの実施報告である。特定の患者数やアウトブレイクの記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Chhattisgarh: 11-km trek takes health team to remote Dantewada village, four critical cases detected
article.articleSummary: An 11-km trek through Bailadila hills to Lohagaon, a remote village in Kuakonda block, Chhattisgarh's Bastar district, screened 62 residents, detecting four urgent cases: a pregnant woman, a cataract patient, and two malaria-positive individuals. The health camp also screened for malaria and sickle cell disease, and flagged suspected cataract and leprosy cases. Antenatal check-ups and children’s vaccinations were provided. This was the village’s first comprehensive health screening camp, reducing the need to travel to facilities. Conducted under the Mukhyamantri Swasth Bastar campaign, the district has 76 health points to extend services to remote settlements. The visit highlights persistent access barriers in Bastar’s interior, where service delivery depends on physical reach, not just facility availability, and emphasizes the need for timely referrals for high-risk patients.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティースガル州:健康チームが11km徒歩でダンテワダの遠隔地村へ、4件の重症例を発見
triage.triage_reason: 単一の地方村落における通常の医療キャンプでの疾患スクリーニング活動であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド・チャッティースガル州の遠隔村落における日常的な保健医療アクセス改善活動（Mukhyamantri Swasth Bastar campaign）の一環であり、マラリア・ハンセン病等の既知の地方病に対する通常のスクリーニング結果報告。アウトブレイクや異常な感染拡大の報告ではないため、対象国リストにあるインドであっても地域検証上、感染症危機シグナルとしての特筆性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 46 người nhập viện sau ăn bánh mì: Nhiều mẫu thực phẩm dương tính Salmonella spp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 46 people hospitalized after eating bread: Many food samples test positive for Salmonella spp.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella outbreak linked to bread prompts 46 hospitalizations in Quảng Trị, Vietnam. Pasteur Institute Nha Trang tested 11 food samples, with 9 positive for Salmonella spp.; items included beef sausage, chả cá, vegetables, braised meat, pickles, cucumber, bread, sandwiches, and drinking water. Of 13 patient specimens, 11 contained Salmonella spp., with one sample also yielding Staphylococcus aureus. Quảng Trị’s Food Safety Department notes Salmonella is a common cause of acute gastroenteritis, presenting with diarrhea, abdominal pain, fever, nausea, vomiting and dehydration, and can cause complications if untreated. Investigators have forwarded findings to Cam Lộ Commune authorities to clarify links between the foods and illnesses. The outbreak began mid-September after bread consumption at a local food establishment in Cam Lộ, affecting residents of Cam Chinh and Cam Nghia in Cam Lo district. By 22 September, the 46 hospitalized patients were stable and discharged; the business remains suspended pending investigation.

triage.headline_ja: 46人がパンを食べた後に入院：多くの食品サンプルからサルモネラ属菌陽性
triage.triage_reason: 単一の食品関連サルモネラ食中毒事例であり、患者は安定・退院済みで、国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクは認められない。地域限定の一過性事案。
triage.notes: 地方の食品安全部門が調査済みで、事業者は営業停止中。患者は全員回復・退院しており、感染症としてのヒト-ヒト感染リスクは低い（食中毒事例）。疾患名にTyphoid/Paratyphoidとあるが記事内容はSalmonella spp.による食中毒であり分類に齟齬あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 7 773 cas confirmés et 3 759 décès
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths to date, with 1,935 recoveries and 839 patients in isolation or hospitalized as of September 23, 2026. In the last 24 hours, 33 recoveries were recorded (17 in North Kivu, 12 in Ituri, 4 in Haut-Uele). The response spans seven provinces and 63 health zones, with 84.5% contact tracing and strengthened medical care in the hardest-hit North Kivu. A Matanda Ebola Treatment Center in Katwa has opened, and care capacity in Butembo has been reinforced. In Bas-Uele, prevention and early detection are being intensified: 542 school authorities have been sensitized, and youth actors trained to recognize symptoms ahead of school reopening. Citizens can report suspected cases via toll-free 151.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：確定症例7,773件、死者3,759人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC全土7州・63保健地区に拡大し、致死率約48%と極めて深刻。人-人感染のリスクが高く、国際的拡大・支援の必要性も懸念されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 累計症例数・死者数から見て大規模かつ継続中のエボラアウトブレイクであり、既にWHO等の国際監視下にあると推測されるが、越境拡大や渡航制限の有無については記事中に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Tăng cường phòng, chống bệnh truyền nhiễm cho trẻ em
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strengthening the prevention and control of infectious diseases for children.
article.articleSummary: As schools reopen, families and educators intensify preventive measures against infectious diseases, notably hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD). In Cam Đường, Bình Minh campus, pre-schoolers are taught daily hygiene, with classrooms cleaned, surfaces sanitized, and good ventilation prioritized. Parents screen children for fever or mouth ulcers before attendance and model handwashing with soap, avoiding mouth contact with objects. HFMD, caused by an enterovirus, presents with fever and sore throat; 1–2 days later, painful mouth ulcers and vesicles on hands, feet, and in the mouth may appear; some cases have oral lesions only. Dr. Dang Thi Quynh of Lao Cai Regional Health Center–Cam Đường notes the importance of “3 sạch” — eating clean, living clean, and hands clean — to limit transmission. The province issued guidance to boost surveillance for polio, HFMD, dengue, influenza, measles, and meningococcal meningitis; education and health sectors mandate clean environments and early reporting, with vaccination catch-up where needed.

triage.headline_ja: 子どもの感染症予防・対策の強化
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病を中心とした学校・家庭での日常的な予防啓発活動を伝える内容であり、異常な流行や重症例の報告はなく、通常の予防的行政対応の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 記事はラオカイ省における学校再開に伴う手足口病等の感染症予防啓発活動を伝えるもので、具体的な感染者数や異常な流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: 安特羅腸病毒71型疫苗前進泰國　瞄準300萬嬰幼兒自費公費標案市場
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus 71 vaccine advances into Thailand, targeting a market of 3 million infants and young children for self-pay and government-funded tenders.
article.articleSummary: Enterovirus 71 vaccine advances into Thailand with exclusive distribution by Biogenetech to reach about 3 million Thai infants and young children through self-pay and government tender channels. Antro Biotech, developer of the EV71 vaccine, filed a new drug application with the Thai FDA in August 2025, seeking rapid regulatory approval and market entry. Thailand’s Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease activity shows 94,670 cases from January to September 2025, with EV71 detected in 18–19% of tested samples, meaning roughly one in five HFMD patients carries EV71 and risking severe disease with occasional fatalities. The 0–4 years age group numbers about 2.64 million, with around 400,000 new births annually, indicating strong demand for both private and public vaccinations. Biogenetech’s nationwide cold-chain network and public-tender experience underpin projected rapid market penetration; its rabies vaccine already commands over 30% local share.

triage.headline_ja: エンテロウイルス71型ワクチン、タイ市場に参入―乳幼児300万人を対象に自費・公費の入札を狙う
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はEV71ワクチンの商業的市場参入に関するビジネスニュースであり、HFMD/EV71の流行statisticsは例年の季節性パターンの説明にとどまり、異常な公衆衛生事態としての報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事は製薬会社によるEV71ワクチンのタイ市場参入・入札戦略に関する商業ニュース。HFMD/EV71の症例数（94,670件、EV71陽性率18-19%）は例年の流行状況の背景説明であり、突発的な異常事態としての記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Broj zaraženih ebolom dostigao 7.700
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola has reached 7,700.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 September 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 7,700 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths, per the National Institute for Public Health in Kinshasa. In the last 24 hours, 40 new cases and 27 deaths were reported, bringing the total to 7,773 cases. The current outbreak is caused by the Ebola strain budibungio, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment protocol at this time. The report provides counts but does not detail onset dates, clinical symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. Updates are issued by the National Institute for Public Health and shared through official channels, including Facebook, Instagram, and X.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者数、7,700人に達する
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染者7,700人・死者3,759人に達し、致死率が高く、ワクチン・治療法未承認の新規株による大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 新規株（budibungio）による大規模アウトブレイクで、致死率が約48%と高く、ワクチン・治療法が未承認である点が重大なリスク要因。詳細な発症日、臨床症状、感染源、越境事例等の情報は不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans la Tshopo : 68 jours sans notification de cas confirmés à Lubunga - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: 68 days without any reported confirmed cases in Lubunga - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 23 September 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in DR Congo’s Tshopo Province has 42 cumulative cases across seven health zones affecting 24 health areas. Active cases total 11, with 9 confirmed and 2 suspected. Three new cases were admitted to the Ebola Treatment Center, including one death. Post-exposure prophylaxis is provided to 162 people. Bed occupancy is 81% for confirmed and 10% for suspected cases. Lubunga health zone has recorded 68 consecutive days without a new case; Wanierukula 54 days; and the Tshopo zone 39 days. In other affected zones, the interval since the last notification is under five days, indicating ongoing transmission and continued reinforced surveillance. The outbreak’s epicenter remains Bafwasende territory, bordering Nia-Nia in Ituri Province, with cross-border risk noted.

triage.headline_ja: トショポ州のエボラ：ルブンガで確定例通知なし68日間 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCトショポ州でエボラ出血熱の感染が継続中（累計42例、アクティブ11例、死亡発生）であり、イトゥリ州との境界地域で越境リスクが指摘されているため、公衆衛生上重大な進行中アウトブレイクとしてフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラアウトブレイクの経過報告記事。一部保健地区では新規例なしが続く一方、他の地区では5日未満での新規通知が続き、感染継続中。バフワセンデ地区がエピセンターでイトゥリ州との境界に近接し越境リスクが明記されている。既存アウトブレイクの継続としてWHOには既に報告済みの可能性が高いが、感染拡大・死亡発生の観点からフルRRAでの状況確認を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: ভয় ধরাচ্ছে ডেঙ্গি! জ্বর নেই, তবু দুর্বলতা কাটছে না? কেন ৪-৬ দিনই ডেঙ্গির সবচেয়ে বিপজ্জনক সময়? যা বলছেন চিকিৎসক
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue is frightening! No fever, yet weakness persists? Why is the 4-6 day period the most dangerous time for dengue? What doctors are saying.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Kolkata, India, is rising amid monsoon heat with DENV-1 to DENV-4 circulating; DENV-2 and DENV-4 are linked to more severe disease, and some patients show co-infections with multiple serotypes. ICMR reports all four serotypes spreading in some states. The illness can involve multiple organs, including hepatitis, myocarditis, and nervous system effects, necessitating regular monitoring. A critical phase typically occurs around days 4–6 after fever onset, during which hemoconcentration may occur and the immune response intensifies; IgM and IgG antibodies become detectable as fever subsides. Platelet counts begin to drop around day 4, with transfusion required if they fall below 10,000/μL. Management is primarily supportive: fever control, dehydration prevention, adequate fluid intake, urine output monitoring, and serial labs of hematopoietic parameters and liver function. Remarks by Dr. Dipankar Sarkar, Senior Consultant Internal Medicine and Critical Care, Manipal Hospital, Salt Lake, underscore the need for continuous observation.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱は恐ろしい！熱はないのに、なぜ倦怠感が続くのか？デング熱で最も危険な時期はなぜ4〜6日目なのか？医師が解説
triage.triage_reason: デング熱に関する一般的な医療情報・啓発記事であり、新規のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: インドの季節性デング熱に関する疫学・臨床解説記事であり、医師のインタビューを中心とした健康教育コンテンツ。新規発生や異常な増加を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en República del Congo ya suma más de 3.750 fallecidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Republic of the Congo now totals more than 3,750 deaths.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached about 7,800 confirmed cases and more than 3,750 deaths as of September 23, 2026, with 1,935 recoveries. The latest bulletin lists 7,773 cases and 3,759 deaths, a case fatality rate of 48.4%, and 84.5% contact follow-up. The eastern outbreak, declared in mid-May, is the deadliest in the country's history. Cases are reported across seven provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uélé (Upper Uele), Bas-Uele (Lower Uele), and Ubangi—affecting 63 of 167 health zones. The DRC is the most experienced Ebola-responding nation, having faced more than a dozen outbreaks since 1976. A Kasai outbreak ended in December 2025. Ebola was first identified in 1976 near Yambuku on the Ebola River, which gave the disease its name.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行、死者3,750人以上に
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ流行（約7,800症例、致死率48.4%）が7州に拡大しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるため。
triage.notes: 見出しでは『Republic of the Congo』とあるが、記事本文・サマリーの内容は一貫してDemocratic Republic of the Congo（コンゴ民主共和国）に関するもの。同国史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で、致死率48.4%、7州63保健地区に拡大中。

article.articleHeadline: CHDC Congo thử nghiệm vắc xin phòng bệnh Ebola trên diện rộng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo conducts a large-scale Ebola vaccine trial.
article.articleSummary: Large-scale Ebola vaccine trial under way in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province, centered in Bunia, with frontline health workers prioritized. The World Health Organization allocated 20,000 Ervebo doses for a research program to evaluate protection against the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, while the outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo; about 50,000 health workers and frontline personnel in Ituri and North Kivu are slated to receive Ervebo to protect against Ebola Zaire. Vaccination began on 19 September 2026 in Bunia; 20,000 participants will be followed for up to one year. In total, 70,000 vaccine doses have been delivered to Congolese authorities for response and research. Since May, Congo has reported at least 7,541 cases and 3,639 deaths, with 1,823 recovered. The WHO Africa region notes higher pediatric mortality, with children under 5 causing about 60% of deaths though they are ~25% of cases; ALIMA reports pediatric care challenges, and survivors are mobilized as frontline; parental consent for new Bundibugyo therapies is sought.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラワクチンの大規模試験を実施
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（7,541例、死亡3,639例）に対する大規模ワクチン接種計画であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心・支援ニーズも高い。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模エボラ流行（Bundibugyo種およびZaire種混在）に対するWHO主導のワクチン接種・研究プログラムに関する続報。小児死亡率の高さ（死亡の約60%が5歳未満）が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS ve "primeros signos alentadores de progreso" en lucha contra el ébola el Congo; nuevos casos han disminuido
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO sees "early encouraging signs of progress" in the fight against Ebola in Congo; new cases have declined.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization reports early encouraging signs in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with new cases down in Ituri (-26%) and Haut-Uélé (-15%) between Aug 31 and Sep 20, but up 73% in North Kivu, showing varied transmission across seven provinces: Ituri, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, South Kivu, and Ubangi del Sur. As of Sep 21, 2026, the epidemic totals 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths; recoveries number 1,935, with 839 hospitalized or in isolation; case fatality rate 48.4%. The outbreak began May 15 in eastern DRC and affects 63 health zones across seven provinces. It is described as the second deadliest and most contagious Ebola outbreak globally, after the 2014–2016 West Africa crisis (roughly 11,000 deaths and 28,000 cases). Challenges include staffing, decentralizing the response, detecting in young children, and reducing community deaths; authorities expect further declines in coming weeks.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱対策に「初期の明るい兆し」；新規症例数が減少
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは、確定症例7,773例・死亡3,759例（致死率48.4%）に達し、7州63保健地区に拡大する史上2番目に深刻な流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 既に大規模な既知アウトブレイクであり、フルRRA継続監視対象として妥当。北キブ州で症例が73%増加している点は今後の悪化リスクとして注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola : en RD-Congo, une expérience est en cours sur l'efficacité du seul vaccin disponible
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: in the DRC, an ongoing trial assessing the effectiveness of the only vaccine available.
article.articleSummary: An ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is being addressed with a frontline vaccination effort as part of a trial assessing the effectiveness of the only vaccine available. Volunteers, under tents set up in front of a laboratory, have received their doses, highlighting active public health mobilization to curb the outbreak. The article emphasizes on-the-ground vaccination actions and the ongoing evaluation of vaccine performance by researchers. Specific case or death counts are not provided in the excerpt. As of 2026-09-23, this vaccination trial represents the central response strategy to protect those at risk in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：コンゴ民主共和国で唯一利用可能なワクチンの有効性に関する試験が進行中
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準上重篤な公衆衛生事象であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクが高く、ワクチン接種対応が行われていることから社会的関心も高いと判断される。
triage.notes: 症例数・死亡者数は記事に記載なし。ワクチン試験の詳細な進捗や感染規模については続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Veterinarians Urge Livestock Owners To Remain Vigilant About Lumpy Skin Disease Symptoms, Ensure Vaccination
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) is affecting livestock across Haryana, Punjab, Uttarakhand, and Uttar Pradesh, with Meerut reporting spread from Haryana to Uttarakhand and now reaching Meerut via Saharanpur. The viral disease lowers livestock blood levels and can be fatal. Meerut's Chief Veterinary Officer Pavitrajit Singh said vaccination drives are underway, with rural areas prioritized and vaccines provided free of cost. He emphasized vaccination as the best protection and urged owners to vaccinate when drives are in their area, and to motivate others. Do not vaccinate cows seven months pregnant or calves under four months. Additional measures include cleanliness, fogging, spraying to reduce insect breeding, and using mosquito nets around livestock to prevent transmission. The resurgence highlights vaccination, biosecurity, and community participation as critical controls as of 23 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 獣医師ら、家畜所有者にランピースキン病の症状への警戒とワクチン接種の確実な実施を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 動物感染症(LSD)がインド北部数州に拡大しているが、ヒトへの影響はなく公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。家畜産業への影響として経過観察対象とする。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病は牛などの家畜に感染するウイルス性疾患で、ヒトには感染しない。動物衛生・畜産業への影響として監視対象とするが、公衆衛生上のリスク評価(RRA)には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni: l'approche communautaire contre Ebola préconisée à Ruwenzori - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: The Community-Based Approach to Fighting Ebola Recommended in the Rwenzori Region - ACP
article.articleSummary: Nine confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases have been recorded in Mutwanga Health Zone, Beni Territory, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with three deaths over the past month. A new Congolese civil society group urges a community-based response, calling on village chiefs, health-center nurses, and local leaders to lead awareness efforts, and to use local languages to strengthen understanding and trust in the response. The approach emphasizes prevention: regular handwashing, avoiding contact with patients or suspects, and rapid clinic visits at first symptoms. The stance follows a Mwenda incident in Beni at the foot of Mount Ruwenzori, where a delegation accompanying the health-zone medical chief and the national police commander was pelted by residents; warning shots were fired and one resident with a shoulder injury evacuated to Beni. The group seeks unity during a security lull to bolster social cohesion and cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ市のエボラ：ルウェンゾリ地域でエボラ対策にコミュニティアプローチを推奨 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で確認済みエボラ症例9例・死亡3例が発生しており、致死性感染症のアウトブレイクかつヒト-ヒト感染リスクがあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準双方に該当する。
triage.notes: 住民による医療関係者への敵対行為（投石、発砲事案）が報告されており、対応活動への地域社会の抵抗・治安上の懸念も存在する。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：刚果（金）埃博拉疫情总体仍未得到控制
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains not under control overall.
article.articleSummary: WHO Africa Regional Office states on Sept 23, 2026 that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains not under control overall, though some areas show relief. Ituri Province and Haut-Uele Province have seen declines in cases (about 26% and 15% respectively from Aug 31 to Sept 20), while North Kivu Province records a sharp rise (about 73% increase), indicating divergent transmission. As of Sept 21, 2026, cumulative confirmed cases reach 7,773 with 3,759 deaths. Children under five are the highest-risk group, with case fatality over 60% versus roughly 40% in adults. Contact tracing coverage has risen to 88%, but many new infections lack clear epidemiological links, highlighting ongoing surveillance gaps and challenging outbreak control in the region.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、全体として依然として制御下にない
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続中で、致死率が高く、地域によって感染拡大が続いており、疫学的リンク不明の新規感染も多く発生している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 累計確認症例7,773例、死亡3,759例。5歳未満の致死率60%超。北キブ州で症例数73%増加と急拡大が見られる一方、他州では減少傾向であり、地域差の大きい継続中の大規模流行。

article.articleHeadline: YouTuber'ı ısıran yarasa viral oldu: Yarasalar ne kadar tehlikeli?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The bat that bit the YouTuber went viral: How dangerous are bats?
article.articleSummary: Harun Köybaşı, a YouTuber known for wildlife videos, was bitten by a bat, fueling discussion about bats as carriers of dangerous pathogens. Bats can host viruses causing serious human disease, but not every bite transmits infection. The WHO classifies direct bat exposure as Category III, the highest rabies risk; immediate wound washing with soap and water for 15 minutes and prompt medical care are advised. Post-exposure treatment may include rabies vaccine with immunoglobulin or monoclonal antibodies, depending on exposure. In Indonesia, Bali shows ongoing rabies risk: 2026 January–August exposures stood at 45,365 with 7 rabies deaths; lyssavirus has been detected in Bali bats. February 2026 veterinary surveillance noted a bat rabies case in the country. Historically, human rabies in Indonesia is attributed to dog bites, though bat involvement may be underreported. In Turkey, there is no documented bat-to-human rabies transmission; a 2013–2023 study found no bat rabies cases there.

triage.headline_ja: YouTuberを噛んだコウモリが話題に：コウモリはどれほど危険か？
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はトルコでのYouTuber個人のコウモリ咬傷エピソードだが、インドネシア・バリ州における継続的な狂犬病曝露（2026年1-8月で45,365件、死亡7件）とコウモリからのリッサウイルス検出に言及があり、公衆衛生上の懸念材料として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はトルコでの個人的なコウモリ咬傷エピソードであり、狂犬病の新規アウトブレイクではない。ただしバリ州の狂犬病曝露・死亡数データは既知の風土病状況として継続監視の価値あり。トルコではコウモリから人への狂犬病感染事例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak toll exceeds 3,700 deaths
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak toll exceeds 3,700 deaths. As of 2026-09-23, after ~130 days, WHO reports uneven progress across seven affected provinces, notably Ituri, Haut-Uele and North Kivu. In the last 21 days, cases declined ~26% in Ituri and 15% in Haut-Uele, but rose 73% in North Kivu, indicating divergent transmission. About one in three new infections are identified only after the patient dies in the community, increasing transmission risk and delaying care. Children under five have the highest case fatality rate, >60% vs ~40% in adults, complicating detection. Contact tracing is ~88% efficient; response capacity includes ~1,400 treatment/isolation beds in 49 Ebola treatment centers and 25 laboratories capable of 2,500 tests daily. Efforts are shifting to decentralize to rural villages to close surveillance gaps and speed early treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、死者数が3,700人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7州にまたがる大規模エボラ流行が継続中で死者3,700人超、地域により感染拡大が悪化しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクもあるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 北キブ州で症例が73%増加するなど地域差が大きく、コミュニティ内死亡後に発見される症例が約3分の1に上るなどサーベイランスの課題が継続している。WHOによる公式リスク評価との照合が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Superflu Mengancam, Dinkes Mojokerto Langsung Siagakan 27 Fasyankes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be On Alert: Superflu Threat Looms as Mojokerto Health Office Mobilizes 27 Health Facilities
article.articleSummary: As of 23 September 2026, Mojokerto Regency Health Office in East Java mobilized 27 health service facilities (Fasyankes) to preempt potential spread of a superflu—Influenza A (H3N2) Subclade K. Although no confirmed cases have been reported, Acute Respiratory Infections (ISPA) have risen, with week 37 data showing an increase of 461 cases, linked to hot, dusty weather. Cumulative ISPA cases in 2026 total 3,885. The Dinkes notes that reports from puskesmas (community health centers) and RSUD Prof. Dr. Soekandar Mojosari have not identified the superflu, and no Influenza A reports have been issued by East Java Province or the Ministry of Health. To prevent spread, facilities are urged to actively monitor patients and report any signs resembling COVID-19 promptly; swift, proactive management will be undertaken if indications of a COVID-19–like virus are detected.

triage.headline_ja: スーパーフルの脅威に警戒、モジョケルト保健局が27の医療施設に即時態勢を指示
triage.triage_reason: H3N2サブクレードKという新興インフルエンザ株への警戒から地元保健当局が予防的態勢を敷いているが、確定症例は報告されておらず、州・国レベルでの報告もないため、情報不足として経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 確定症例は未報告で、ISPA増加は暑さ・埃が原因とされている。インフルエンザA(H3N2)新規サブクレードへの予防的警戒段階であり、続報の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Animais testam positivo para raiva e 139 propriedades rurais de MT serão notificadas; entenda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Animals test positive for rabies, and 139 rural properties in Mato Grosso will be notified; find out more.
article.articleSummary: Five cattle on a rural property in Gleba Rio Vermelho, Rondonópolis, Mato Grosso, tested positive for rabies, confirmed by lab analysis after a private veterinarian collected samples. Indea-MT will notify 139 properties in the region to conduct vaccination and strengthen herd protection. Rabies, caused by a Lyssavirus of the Rhabdoviridae family, is a severe central nervous system disease in mammals that is almost always fatal if untreated. Transmission occurs primarily through bites with virus present in saliva, and bats are common reservoirs. In livestock, signs include difficulty walking, excessive salivation, and behavioral changes, while human risk arises from contact with saliva via bites, scratches, or licking. The incubation period ranges from days to years, averaging about 45 days in humans; infected animals may shed virus before symptoms, with death typically 5–7 days after onset. Vaccination of neighboring properties is being urged to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 動物が狂犬病陽性反応、マトグロッソ州の農村地139カ所に通知へ
triage.triage_reason: 家畜（牛5頭）の狂犬病確認事例で、周辺農場への通知・ワクチン接種強化が行われているが、ヒト感染例や広域拡大の情報はなく、地域的な家畜衛生対応に留まる。
triage.notes: 家畜（牛）における狂犬病確認事例であり、ヒトへの感染は報告されていない。地方獣医当局（Indea-MT）が主体的に対応しており、国際的な関心事項ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo is running short of health workers as Ebola remains out of control, WHO says - WTOP News
article.articleSummary: DR Congo is contending with its fastest-growing Ebola outbreak, reporting 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths across seven provinces, with North Kivu showing a 73% rise in three weeks. Ituri, historically the epicenter, has declines (Ituri down 26% and Haut-Uele down 15% Aug. 31–Sept. 20), but transmission remains widespread and the outbreak is not under control. Insecurity, displacement, a health workers’ strike, and population movements hamper the response. Ebola treatment centers are expanding, yet staffing shortages persist; one center requires about 300 health professionals. Payroll arrears underscore frontline grievances. Children under five have the highest case-fatality rate—over 60%—and detecting illness in this group is challenging. WHO notes progress in some areas but continues to warn that cases rise in others and the outbreak may surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa death toll.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが制御不能な状況が続く中、医療従事者不足が深刻化 - WHOが指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大しており（7,773例、死亡3,759人）、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、対応能力の限界が明確に確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストになく、記事本文でもDRC国内の状況が主題であるため除外。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行の死者数を超える可能性があるとWHOが警告しており、深刻度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Phase II Clinical Trial of NV-387 as a Treatment for Monkeypox (MPox) Has Begun in DRC, Announces NanoViricides
article.articleSummary: Phase II clinical trial of NV-387 for mpox has begun in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with first patients enrolled in Lodja, Sankuru province. The adaptive, international, multi-center Phase II (IIa/IIb) trial compares NV-387 formulated as oral gummies against standard care in patients with clinical mpox signs and lab-confirmed or presumptive HMPXV infection. Trial registration: Pan African Clinical Trials Registry (PACTR202609506749917). Principal Investigator: Prof. Vivi Maketa Tevuzula, University of Kinshasa/IMABE. No approved mpox drug exists; Tecovirimat previously failed to demonstrate efficacy; a separate MOSA Brincidofovir trial is ongoing in Africa. Mpox Clade I is endemic in DRC; Clade II is present in the USA with travel-associated cases. NV-387 seeks FDA Orphan Drug Designation, potentially unlocking regulatory and economic benefits if approved.

triage.headline_ja: NanoViricides社、DRCでサル痘（Mpox）治療薬NV-387の第II相臨床試験を開始と発表
triage.triage_reason: 既知の流行病（Mpox Clade I）に対する治療薬の臨床試験開始に関する記事であり、新規の公衆衛生上の異常事態ではないが、Mpox Clade Iの流行状況として継続監視が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事は治療薬の臨床試験開始に関する内容で、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。DRCにおけるMpox Clade I流行は既知の継続事案。

article.articleHeadline: 印尼山火致17万人呼吸道感染 濒危婆罗洲猩猩缺氧丧生 | e南洋
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesian wildfires trigger respiratory tract infections in 170,000 people; endangered Bornean orangutans die from hypoxia.
article.articleSummary: Wildfire smoke in Indonesia has triggered widespread respiratory tract infections, with about 170,000 people affected nationwide and 4,533 active cases, most of whom have recovered. Since January, roughly 90,000 hectares have burned, and the country logged around 734,000 fire hotspots—about 30% more than during the 2019 severe season. Experts attribute the surge to an unprecedented El Niño-driven drought. Smoke also degraded air quality in neighboring Malaysia, Singapore, and parts of the Philippines. In wildlife news, several critically endangered Bornean orangutans are reported to have severe respiratory illness from smoke exposure; one in West Kalimantan suffocated by hypoxia after rescue attempts. Indonesian authorities have mobilized over 54,000 rescuers and deployed dozens of aircraft for aerial water–bombing. Oxygen concentrators and masks are dispatched; authorities advised remote schooling in affected areas to limit children's exposure.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの山火事により17万人が呼吸器感染、絶滅危惧種のボルネオオランウータンが酸欠死
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは山火事の煙による非感染性の呼吸器疾患であり、病原体によるヒト-ヒト感染ではないためEBSが対象とする感染症シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 呼吸器症状は病原体感染ではなく山火事の煙（大気汚染）が原因であり、感染症サーベイランスの対象外と判断。マレーシア・シンガポール・フィリピンは大気質悪化の影響を受けているのみで、疾患発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: 世衛組織：剛果（金）埃博拉疫情總體仍未得到控制 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains not under control - Hong Kong Commercial Daily
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains not under control, per WHO Africa Region. As of Sept 21, 2026, cumulative confirmed cases reach 7,773 with 3,759 deaths. From Aug 31 to Sept 20, Ituri Province and Upper Uele Province reported declines of about 26% and 15%, respectively, while North Kivu Province saw a 73% surge, signaling divergent transmission dynamics across regions. Children aged five and under are a high-risk group, with case fatality rates exceeding 60% versus about 40% in adults. Local contact tracing coverage has risen to 88%, but many new infections lack clear epidemiological links, indicating ongoing surveillance gaps and challenges in outbreak containment.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ出血熱流行は依然として制御下にない
triage.triage_reason: WHOがDRCのエボラ流行を「制御下にない」と明言し、累計7,773例・死亡3,759例、致死率60%超（5歳以下）で北キブ州では73%の急増が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 地域内で感染動向に差異（イトゥリ州・オートウエレ州は減少傾向、北キブ州は急増）があり、接触者追跡率は88%まで向上したものの、疫学的リンク不明の新規感染が多く監視体制の課題が残る。

article.articleHeadline: 18 Kasus Influenza A Terdeteksi di DIY, Dinkes Sebut ISPA Justru Menurun
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 18 Influenza A Cases Detected in the Special Region of Yogyakarta (DIY), Health Office Says URTIs Have Actually Declined.
article.articleSummary: 18 cases of Influenza A have been detected in the Special Region of Yogyakarta (DIY) as of 23 September 2026, while Acute Respiratory Infection (ARI) cases across DIY facilities show a four-week decline. Surveillance is conducted via sentinel sites for Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) and Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI); testing remains limited. Influenza A is described as a year-round seasonal virus in Indonesia, with symptoms typically including fever, cough, and sore throat; some groups may experience more severe illness. The circulating strain is Influenza A(H1N1)pdm09, a descendant of the 2009 pandemic. Preventive measures include vaccination, hygiene, mask usage when ill, cough etiquette, and regular handwashing, plus reducing contact with the sick. Health authorities plan intensified public education and a community webinar; experts advise vigilance without panic and emphasize mitigation for at-risk groups.}}{

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア特別州ジョグジャカルタで18件のインフルエンザA感染確認、保健局はARI（急性呼吸器感染症）は実は減少傾向と発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)pdm09による通常規模の発生であり、ARIは減少傾向にある。異常性・重症性・国際的拡大リスクのいずれも認められず、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: H1N1pdm09はインドネシアで季節性に周年循環するウイルスとされ、当局は教育活動強化とウェビナー開催を計画。パニックなしの警戒を専門家は推奨しているのみで、緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: एसकेएमसीएच में डॉक्टर समेत दो डेंगू संक्रमित, परिसर में फागिंग न होने से बढ़ा खतरा - skmch dengue cases fogging crisis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two dengue-positive cases, including a doctor, at SKMCH; risk increased due to lack of fogging on the premises - skmch dengue cases fogging crisis
article.articleSummary: Two dengue-positive cases confirmed at Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital (SKMCH) in Muzaffarpur after antigen testing, including a doctor and a female patient, triggering fear among clinicians, students, and nursing staff. The hospital campus is plagued by garbage, waterlogging, and overgrown vegetation that boost mosquito breeding. Despite the presence of fogging machines for two years, no fogging has been carried out on the premises, signaling administrative neglect. District health authorities report 31 dengue cases in Muzaffarpur, with Mushahari block accounting for 16 cases; Bochahan and Kanti each report 2; Meenapur 3; Motipur 1; others scattered. Dengue wards have been established at SKMCH and Sadar Hospital, with mosquito nets on every bed and ongoing patient monitoring. Urgent calls for comprehensive fogging, larvicidal spraying, and vegetation clearance aim to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: SKMCHで医師を含む2人がデング熱に感染、構内の防疫(フォギング)未実施でリスク増大
triage.triage_reason: ビハール州ムザファルプル県で季節性デング熱の局地的な症例増加が報告されているが、重症度や国際的拡大の情報はなく、地方レベルの公衆衛生管理課題にとどまる。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド・ビハール州で毎年季節的に発生する感染症であり、今回の報告は地域内での媒介蚊対策の不備（フォギング未実施、環境衛生問題）を指摘する内容。31例という規模は地域の公衆衛生上の懸念だが、IHR通報基準には該当しない。ネパール・バングラデシュは発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事本文はインド・ムザファルプルに限定されているため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Miguel Leão promove ação educativa sobre hanseníase
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Miguel Leão promotes an educational campaign about leprosy.
article.articleSummary: On September 22, 2026, Miguel Leão's Municipal Health Secretariat conducted an educational campaign on leprosy (hanseníase) at a local school. The initiative, organized by the Prefeitura de Miguel Leão, aimed to raise awareness of the disease's signs and symptoms, and to stress the importance of seeking care and achieving early diagnosis. Attendees learned about appropriate treatment and the value of reliable information as part of health-education strategies. By bringing the topic into the school environment, the activity sought to expand students' knowledge and empower them to share accurate information with their families. The action is part of ongoing health-education efforts by the Municipal Health Secretariat, focusing on prevention, population guidance, and strengthening community care across different spaces.

triage.headline_ja: ミゲル・レアン市がハンセン病に関する啓発活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の教育啓発活動に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。記事は疾患の発生報告ではなく啓発活動の紹介である。

article.articleHeadline: Minister urges vigilance as dengue risk rises amid rains
article.articleSummary: Dengue, chikungunya and zika risk are rising in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, as intermittent rains create stagnant water conducive to Aedes breeding. Health minister K Muraleedharan urged vigilance; dengue symptoms include high fever, severe headache, body ache, skin rashes, vomiting and abdominal pain, with a call to seek medical attention promptly. Preventive measures emphasize dry days on Fridays at schools, Saturdays at workplaces, and Sundays at homes, and eliminating standing water in refrigerator trays, plant-water containers, discarded containers, coconut shells, tyres, and other receptacles. Water storage tanks and rooftops should be covered; terraces, sunshades and gutters cleared of stagnation. Use of light clothing, repellents and nets recommended while source-eliminating. On medicines, Kerala's procurement delays tied to elections and the Middle East war; KMSCL has placed orders for 664 of 855 essential medicines, with 530 delivered; 191 items pending; fresh tenders invited; Karunya scheme instructed for local procurement if shortages arise.

triage.headline_ja: 大臣、雨季でデング熱リスク上昇に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱リスク上昇に関する注意喚起であり、通常の予防的公衆衛生対応の範囲内だが、媒介蚊感染症の流行しやすさから経過観察が望ましい。
triage.notes: 季節性の雨季に伴う媒介蚊感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱）の予防的注意喚起記事。異常な流行拡大や重症例の報告はなく、通常の公衆衛生対応として位置づけられる。ケララ州の医薬品調達遅延にも触れられているが、感染症危機とは直接関連しない。

article.articleHeadline: Falta de personal sanitario en el Congo complica esfuerzos por controlar brote de ébola, dice la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shortage of health workers in the Congo complicates efforts to control the Ebola outbreak, WHO says.
article.articleSummary: Shortage of health workers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is hampering Ebola response, especially in North Kivu where cases have surged 73% in three weeks, according to the WHO. The outbreak’s epicenter remains Ituri and has spread to seven provinces, with 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths per government figures. From Aug 31 to Sep 20, cases fell 26% in Ituri and 15% in Haut-Uele, but transmission patterns vary and the outbreak remains uncontrolled across a wide area. Ongoing insecurity, displacement, a health worker strike, and large population movements fuel transmission. WHO warns the outbreak could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa crisis in deaths. Although new treatment beds are added, staff shortages persist; a single Ebola treatment center requires about 300 health professionals. Frontline workers have struck over pay arrears, with some owed; fatalities remain highest among children under five, where CFR exceeds 60% and case detection is challenging.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの医療従事者不足がエボラ流行対策を困難に、WHOが指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ感染者7,773人・死者3,759人と大規模で、複数州に拡大し封じ込めが困難な状況が続いており、WHOも2014-2016年の西アフリカ危機を超える可能性を警告している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事本文ではDRC（Ituri, Haut-Uele, North Kivu等）のみが言及されており、Angolaは主題として言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: CONGO: Reconciling Ebola response and community needs to prevent transmission
article.articleSummary: In Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, a delayed safe and dignified Ebola burial in Mutumbi (25 km from Bunia) sparked resistance as families rejected body bags, citing cultural rites. GOARN RCCE specialist Kennedy Muhindo Wema led an improvised community dialogue that produced a negotiated compromise after about an hour of talks, translating health protocols into culturally resonant practices and underscoring body bags’ role in preventing transmission. Deployed eight weeks across three affected areas, Wema strengthened feedback mechanisms, Rumours management, and helped establish two community watch brigades in Lita and Mangala, training ~30 members to report concerns and facilitate dialogue. The approach supported tracing an Ebola treatment centre escapee and conducting visits to dispel myths. GOARN deployments in DRC (about 10 deployments; nearly 400 partner institutions) aim to adapt interventions with communities, with replication extending to Beni, North-Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ対応とコミュニティのニーズの両立で感染拡大を防ぐ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱の対応が継続中であり、コミュニティの抵抗や遺体の埋葬拒否など感染拡大リスクが指摘されているため、WPRO基準に複数該当し社会的関心（WHO・GOARNの関与）も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedotが付与した地域情報にはルーマニアやオーストラリアなど無関係な地名が含まれているが、記事主題はDRC・イトゥリ州のエボラ対応に限定される。既知の進行中アウトブレイクに関するコミュニティ対応の記事であり、新規発生情報ではないが、感染継続・地域拡大リスクの観点からPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Cavalo testa positivo para raiva e 139 propriedades serão notificadas em MT - Diário News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Horse tests positive for rabies and 139 properties will be notified in MT - Diário News.
article.articleSummary: 23 September 2026 — A horse tested positive for rabies on a rural property near Rondonópolis, five km from the Gleba Rio Vermelho area, Mato Grosso, Brazil. The case was confirmed, prompting Indea-MT to initiate surveillance and outreach across 139 nearby rural properties within a 5 km radius. Producers are advised to reinforce vaccination and adopt protective measures. Rabies in herbivores is caused by a virus affecting the central nervous system, with Desmodus rotundus (vampire bat) as the main transmitter in Mato Grosso, transmitting via saliva during feeding. Signs include behavioral changes, isolation, ataxia, dysphagia, hypersalivation, hind limb paralysis, and collapse. Do not handle suspected animals; avoid contact with the mouths of animals with swallowing difficulties. Vaccination: a second dose 30 days after the first, then annual boosters. Report bat bites, roosts, or nervous signs to the Official Veterinary Service. Lab confirmation uses DFA, RT-PCR, or viral isolation.

triage.headline_ja: 馬が狂犬病陽性反応、マットグロッソ州で139農場に通知予定
triage.triage_reason: 動物（馬）における狂犬病単発例であり、ヒトへの感染や公衆衛生上の重大な影響は報告されていない。ブラジルの当該地域では吸血コウモリを介した家畜狂犬病は既知のリスクであり、異常性・国際的拡大の懸念も低い。
triage.notes: 本事例は動物衛生（獣医領域）の事案であり、ヒトの公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。地域の獣医当局（Indea-MT）が既に監視・対応を開始しており、外部支援の必要性も低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deja casi 7 mil 800 casos y más de 3 mil 750 muert...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola leaves nearly 7,800 cases and more than 3,750 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 7,773 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 3,759 deaths from the eastern outbreak, across seven provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and Ubangi Lower. Case fatality stands at 48.4%, with 1,935 recoveries. Epidemiologic surveillance indicates 84.5% of identified contacts have been monitored. Declared in May in the eastern region, the outbreak is among the most severe in the DRC’s history. The country has long experience with Ebola since its first identification in 1976, with Yambuku near the Ebola River as a historic focus. The current situation follows December 2025 the declaration of the end of a prior Kasai outbreak. Authorities maintain surveillance, contact tracing, and clinical care as new cases persist in affected zones, underscoring sustained vigilance against transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で約7,800症例、3,750人以上の死者
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最も深刻なエボラ流行の一つで、致死率48.4%、7province にまたがる大規模発生であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: DRC東部での大規模エボラ流行。7,773症例、3,759死亡、致死率48.4%と極めて深刻。7州にまたがり、接触者追跡カバー率84.5%と管理努力継続中だが新規症例が持続しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Мутировавшие штаммы "гонконгского" гриппа проникли в Россию
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mutated strains of Hong Kong flu have entered Russia.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 September 2026, mutated strains of the Hong Kong flu have entered Russia, with initial cases reported by the Mash Telegram channel. The primary concern is complications, including lower respiratory tract infections, pneumonia, and exacerbation of chronic diseases. Initial symptoms include high fever; however, some patients report cold-like illness with sore throat, runny nose, cough, dry mouth, and pronounced fatigue at normal temperature. Mash notes that the mutated virus previously circulated in countries of the Southern Hemisphere. The article provides no laboratory confirmation, official case counts, or verified infection source, and it does not specify imported or exported cases. No details are given about containment measures or public health responses. Verification and laboratory testing are needed to establish transmission dynamics and risk assessment.

triage.headline_ja: 変異した「香港型」インフルエンザ株がロシアに侵入
triage.triage_reason: 非公式のTelegramチャンネル情報のみで、公式な検査確認や症例数が示されておらず、情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア国内でのインフルエンザ変異株報告であり、対象国リストに該当する国（中国・香港含む）での発生は確認されていない。情報源は非公式のTelegramチャンネルであり、公式検査結果・症例数は未確認。

article.articleHeadline: Kapolda Jateng Tinjau Skrining dan Tracing TB di Puskesmas Adiwerna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Java Police Chief Inspects TB Screening and Tracing at Adiwerna Community Health Center
article.articleSummary: TB screening and contact tracing were showcased at Adiwerna Community Health Center in Tegal Regency, Central Java, on 23 September 2026, led by Central Java Police and local authorities. Active Case Finding (ACF) included sputum testing and free chest X-rays, with TB patients traced through Dokkes Polres Tegal and Bhabinkamtibmas noted for outreach. The initiative supports the TOSS TB program (Find, Treat Until Cure TB) to strengthen contact tracing, encourage early testing, adherence to treatment, and transmission prevention within families and communities. Gifts were distributed to 80 patients, and two Bhabinkamtibmas were recognized for top TB tracing. Data cited: 6,034 pulmonary TB cases in Tegal Regency, about 65% of whom have received treatment. The effort emphasizes ongoing screening, diagnosis, treatment, and family/community-level prevention through police-health collaboration and public outreach.

triage.headline_ja: 中部ジャワ州警察本部長、アディワルナ保健センターでのTBスクリーニング・トレーシングを視察
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムに関する通常の広報活動であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスクともに認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の結核対策プログラム（TOSS TB）の一環としての通常業務報告であり、感染症危機シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : les contrôles renforcés face à l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Tightened controls amid the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts tightened surveillance along major transport routes, waterways, and borders. At the Congo River port of Bende-Bende, the International Organization for Migration assists authorities with traveler screening, including temperature checks and health questionnaires, averaging about 1,000 screenings daily for entry toward Kinshasa. Suspected cases are directed to a sampling unit to determine if Ebola, another epidemic disease, or cholera. Declared in May 2026, the outbreak has surpassed 7,400 laboratory-confirmed cases with more than 3,600 deaths as of 16 September 2026, per the World Health Organization. The IOM is expanding surveillance in displacement areas and coordinating with neighboring countries—Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, and the Central African Republic—to limit cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ出血熱流行に伴い管理体制を強化
