triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、既に7,400例以上・死亡3,600人超と大規模かつ深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、越境拡大リスクへの対応が進行中のためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内（キンシャサ、コンゴ川沿いのBende-Bende港など）でのエボラ流行対応を主題としている。ウガンダ、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、南スーダン、中央アフリカ共和国は越境拡大防止のための連携相手として言及されているのみで、これらの国での実際の発生は述べられていないため対象外とした。コレラも鑑別対象として言及されているが、記事の主題はエボラ流行対応である。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya explode na Bahia e casos aumentam 364,9% em 2026; saiba como diferenciar da dengue e da zika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya surges in Bahia, cases rise 364.9% in 2026; learn how to differentiate it from Dengue and Zika.
article.articleSummary: Bahia, Brazil, as of September 15, 2026, reports 9,990 probable chikungunya cases, up 364.9% from 2025 (2,149), with 2 deaths. Dengue has 23,285 probable cases (down 16.5% from 27,894 in 2025) and 12 deaths; Zika records 260 cases (up 3.2% from 252). The chikungunya surge follows warmer temperatures linked to El Niño, boosting Aedes aegypti breeding; 201 municipalities have reported cases, 22 with incidence >100 per 100,000. Prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water in tires, bottles, caps, cans, and plant pots; sealing water tanks; maintaining pools; and reporting vacant lots. Dengue vaccination is publicly available for priority groups and privately for 4–60-year-olds, protecting against DEN-1 to DEN-4. Distinguishing symptoms: dengue—high fever, severe headache, myalgias; chikungunya—high fever with intense arthralgia; zika—low fever, rash. Sabin offers a six-virus PCR test (dengue, zika, chikungunya, oropouche, yellow fever, Mayaro) from day 1–5, at multiple sites and the VEM Sabin mobile unit.

triage.headline_ja: バイア州でチクングニア熱が急増、2026年の症例数が364.9%増加；デング熱・ジカ熱との違いを解説
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・バイア州でチクングニア熱の症例数が大幅増加しているが、国内の地域アウトブレイクであり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本イベントはブラジル・バイア州における蚊媒介性感染症（チクングニア、デング、ジカ）の症例動向報告であり、対象国リストにはブラジルが含まれるため記載。死亡例はあるが重症度は限定的で、El Niñoによる気候要因が媒介蚊の増殖を促進しているとされる。国内公衆衛生対応（ワクチン接種、防除活動）が既に行われており、外部支援の必要性は低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: NCDC, Nijerya'da KDC'deki Ebola salgını nedeniyle yüksek alarm ilan etti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: NCDC declared a high alert due to the Ebola outbreak in the KDC in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) declared a high alert in response to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). NCDC Director‑General Jide Idris said the latest developments are being closely monitored and that response measures will be adjusted according to outbreak trajectory and public‑health risk assessments. As part of heightened vigilance, travelers arriving from Ebola‑active countries must complete the Health Declaration Form; travelers from other countries are not currently required to do so. Nigerians are urged to stay vigilant and seek care promptly if they develop Ebola‑compatible symptoms, reporting travel or contact history to authorities. In the DRC, Ituri province's eastern region reported 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths before the outbreak was declared on May 15. By 19 September, the country had 7,672 confirmed cases and 3,699 deaths, per a 20 September update. The Bundibugyo Ebola variant has no approved treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: NCDC、コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)のエボラ流行を受けナイジェリアで高度警戒を宣言
triage.triage_reason: DRC(イトゥリ州)でエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が確認7,672例・死亡3,699例に達し、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認である重大な公衆衛生事案。ナイジェリアが越境リスクを警戒し渡航者への健康申告を義務化するなど国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクも顕在化しており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアの警戒対応を報じているが、感染症イベントの発生地はDRC(イトゥリ州)であるため、Nigeriaは対象国リストに含まれず除外した。致死率が高く（約48%）、ブンディブギョ変異株には承認された治療薬・ワクチンがない点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : deux nouveaux cas à Eringeti, le bilan monte à quatre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: two new cases in Eringeti, the tally rises to four.
article.articleSummary: Two new Ebola virus disease cases were reported on 23 September 2026 in Eringeti, North Kivu's Beni Territory, confirmed by the Eringeti Reference Health Center. The pair—a man and a woman—both died and are believed to have contracted the infection after attending a funeral. These cases bring Eringeti's total to four in less than a week, with three deaths and one patient currently under treatment at the Ebola Treatment Center in Beni. Eringeti lies in the Bambuba-Kisiki groupement of the Beni-Mbau sector. Medical officials note several suspected cases linked to the neighboring Ituri province, also affected by the outbreak, raising concerns about community transmission. Authorities urge residents to strengthen vigilance, follow prevention measures, and promptly report any person with suspected symptoms. The unfolding outbreak in Eringeti underscores ongoing risk of spread within the local community.

triage.headline_ja: ベニでのエボラ:エリンゲティで新たに2例、累計4例に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に複数該当する重大感染症であり、葬儀を介した感染拡大や隣接州への波及懸念があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 北キブ州ベニ地域エリンゲティでの感染拡大に加え、隣接するイトゥリ州でも疑い例が報告されており、地域を跨いだ感染拡大の懸念がある。致死率が高く（4例中3例死亡）、葬儀での感染連鎖が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Virus du sida: aux Fidji, face à l'explosion de cas de VIH, l'état d'urgence sanitaire nationale a été décrété
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV: In Fiji, amid a surge in HIV cases, the national health emergency has been declared.
article.articleSummary: Fiji declares a national health emergency amid a surge in HIV infections. In 2025, 2,016 new HIV cases were reported—sixteen times higher than 2019—bringing people living with HIV to about 9,100 (roughly 1 in 60 adults). Among pregnant women, about 2% are infected, and of 59 children born with HIV, 18 died before age one. Transmissions are over 50% sexual, with injecting drug use contributing more than 42% of known cases. Fiji, a 300+ island archipelago, sits on a drug transit route toward Australia and New Zealand. The government pledges free testing, prevention, and treatment, including rapid tests, PrEP for high-risk groups, harm-reduction for people who inject drugs, and free antiretroviral therapy. International support comes from Australia, New Zealand, India, and the Global Fund; ONUSIDA urges stronger regional cooperation. Globally, donor funding has declined, threatening efforts to end HIV/AIDS by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: HIV(エイズ)ウイルス：フィジーでHIV感染者が急増し、国家保健緊急事態が宣言される
triage.triage_reason: 2025年の新規HIV感染者数が2019年比16倍に急増し、国家保健緊急事態が宣言されるなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が確認され、国際支援も要請されているためフルリスク評価に進める。
triage.notes: 本イベントの発生地はフィジー（Republic of Fiji）であり、対象国リストに含まれていないためverified_locationsは空とした。インドはHIV対策支援国として言及されているのみで、感染事例の発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 世衛稱剛果民主共和國的伊波拉疫情總體仍未受控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control.
article.articleSummary: WHO Africa Region says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control, with some districts showing temporary relief but transmission intensifying in the eastern North Kivu province. Cumulative confirmed cases reach 7,773 with 3,759 deaths. From Aug 31 to Sep 20, Ituri and South Kivu reported declines of about 26% and 15% respectively, while North Kivu surged about 73%. Children under five are a high-risk group, with mortality above 60%, far higher than the roughly 40% observed in adults. Many new infections lack clear epidemiological links, signaling surveillance gaps and ongoing challenges in contact tracing and containment. The update highlights a heterogeneous outbreak dynamic in the DRC, with eastern provinces bearing the brunt despite localized improvements.

triage.headline_ja: 世衛、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情は依然として制御されていないと発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ流行が継続し、致死率が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大や国際的拡大リスクが懸念されるためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 北キブ州で感染拡大が加速し、5歳未満の致死率が60%超と極めて高い。疫学的リンク不明の新規感染例が多く、サーベイランス・接触者追跡の課題が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: EPS slams Vijay govt over dengue outbreak response
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu reports a dengue outbreak with 17,348 dengue cases and seven deaths as of Sept 21, 2026, per the state health department; 4,653 people tested positive for scrub typhus. AIADMK general secretary Edappadi K. Palaniswami criticizes Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay and Health Minister K. G. Arunraj for failing to mount a war-footing response, alleging the minister skipped dengue review meetings to attend bypoll campaigns. He urges decisive measures: ensure adequate medicine supply, deploy doctors to treat dengue patients, and organise dengue camps. Palaniswami contends the government is politicizing data from previous years rather than intensifying preventive action. The remarks come amid ongoing outbreak concerns in Tamil Nadu and reflect opposition pressure on outbreak management at the state level.

triage.headline_ja: EPS、デング熱アウトブレイク対応でヴィジャイ州政権を非難
triage.triage_reason: タミルナードゥ州で17,348例のデング熱（死亡7名）と4,653例のツツガムシ病が報告されており、政治的関心も高いため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心ありでフルRRAへの移行対象とする。
triage.notes: デング熱・ツツガムシ病はインドで季節性・風土病的に発生するが、症例数・死亡者数が多く、州政府の対応を巡る政治的批判が報道されている。記事は主に政治批判に焦点があり、公衆衛生上の異常性としての評価情報は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Inundaciones, hambre y enfermedades agravan sufrimiento en Myanmar en medio de la guerra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Floods, hunger and diseases worsen suffering in Myanmar amid the war.
article.articleSummary: Flooding from the monsoon since July worsens Myanmar’s war-driven humanitarian crisis. The World Health Organization reports floods affecting more than 470,000 people, with rising malaria, dengue, and cholera outbreaks. Nearly four million people are internally displaced, and access remains blocked by fighting and multiple checkpoints. In Shwebo, Sagaing Region, and central Magway, conflict disrupts aid delivery and inflates costs. The UN’s OCHA warns Myanmar is among the world’s gravest crises, with over 16 million in need and partners reaching about 1.6 million by March. Food prices have surged amid higher fuel and fertilizer costs linked to the Russia-Ukraine war and Iranian blockades of the Strait of Hormuz after US and Israel attacks. Skin infections such as scabies are common; the Ayeyarwady Delta’s crops are threatened as harvest approaches, and regime recruitment exceeds 100,000.

triage.headline_ja: 戦争下のミャンマーで洪水・飢餓・疾病が人道的苦境を悪化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常性（戦争下での複合災害）」の2項目が該当し、WPRO基準も重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性の全てでYesとなるため、フルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はミャンマー国内の洪水・戦争による人道危機を主題とし、マラリア・デング・コレラ・疥癬の増加を報告。米国・イラン・ウクライナ・イスラエル・ロシアは食料価格や紛争の背景要因として言及されているのみで、感染症発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: الكونغو تعاني شحاً في الكوادر الصحية وسط استمرار تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The Congo faces a shortage of health personnel amid an ongoing Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the Democratic Republic of Congo faces a severe shortage of health workers to run treatment centers amid the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history, centered in North Kivu Province where infections rose 73% over three weeks. While some provinces show improvement, Ituri remains the epicenter and, according to latest government data, the outbreak has spread to seven provinces, with 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths to date (as of 23 September 2026). Between 31 August and 20 September, infections declined by 26% in Ituri and by 15% in Haut-Uele, but transmission patterns vary widely and the epidemic remains out of control, expanding across a broad geographic area. Health officials stress ongoing transmission and the need to bolster health-system capacity in treatment centers.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴはエボラ出血熱の流行が続く中、医療従事者の不足に直面している
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が7州に拡大し、致死率が高く（7,773症例中3,759死亡）、史上最速の拡大速度と報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOが医療人材不足を警告しており、7州に拡大、致死率約48%と非常に高い。史上最速拡大との記述あり。継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola surveillance expands beyond DR Congo borders as IOM steps up efforts
article.articleSummary: Ebola surveillance expands beyond the Democratic Republic of Congo as the IOM intensifies monitoring at displacement sites and along major travel routes, including the Congo River. In the DRC, government figures report more than 7,700 cases and over 3,700 deaths amid an outbreak described as reaching unprecedented levels. At Kinshasa’s Bende-Bende port, IOM teams screen roughly 1,000 travelers daily, taking temperatures and collecting health information with a traveller health form. Passengers meeting the suspected or alert definition are referred to a sampling unit to determine whether the case is Ebola, another epidemic disease, or cholera. The IOM is working closely with neighboring countries—Uganda, South Sudan, Burundi, Rwanda, and the Central African Republic—to strengthen preparedness and curb cross-border transmission. These measures aim to mitigate spread as cases accumulate.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの監視活動、DRC国境を越えて拡大 IOMが対応強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が7,700例超・死亡3,700人超と「前例のない規模」に達しており、近隣諸国への越境拡大リスクと国際的な監視・支援体制強化が進んでいるため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで発生中のエボラ流行（コレラの可能性も含む鑑別診断体制）に関するもので、Uganda・South Sudan・Burundi・Rwanda・Central African Republicは監視強化・準備支援の対象国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではない。対象国リストにこれら5か国は含まれないため verified_locations には反映しない。

article.articleHeadline: Главные новости дня | среда: Генассамблея ООН, Украина, право на развитие, детский рак, Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Top News of the Day | Wednesday: UN General Assembly, Ukraine, Right to Development, Pediatric Cancer, Ebola.
article.articleSummary: At the UN General Assembly, the Security Council discussed Ukraine, with UN Deputy Secretary-General Rosemary DiCarlo reporting that the eight months of 2026 have seen more civilian casualties and injuries in Ukraine than all of 2025, as long-range missiles and drones strike towns far from the front lines and a 'new, dangerous' phase of full-scale invasion is underway, prompting calls to intensify peace efforts. In advance of the 40th anniversary of the 1986 Declaration on the Right to Development, world leaders urged action on equitable development amid digital and AI challenges. The WHO released pediatric cancer data across 194 countries: about 400,000 cases annually in those under 20, with survival 80-90% in high-income countries but ~40% in lower-income settings, notably for ages 15-19. In the DRC Ebola outbreak, after ~130 days, cases declined ~26% in Ituri and Upper Uele but rose 73% in North Kivu, requiring ongoing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 今日の主要ニュース｜水曜日：国連総会、ウクライナ、発展の権利、小児がん、エボラ出血熱
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行に関する続報で、North Kivuでの症例増加(73%)が懸念されるが、既知の流行の経過報告であり新規異常事態や社会的関心の急激な高まりを示す情報がないため、継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はUNニュースの日次まとめであり、エボラに関する記述はDRCの既存流行(約130日経過)の地域別動向報告。IturiとUpper Ueleで26%減少、North Kivuで73%増加という情報があり、地域差の悪化傾向に注意が必要。ウクライナは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Pernambuco registra aumento de 35,9% nas notificações de dengue em 2026 - Portal CBN Recife
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pernambuco records a 35.9% increase in dengue notifications in 2026 - Portal CBN Recife
article.articleSummary: Between Jan 4 and Sep 19, 2026, Pernambuco State, Brazil, recorded 48,423 dengue notifications, up 35.9% year over year, per Arboviroses Epidemiological Bulletin No. 37 from SES-PE released on Sep 23. Of these, 11,631 dengue cases were confirmed, including 696 classified as severe. Municipal incidence varied: 82 municipalities with low, 55 with medium, and 42 with high incidence. The bulletin also recorded 6,852 chikungunya notifications, with 383 confirmed. For Zika, 1,266 notifications were reported; none were confirmed. The data show ongoing dengue activity with substantial case counts and regional variation across Pernambuco, alongside chikungunya activity and no confirmed Zika infections in this period.

triage.headline_ja: ペルナンブコ州、2026年のデング熱届出が35.9%増加 - Portal CBN Recife
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ペルナンブコ州における季節性デング熱の定期疫学速報であり、症例数増加と重症例が報告されているが、IHR基準の異常性・国際的拡大リスクは明確でないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 州保健当局(SES-PE)による定期的な節足動物媒介感染症（アルボウイルス）疫学速報第37号に基づく報告。デング・チクングニア・ジカの状況を含むが、いずれも既知の風土病であり突発的異常事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Cebu City culls 57 hogs infected with ASF virus
article.articleSummary: ASF outbreak in Cebu City, Philippines: 57 hogs culled in Barangay Toong as of Sept 21, including 39 from one compound and 14 from two owners after lab-confirmed results. Toong and Quiot officially confirmed ASF; Buhisan and Pamutan are hotspots under intensified surveillance. Movement restrictions within 500 meters of confirmed areas are in force; nothing can leave or enter. Burial operations began Sept 21, led by the DVMF, with backhoes; hog owners barred from handling carcasses to prevent contamination. Blood testing and surveillance continue; authorities are tracing possible sources from outside Cebu City, with potential links to Consolacion, Liloan, and Lapu-Lapu City; no supplier identified yet. Some raisers resist blood sampling, fearing immediate culling and loss of aid. Indemnification offers fixed amounts (P4,000 for pigs 21–90 days, P8,000 for hogs 25–70 kg, P12,000 for sows) with registration; unregistered raisers may access social welfare support. Depopulation remains possible near confirmed areas.

triage.headline_ja: セブ市、ASFウイルス感染の豚57頭を殺処分
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱(ASF)はフィリピンで継続的に発生している家畜疾病であり、ヒトへの健康影響はなく、地域限定的な家畜管理対応（殺処分・移動制限）として通常の行政対応の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: ASFはブタ間の家畜感染症でヒト健康への直接的リスクはない。フィリピン国内（セブ市）での局地的な家畜疾病対応事案であり、地方当局（DVMF）が主体的に対応している。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

article.articleHeadline: Measles is making a comeback- Will we end it for good?
article.articleSummary: Measles is resurging in the Western Pacific after decades of progress toward elimination. The region, home to 2.2 billion people, saw a rebound linked to COVID-19 vaccination challenges and antivaccine misinformation. WHO notes that elimination by 2030 is possible, building on the record that measles vaccination has saved 94 million lives globally, including 12 million in Western Pacific, with vaccination preventing 154 million deaths since 1974. In 2025, Western Pacific recorded over 1.6 million zero-dose children—most at risk. Last year, WHO certified measles and rubella eliminated as public health threats in all 21 Pacific island countries and areas. Nine countries remain to reach elimination: Cambodia, China, Indonesia, Lao PDR, Malaysia, Mongolia, Papua New Guinea, Philippines, Vietnam; they must maintain strong routine immunization, surveillance, and rapid outbreak response, not rely on campaigns alone. Investment is essential; measles is a sentinel for health system strength. Dr Saia Ma'u Piukala.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹が再流行の兆し―根絶できるか？
triage.triage_reason: 西太平洋地域における麻疹再流行の傾向を報告する概説記事であり、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・発生地の詳細が乏しいため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHO関係者の発言を基にした地域全体の麻疹排除進捗に関する概説であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクの発生詳細（症例数・死亡数等）は記載されていない。カンボジア・マレーシア・モンゴル・パプアニューギニア・ラオスも未排除国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Scientists to test England's sewers for Ebola
article.articleSummary: England's sewers will be monitored for Ebola under UKHSA's Prism wastewater surveillance, expanding to detect Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever, Marburg virus and Lassa fever. The scheme will sample hospital sewage and waste from busy locations, testing for multiple pathogens and early signals of outbreaks such as Covid-19 or norovirus. Ebola is not present in the UK, but the system aims to spot it early; Africa's Democratic Republic of Congo is currently experiencing a major outbreak with more than 3,000 deaths. The programme, already used to track norovirus strains, will extend to monitor variants and drug-resistant bacteria and fungi, including Klebsiella pneumoniae and Candida auris. Prism—Pathogen Risk Intelligence through Surveillance and Modelling—will run for two more years and complements existing polio wastewater surveillance, which detected polio in London in 2022 and has detected imported cases in Leeds, West Sussex, Shoreham and Sheffield.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者らがイングランドの下水道でエボラウイルスの検査を実施へ
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は英国UKHSAの下水サーベイランス（Prism）拡充に関するものであり、DRCのエボラ大流行（3,000人超死亡）は既知の背景情報として言及されているのみで、新規発生情報や進展を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は英国の公衆衛生監視体制（下水サーベイランス）拡充が主題であり、DRCのエボラ流行自体の新規情報は含まれていない。UK自体にはエボラの発生はないと明記されている。DRCのエボラ大流行については別途RRA済みの可能性が高いため、続報の有無を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Sud-Ubangi : après un 2ᵉ cas confirmé à Bulu, Dr Mbungani appelle à l'organisation d'une riposte à la hauteur de la menace - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in South Ubangi: after a second confirmed case in Bulu, Dr Mbungani calls for a response commensurate with the threat
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola cases confirmed in Bulu health zone, South Ubangi Province, signaling active community transmission. The second case tested positive at INRB and is a contact of the first fatal case in Gwaka; the patient had refused post-exposure prophylaxis and is being treated with Remdesivir. The first death occurred on September 8, 2026 in Gwaka after travel through Rwanda, Burundi, Bunia, Kisangani, Bumba, Lisala and Akula, with deterioration at Akula before admission to Gwaka General Referral Hospital. A prior June suspected case from Beni, also passing through Akula, died in Gwaka. So far, all Sud-Ubangi samples tested: two positives; others pending. Dr Mbungani calls for declaring Bulu an active outbreak, strengthening surveillance along Akula-Gwaka-Zongo, and integrating Sud-Ubangi into Fleuve Congo sans Ebola; ensure funding, isolate contacts, secure river ports, protect frontline workers with risk allowances, and engage communities.

triage.headline_ja: 南ウバンギ州エボラ:ブルで2例目の症例確認、ムブンガニ医師が脅威に見合った対応の組織化を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認例が複数発生し、地域内での人から人への感染拡大（コンタクト事例）が確認されており、広域移動歴（ルワンダ・ブルンジ・複数都市経由）もあることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 患者は複数州（ルワンダ、ブルンジ経由）を移動しており、感染拡大リスクが高い。ベナン(Atakora)は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及がなく、主題国ではないため除外。医療従事者への曝露予防拒否や資金不足の訴えなど、対応能力に懸念があり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情未受控｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled | METROHK.com.hk.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled, according to the World Health Organization Africa regional office, despite relief in some districts. Eastern North Kivu Province shows a sharp rise in cases, while Ituri and Haut-Uele report declines. As of Sep 21, 2026, cumulative confirmed cases total 7,773 with 3,759 deaths. From Aug 31 to Sep 20, Ituri and Haut-Uele experienced case declines of about 26% and 15%, respectively, whereas North Kivu surged by about 73%. Children aged 5 years and under are a high-risk group, with mortality above 60% compared with roughly 40% in adults. A large portion of new infections lack clear epidemiological links, indicating surveillance gaps that complicate outbreak control and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、依然として制御下にない
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が大規模流行を続け、致死率が高く（子供60%超）、北キブ州で症例が急増するなど国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるため、IHR基準に複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 北キブ州での症例急増と疫学的リンク不明の新規感染が多いことから、サーベイランスの脆弱性が示唆される。継続的なWHOの状況報告の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Prados realiza caminhada de conscientização e prevenção à dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prados holds a dengue awareness and prevention walk.
article.articleSummary: Dengue awareness and prevention walk organized in Prados, Brazil, on Friday, September 25, 2026, at 8:00 AM. The event is promoted by the Municipal Secretariats of Health and Education (via the Epidemiology unit) to raise awareness and promote dengue prevention. The route starts at Pinheiro Chagas Health Post, proceeds along Rua Vereador José Pedro de Moura to Creche Gabi, then returns toward Escola Professor Antônio Américo and ends back at the Health Post. Participants are advised to bring a reusable water bottle. The initiative emphasizes public education and prevention, with no details on local dengue cases or outbreaks in the report.

triage.headline_ja: プラードス市でデング熱啓発・予防のためのウォーキングイベント開催
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の啓発・予防を目的とした地域イベントの告知であり、具体的な発生状況や症例数の記載がなく、公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事は地域の予防啓発活動の告知であり、実際のデング熱症例やアウトブレイクに関する情報は含まれていないため、対象国リストの発生国としては特定できない。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta en Latinoamérica por la llegada de El Niño que amenaza con inundaciones, contaminación y enfermedades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Latin America on alert over the arrival of El Niño, threatening floods, pollution and diseases.
article.articleSummary: El Niño is active and Latin America faces potential floods, water contamination, and dengue risk as temperatures rise and rainfall intensifies. An OPS 2026-2027 assessment warns of health risks under both wet and dry scenarios across the region, with parts of Ecuador, Peru, Colombia, Brazil, Paraguay, and Argentina identified as areas where floods, displacement, and water- or vector-borne diseases may increase. Higher temperatures can accelerate Aedes mosquito development and shorten the virus incubation period, potentially elevating dengue transmission when conditions are favorable. Drought conditions may lead households to store water, creating mosquito breeding sites. After floods or droughts, weakened water and sanitation systems can worsen disease spread. A 2026 international study found a link between El Niño intensity and dengue risk, though outcomes vary by locale. Importantly, El Niño arrival does not automatically raise cases; local surveillance and prevention matter.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョ現象の到来で中南米に警戒、洪水・汚染・疾病の脅威
triage.triage_reason: エルニーニョによるデング熱リスク増大の一般的な予測・警戒情報であり、具体的な症例増加や発生報告はなく、対象国（ブラジル）についても仮定的リスクの言及に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事はエルニーニョ現象と中南米全般（ペルー、ブラジル、アルゼンチン、パラグアイ、エクアドル、コロンビア）における気候要因由来のデング熱リスク上昇の一般的な予測記事。対象国の中ではブラジルのみが該当。具体的な症例数や発生地域の特定情報はなく、PAHO(OPS)による将来予測・注意喚起の域を出ない。

article.articleHeadline: Etawah Auraiya News: जांच में डेंगू के दो और मलेरिया एक मरीज निकला संक्रमित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Etawah Auraiya News: Two more dengue cases and one malaria patient found infected.
article.articleSummary: On 23 September 2026, Etawah district hospital’s pathology lab confirmed two additional dengue cases and one malaria case, with all typhoid tests negative, amid a continuing fever surge in Etawah and the Auraiya region. In the same period, the district outpatient department recorded 1,497 new patients seeking treatment, mostly for fever, cold and other seasonal illnesses; over 250 returned for follow-up. Dengue testing (56 samples) yielded two positives; malaria testing (122 samples) yielded one positive; typhoid testing (148 samples) was negative across the board. Health authorities emphasize timely testing and medical consultation for those with high fever, body pains, weakness or headaches to distinguish dengue and malaria from other viral illnesses, and to avoid self-medication. The situation underscores ongoing surveillance and public health messaging in the area.

triage.headline_ja: Etawah Auraiya News: 検査でデング熱2例、マラリア1例の感染が判明
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・マラリアの散発的な症例報告であり、規模も小さく、通常の地域サーベイランス活動の範囲内であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 季節性の熱性疾患サーベイランスの一環としての通常報告。デング熱・マラリアともに少数例で、地域の医療機関が通常の検査・対応を行っている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : L'épidémie s'étend, la Tunisie dépêche une aide médicale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the outbreak spreads, Tunisia dispatches medical aid.
article.articleSummary: Tunisia dispatched a cargo of medicines and medical equipment to bolster the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, now expanding to 63 health zones. The aid, sent on 22 September 2026 by aircraft to Kinshasa, was coordinated by Tunisia’s foreign affairs, defense, health and social affairs ministries, the Tunisian Red Crescent, and the Tunisian Solidarity Union, with the defense ministry handling loading and transport and the Kinshasa embassy supervising handover. According to the World Health Organization’s latest situation report (20 September), the outbreak has 7,733 confirmed cases and 3,732 deaths (CFR 48.3%), with 475 new cases and 222 additional deaths since the prior update. The epidemic reaches 63 health zones, including Dungu in Haut-Uélé near the Sudan border. Ituri remains the epicenter (about 76.9% of cases), with sustained transmission in Nord-Kivu and Haut-Uélé. Transmission remains geographically heterogeneous, with new zones at ongoing risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：流行が拡大、チュニジアが医療支援を派遣
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は7,733例・死亡3,732例（致死率48.3%）に達し63保健区に拡大しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: スーダン国境付近のDunguが言及されているが、スーダン国内での症例発生を示す記述はなく、Sudanは対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。チュニジアは支援提供国であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: FMD outbreak: Arunachal minister orders deployment of 2 additional teams in Dibang Valley
article.articleSummary: Arunachal Pradesh's Dibang Valley faces an ongoing foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) outbreak, prompting on Wednesday the deployment of two additional expert rapid response teams to the district. The new teams join one already operating in the affected area and will be equipped with medicines, disinfectants, diagnostic support, logistics and mobility facilities. They will assist district authorities with disease investigation, sample collection and containment, while intensifying village-level surveillance and awareness campaigns for early detection of suspected cases. Farmers and livestock owners will be briefed on early reporting, movement restrictions, and biosecurity practices to curb spread. The minister also ordered ring vaccination in identified areas to create a protective buffer around affected locations and instructed daily monitoring by the secretary of the animal husbandry department.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫の発生：アルナーチャル州大臣がディバン渓谷に追加2チームの派遣を指示
triage.triage_reason: 動物（家畜）における口蹄疫の発生であり、人への健康影響やヒト-ヒト感染のリスクはなく、公衆衛生上の国際的懸念には該当しない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは家畜（牛等）における口蹄疫（FMD）の発生であり、影響カテゴリも'animals'のみ。人獣共通感染症としてのヒトへの感染報告はなく、動物衛生当局による地域的な防疫対応（ワクチン接種、移動制限等）にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: Church builds on Ebola response in Congo | UMNews.org
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (eastern Congo) continues. As of Sept 19, it has spread to seven provinces and 63 of 167 health zones. Since May, the country has recorded 7,672 confirmed cases, 3,699 deaths, and 1,879 recoveries; about 886 patients are hospitalized or in isolation. No approved vaccine exists yet for this outbreak, though WHO on Sept 21 began a frontline vaccination trial with 20,000 Ervebo doses allocated for Ituri province. The United Methodist Church (UMC) is strengthening its response, building a 50-bed Ebola treatment center at Bambu General Referral Hospital in Djugu, about 40 km from Bunia; it will start with 30 beds and reach 50. The $100,000 Global Ministries grant funds construction, equipment, IPC, and staff; nutrition support is provided separately by UMC Relief. The church's communications campaign—text messages, radio, and video—reached over 160,000 texts, 450 radio spots, and 30 video spots. Challenges include personnel and bed shortages, insecurity, and contact tracing. Dr. Bienvenu Ikomo Bitalo cautions that a decline phase has not begun.

triage.headline_ja: 教会、コンゴにおけるエボラ対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、死亡者数・症例数が非常に多く公衆衛生上深刻な影響があり、国際的な対応（WHOのワクチン接種トライアル、教会の支援）が行われているためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 7672例の確定症例、3699人の死亡と大規模な流行。ワクチン接種トライアルが開始されたが承認済みワクチンはまだない。減少局面には至っていないとの専門家コメントあり。

article.articleHeadline: At 40, Panchkula's dengue tally outpaces last year
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Panchkula reached 40 cases through Sept 22, 2026, surpassing last year's 35; hotspots Urban Panchkula (15) and Surajpur (12) account for the bulk, with Pinjore (6), Kalka (4), Raipur Rani (1), Morni (1), and Old Panchkula (1) also reporting infections. The district also reports 10 malaria cases so far this year, up from 9 in the comparable period, with Old Panchkula contributing 8 and Pinjore/Urban Panchkula one each. Authorities attribute dengue clustering to poor sanitation, limited anti-mosquito fogging, and stagnant water along the Kaushalya river bed; residents suspect actual counts are higher due to under-testing. Slum clusters along the riverbank are particularly vulnerable. Civic activists criticize weak enforcement against mosquito breeding, urging the municipal corporation to clear garbage dumps and eliminate standing water.

triage.headline_ja: パンチクラのデング熱累計が40件に達し、昨年を上回る
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地区における季節性デング熱・マラリアの通常の増加報告であり、症例数は小規模で国際的懸念や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地方紙報道でパンチクラ地区（ハリヤーナ州）における季節性デング熱・マラリアの流行状況を伝える内容。衛生環境改善を求める地元活動家の声を含むが、公衆衛生上の重大な脅威や国際的拡大リスクは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Hortolândia reforça combate ao Aedes após chuvas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hortolândia steps up the fight against Aedes after rains.
article.articleSummary: Following persistent rains, Hortolândia intensifies the fight against Aedes aegypti. The Zoonoses Surveillance Unit (UVZ) is conducting a house-to-house campaign this week in Jardim Novo Ângulo, Parque Ortolândia, and Remanso Campineiro, inspecting properties to eliminate potential breeding sites and advising residents on prevention. UVZ notes about 80% of breeding sites are inside homes; residents are asked to allow entry, with teams identified by badges and uniforms. For updates on routes, call UVZ at (19) 3897-3312 or (19) 3897-5974. Dengue this year: 2,131 notified, 126 positive, zero deaths. Chikungunya: 31 notified, zero positives. Zika: no cases notified. Dengue vaccination is available at UBS health clinics from 7:30 to 15:30; seven units offer extended hours: until 17:30 at Amanda II, Dom Bruno Gamberini, Rosolém, Santa Clara; until 18:30 at Amanda I, Figueiras, Parque do Horto.

triage.headline_ja: オルトランジア市、降雨後にネッタイシマカ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は今年2,131件通報中126件陽性・死亡0件、チクングニアも陽性0件、ジカも発生なしと、通常の予防的蚊対策活動であり、異常性・重篤性ともに認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体（サンパウロ州オルトランジア市）による通常の蚊媒介感染症予防活動の広報記事。死亡例なし、陽性率も低く、季節性の予防キャンペーンの範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: OMS reporta avances en la lucha contra el ébola en la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Reports Progress in the Fight Against Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization reports early progress containing the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Ituri Province down 26% and Haut-Uélé down 15% over the past three weeks, while North Kivu records a 73% rise. The outbreak—second-deadliest Ebola surge globally—has reached 7,773 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths since it began in May. Health authorities face severe operational challenges, including staff shortages at treatment centers, diagnostic shortcomings in pediatric cases, and difficulties decentralizing care to rural areas. Transmission remains geographically heterogeneous, underscoring that gains are not uniform across provinces. Enhanced surveillance, diagnostics, and expanded access to care are essential to sustain declines, prevent further spread, and address the persistent burden in the most affected regions of the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱対策の進展を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）が2つ以上該当し、致死率の高いエボラ大規模流行が継続中で国際支援も必要とされているため。
triage.notes: 北キブ州で症例が73%増加するなど地域差があり、依然として深刻な流行が継続中。人員不足や小児診断の課題など運用上の困難も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: "மர்ம காய்ச்சல்" என்று மறைத்தவர்கள்.. இன்று டெங்கு குறித்து பாடம் எடுக்க வருகிறார்கள் - அமைச்சர் அருண்ராஜ்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Those who hid it by calling it a 'mysterious fever'... today they are coming to learn about dengue - Minister Arunraj.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Tamil Nadu stands at 17,348 dengue infections and 4,653 chikungunya cases, with 71 dengue fever cases reported as of 21 September 2026, per official daily releases. Minister Arunraj accuses opponents of masking the outbreak as a mysterious fever to damage his government; he contrasts with 2017, when 23,294 dengue cases and 65 deaths were recorded in the state per NVBDCP. The government asserts rigorous control: 131 expanded testing centers, 2.23 lakh tests conducted, and a case fatality rate of 0.05%. From 04 August 2026, district-level inspections by the Health Department Director and district officers have occurred, and 26,303 mosquito-larvae control workers are clearing 58.5 lakh houses, with 5,677 fogging machines active and 17,187 fever camps held. Public health infrastructure is mobilized—hospitals with dengue wards, TNMSCs stocks, monitored blood banks, and trained clinicians per national guidelines. Citizens are urged to cover water containers, observe dry days, and seek care at 104.

triage.headline_ja: 「謎の熱」と隠していた者たちが今、デング熱について講義しに来る - アルンラージ大臣
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱・チクングニア熱が合計2万件以上発生し政治的論争にまで発展しており、ベクター媒介感染症としての継続的曝露・流行可能性と社会的関心の高まりが認められる。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱・チクングニア熱の流行であり、致死率は0.05%と低く、州政府が独自に大規模な防除・検査体制を展開している。政治的論争が主な報道動機であり、国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。続報でケース数の推移や重症度の変化を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox surges in SA and 11 African countries - Juta MedicalBrief
article.articleSummary: Mpox surges in South Africa with 18 laboratory-confirmed cases, mainly in Cape Town (15), plus 3 in Gauteng and 1 in KwaZulu-Natal. Ages 23–50 (median 36.5); 18 men and 1 woman. Thirteen cases occurred between 13 August and 17 September, signaling rapid local transmission; one case had traveled to Spain. Limited Tecovirimat vaccine doses have been secured for outbreak response. Across Africa, 11 countries report 1,153 cases and seven deaths in six weeks (6 July–16 August), with Madagascar accounting for 785 cases—the highest; Angola 184; Kenya 94; DRC 41; Cameroon 28. Since January 2025, mpox has affected 35 African countries; regional totals reach 52,424 cases and 238 deaths (through 16 August 2026). Globally, 65,784 cases and 264 deaths across 105 countries (through 31 July 2026). The WHO extends mpox recommendations to August 2027; Africa CDC had ended PHECS in January 2026, vaccination central to ongoing control.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカおよびアフリカ11カ国でMpoxが急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で複数該当（重篤な影響、国際的拡大、異常な急速伝播）し、WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は主に南アフリカとアフリカ全体（マダガスカル、アンゴラ、ケニア、DRC、カメルーン等）のMpox流行を報じているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。南アフリカ・マダガスカル等は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: சிவகாசி மாநகராட்சியில் டெங்கு காய்ச்சல் தடுப்பு நடவடிக்கை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever prevention measures in Sivakasi City Municipal Corporation.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever prevention measures are being implemented in the Sivakasi City Municipal Corporation, Tamil Nadu. On Wednesday, Municipal Commissioner Kannan announced ongoing dengue prevention and vector-control actions. Across Sivakasi, vector-control operations are underway in 48 wards. Teams inspect water stored in households and commercial establishments to check for mosquito larval breeding and apply pesticides. Residents should seek treatment at Sivakasi Government Hospital if anyone develops dengue symptoms, and medicines or samples should not be taken without a doctor's advice. The report focuses on preventive activities rather than case numbers; no specific counts or confirmed outbreak details are provided. The measures aim to curb dengue transmission through larval source reduction and targeted spraying within the municipal limits.

triage.headline_ja: シヴァカシ市自治体でデング熱予防対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の日常的な予防・防除活動を報じる内容であり、症例数や異常な発生を示す情報がなく、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は媒介蚊対策・幼虫源対策など日常的な予防活動の告知であり、具体的な症例数や流行状況は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: बच्चों पर वायरल के साथ हेपेटाइटिस ए का हमला
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis A attack on children with a viral infection.
article.articleSummary: Bagpat district, Uttar Pradesh, India, reports a surge in pediatric viral infections accompanied by Hepatitis A. In the last three months, both private and government hospitals have recorded record caseloads. Of 100 admitted cases, 60 involve Viral Hepatitis A. Symptoms include fever lasting 3–4 days, followed by jaundice, abdominal pain, vomiting, and loss of appetite; fever often precedes jaundice. Liver enzymes SGPT and SGOT are markedly elevated, complicating recovery. Oxygen levels are falling, with pneumonia-like respiratory distress reported; nebulizers are used to stabilize patients. Recovery for hepatic illness and associated respiratory symptoms typically spans 10–15 days. Pediatricians note that standard viral symptoms—sore throat and cough—remain common, but concurrent Hepatitis A infection prolongs illness duration. The article does not report fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: バグパット県で子供たちにウイルス感染とともにA型肝炎が流行
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域（バグパット県）でA型肝炎とウイルス性疾患の重症例が増加しているが、死亡例の報告はなく、国際的拡大の可能性も低い。地域の公衆衛生状況として継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: A型肝炎はインドで水・衛生関連の風土病として頻発するため、異常性は低いが、呼吸器症状を伴う重症例増加は注視が必要。死亡例なし、国際的拡大の兆候もないため現時点ではWATCH。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : la baisse des cas en Ituri ne suffit pas encore à enrayer l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the decline in cases in Ituri is not yet enough to stem the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: After more than 130 days of Bundibugyo-strain Ebola transmission in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the outbreak remains active. Ituri shows a roughly 26% drop in cases between Aug 31 and Sept 20, and Haut-Uélé a 15% decrease, but North Kivu reports a 73% rise, prompting cross-border concerns with South Sudan near Dungu in Haut-Uélé. As of Sept 21, 7,733 confirmed cases and 3,732 deaths have been recorded across seven provinces and 63 health zones; 1,935 recoveries and 839 patients in isolation or hospital care. Children, especially under 5, face the highest case fatality (>60%; adults ~40%). About one-third of new infections are detected after death, many with no known epidemiological link. The response includes 1,400 treatment/isolation beds in 49 centers and 25 labs processing up to 3,500 tests daily. Community engagement and surveillance are prioritized, with contact tracing at ~88% and Ituri’s Taximoto alert program to speed case reporting.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：イトゥリ州での症例減少はまだ流行を食い止めるには不十分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）し、130日超継続する大規模アウトブレイクで北キブ州の急増や南スーダン国境地域への懸念があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 南スーダンとの国境地域（Dungu近郊）での越境懸念が言及されているが、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。北キブ州での症例73%増加は流行拡大の懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு விழிப்புணா்வு முகாம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Awareness Camp
article.articleSummary: Dengue Awareness Camp conducted at the school, with principal Ma. Th. Ajay Kumar inaugurating the event and distributing Nilavembu Kudineer to students. Coordinator Vasanth Raj led proceedings, and Chief Minister Sathyia Sabareesan welcomed attendees. Kalavani, a Siddha physician from Valajabath Government Hospital, explained dengue symptoms and transmission, outlined vector-control measures to prevent mosquito breeding, and discussed the medicinal benefits of Nilavembu Kudineer. School administrator Shanti Ajay Kumar arranged the event logistics. The session aimed to educate students on recognizing dengue signs, reducing mosquito habitats, and recognizing traditional remedies as part of broader public health awareness."}{

triage.headline_ja: デング熱啓発キャンプ
triage.triage_reason: 学校での通常のデング熱啓発活動に関する記事であり、実際の症例発生や流行を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の症例やアウトブレイクではなく、啓発イベントの報告であるため、対象国を該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria claims 2 lives in Mumbai, breaks 3-year zero death record
article.articleSummary: Malaria deaths in Mumbai rise to two for 2026, breaking a three-year no-death streak as cases climb to 9,298 during the monsoon, state health data show. The year-to-date tally through September equals about 91.5% of Mumbai’s 2025 total (10,163). Transmission remains concentrated in pockets such as Dongri, Sion and Parel; officials point to stagnant water at construction sites and poor drainage as potential Anopheles breeding grounds. Doctors report patients with prolonged fever—about five days—leading to higher admission rates. While civic teams say surveillance has improved, activists blame infrastructure-driven waterlogging and inadequate basic services. There is no citywide outbreak, but calls for a clear protocol to monitor and eliminate breeding sites and for tighter management of water at infrastructure projects. Historical data show 2020–2025 ranges from 3,985 to 10,163 cases with two 2026 deaths by September.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアによりムンバイで2人死亡、3年連続の死者ゼロ記録が途絶える
triage.triage_reason: ムンバイでの季節性（モンスーン期）マラリア流行の一環であり、都市当局も「シティ全体のアウトブレイクではない」としている。国際的拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限の懸念もなく、通常の風土病報告の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はムンバイ市内のマラリア流行に関する地方ニュースであり、3年ぶりの死亡例という点でやや異例性はあるが、症例数・死亡数ともに過去の年間推移の範囲内。当局は都市全体のアウトブレイクを否定しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : les élèves d'une école sensibilisés contre la propagation d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Students at a school educated on preventing the spread of Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 23 September 2026, in Kisangani, Democratic Republic of Congo, the Nazareth Complex School in Makiso district conducted Ebola virus disease prevention sensitization for its more than 700 students. The Catholic-affiliated institution stressed that Ebola is present in the province and specifically in Kisangani. During morning sessions, civics teacher Kawaya Djumba urged final-year students in pedagogy to follow barrier measures: regular handwashing with soap or hydroalcoholic gel, avoiding handshakes and sharing personal items, and seeking hospital care promptly if fever or malaise occurs, given Ebola’s lethality. The initiative was reiterated across classrooms by multiple teachers, under the direction of interim prefect Raphaël Kapupa, who said the aim was to inform and empower students against misinformation. Nazareth Complex School provides basic education with five tracks: general pedagogy, construction, dressmaking, sciences, and social techniques.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:ある学校の生徒たちがエボラ感染拡大防止について教育を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国キサンガニでのエボラ流行継続を示唆する記事だが、内容は学校での予防啓発活動に関するもので新規感染者数や流行状況の変化についての具体的情報がないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行下での学校教育活動を報じたもので、新規感染者数や地域拡大の具体的データは含まれていない。既存の流行状況（キサンガニ、チョポ州）を裏付ける情報として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Festival Ngoma à Kisangani : le public soumis au lavage des mains contre Ebola. - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ngoma Festival in Kisangani: the public subjected to handwashing to prevent Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Public health measures at the 16th Ngoma Festival in Kisangani, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, on 23 September 2026 require attendees to wash hands at buckets at the entrance of the main venue to prevent Ebola virus disease (EVD). The initiative responds to Ebola activity in Kisangani and the wider Tshopo area and is welcomed by festival-goers such as Jean-Pierre Alongo and Divine Lotsima, who say it enhances safety. The festival, themed 'Art at the Heart of Communities', features slam, dance, theater and storytelling with participants from Kisangani and visitors from Kinshasa, Matadi and Congo Brazzaville; Burundian artists did not attend this edition. The article notes ongoing Ebola circulation in the city but provides no lab-confirmation details or case counts.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニのンゴマ・フェスティバル：エボラ対策として来場者に手洗いを義務付け
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国キサンガニ市（ツショポ州）でエボラウイルス病の流行が継続中であることが確認されており、大規模公衆イベントでの感染拡大リスクが懸念されるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はキサンガニで開催された文化祭における手洗い対策の実施を報じており、エボラの症例数や検査確定情報は含まれていないが、同地域でのエボラ流行継続が言及されている。ブルンジ人アーティストは今回不参加のため、ブルンジは発生地域から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: James Swan appelle à renforcer la riposte contre Ebola dans le Grand Nord-Kivu - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: James Swan calls for strengthening the Ebola response in Greater North Kivu - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 23 September 2026 in Beni, North Kivu, Ebola cases are rising in the Greater North, prompting MONUSCO chief James Swan to call for sustained vigilance and a strengthened response under Congolese government leadership. The UN, with the World Health Organization and humanitarian partners, remains mobilized to contain the outbreak and assist affected communities, while health workers operate under difficult conditions. The security situation is highlighted by the threat from the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), deemed extremely concerning, with civilians bearing the brunt of attacks and displacements. Swan urged enhanced early-warning systems, improved information sharing, and closer operational coordination among MONUSCO, the FARDC, and Congolese security forces. He noted nearly 4,900 joint FARDC patrols from January–September 2026 in the FIB sector, with six mobile bases deployed to strengthen response capacity.

triage.headline_ja: ジェームズ・スワン氏、大北キブでのエボラ対応強化を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でエボラ症例が増加しており、武装勢力ADFによる治安悪化が対応を困難にしているため、国際的拡大や管理不全のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: MONUSCO代表が北キブ州でのエボラ症例増加と治安悪化（ADFの脅威）を受け、コンゴ政府主導での対応強化とWHO・国連の連携継続を呼びかけている。武力紛争地域での感染症対応は情報不足な点も多く、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la Tunisie apporte dix tonnes de matériels médicaux pour soutenir la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Tunisia brings ten tonnes of medical equipment to support the response - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 23 September 2026, Tunisia delivered ten tonnes of medical and paramedical supplies, including antivirals, to support the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The consignment was received at Kinshasa's N'Djili International Airport by the Tunisian ambassador to the DRC. The gesture underscores Tunisia's commitment to African solidarity with the DRC amid the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country. The aid was mobilized with the involvement of Tunisia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Migration, the Ministry of Defense, the Tunisian Red Crescent, and the Tunisian Solidarity Union, and coordinated for delivery to the RDC authorities. Romain Muboyayi, director of cabinet at the Minister of Public Health, welcomed the assistance, noting Tunisia's status as a brother country and partner in reinforcing the RDC's outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：チュニジアがコンゴ民主共和国の対応支援のため医療物資10トンを提供
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクへの国際支援に関する報道であり、疾患自体の重篤性・国際的拡大リスクからIHR基準を2つ以上満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事はチュニジアによる医療物資支援の内容であり、DRC国内での新規症例数や死亡者数など疫学的詳細は含まれていない。既知の第17次アウトブレイクに関する継続報道であるため、最新の症例状況は別途確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Manguredjipa : une nouvelle aire de santé touchée faisant 13 cas confirmés - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Manguredjipa: a new health area affected, resulting in 13 confirmed cases - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, is affecting Manguredjipa health zone in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. A new health area, Kambau, in the Bapere sector of Lubero territory, has been added, bringing the total to 13 confirmed cases since 25 August 2026, with 5 deaths. Authorities warn that transmission risk is rising due to population mobility, including returnees who fled violence by the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) and stayed in Ebola hotspots like Butembo, Katwa, and Mabalako, where many high-risk contacts evaded surveillance. The zone’s health authorities and political-administrative leadership have launched a comprehensive mobilization to cut transmission chains, emphasizing community engagement. Schools in Lubero are being targeted for awareness on preventive practices to curb the outbreak, as containment measures are scaled up.

triage.headline_ja: マングレジパでのエボラ出血熱：新たな保健地区で感染確認、確定症例13例に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の新規感染地域が拡大し、確定症例13例・死亡5例、住民移動や監視回避による感染拡大リスクが指摘されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに北朝鮮（Hwanghae-namdoなど）が含まれるが、記事内容はDRC北キブ州のエボラ流行のみを扱っており、北朝鮮は主題ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 48% drop in testing even as dengue, chikungunya cases spread wings in Bhopal
article.articleSummary: Bhopal, 23 Sept 2026: Testing for malaria, dengue and chikungunya fell about 48% year-on-year in Sept, with 4,775 tests vs 9,195 in Sept 2025, even as dengue (10 cases) and chikungunya (3 cases) were reported and malaria detections remained low. Malaria testing dropped from 8,321 to 4,267; no malaria positives this Sept vs two last year. In the third week of Sept, 409 malaria, 57 dengue and 22 chikungunya tests were conducted with no positives, while the same week last year had one dengue and one chikungunya case. Year-to-date since Jan 1: nine malaria, 81 dengue and 26 chikungunya cases from 196, 971, 5,043 and 1,072 tests, respectively. 2025 figures stood at 10 malaria, 83 dengue, 65 chikungunya from 236, 883, 7,353 and 1,865 tests. Surveillance concerns persist as transmission continues.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールでデング熱・チクングニヤ症例が拡大する一方、検査数は48%減少
triage.triage_reason: インド・ボパールにおける季節性のデング熱・チクングニヤ・マラリアに関する定例サーベイランス記事で、症例数は前年比横ばいまたは減少しており、異常性や深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニヤ・マラリアはインドで毎年発生するエンデミックな媒介感染症であり、今回の記事は検査数減少という行政上の懸念を報じているが、症例数自体は前年並みか減少傾向にある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Isiro: baisse de menaces lors des enterrements des victimes de l'épidémie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Isiro: Decline in risk during the funerals of epidemic victims - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Isiro, Haut-Uélé, Northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, shows a decline in risk during funerals of Ebola victims. In Isiro, Red Cross official Coco Abome said interventions are proceeding calmly and there are no remaining threats. Authorities, community leaders, and Governor Jean Bakomito are praised for ongoing sensitization and the implementation of dignified, safe burials to curb transmission. The response teams remain fully deployed, focusing on risk communication, community engagement, and base surveillance to guide elimination efforts. The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies supported the operation with equipment for the Wamba health zone, including a motorized tricycle for transporting bodies and two motorcycles for volunteer responders, enabling continued protection and routine activities. The message to communities emphasizes adherence to preventive measures to eradicate Ebola in the province.

triage.headline_ja: イジロにおけるエボラ出血熱：疫病犠牲者の埋葬時における脅威の低減 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イジロ/ワンバ地域で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する続報であり、疾患特性上、公衆衛生上の重大性・国際的関心が極めて高いためフルリスク評価対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事自体は埋葬時のリスク低減という進行中対応の肯定的な進捗報告だが、エボラ出血熱は常にIHR Annex2上の即時通知対象疾患であり、既存アウトブレイクの継続状況として引き続き監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta sanitaria: Un mosquito de la malaria resistente a insecticidas se expande rápidamente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health alert: An insecticide-resistant malaria vector is spreading rapidly.
article.articleSummary: Anopheles stephensi, a malaria mosquito that thrives in urban environments and can reproduce without rainfall, is spreading across Africa with strong insecticide resistance, threatening megacities like Lagos, Nigeria, and Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, each about 20 million residents. A Science-published study summarized by The New York Times analyzed genomes from specimens in ten countries and found resistance to all chemicals used in current vector-control campaigns. Originating in South Asia (coast of Pakistan and northern India), the species was first detected in the Horn of Africa in 2012 (Djibouti) and spread via three routes: East to Ethiopia and Kenya; across the Red Sea to Yemen; and through the Sahel to West Africa (Ghana) and southward. Public health experts warn urban populations lack immunity, and once established in cities, malaria transmission could become year-round. There are concerns it may have reached Chad, Somalia, Eritrea, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: 健康警報：殺虫剤耐性を持つマラリア媒介蚊が急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 都市部で繁殖可能な殺虫剤耐性マラリア媒介蚊（Anopheles stephensi）がアフリカ全域で急速に拡大しており、複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当し、国際的な学術誌・大手紙でも報道され社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はAnopheles stephensiという都市適応型マラリア媒介蚊の殺虫剤耐性拡大に関する内容。起源地とされるパキスタン・インドは歴史的経緯として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国としての記述ではないため除外。ナイジェリア（ラゴス）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ガーナへの到達は明記されているが、DRC（キンシャサ）は「脅威にさらされている」との表現であり実際の定着状況は不明確。続報での確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழகத்தில் தினசரி டெங்கு பாதிப்பு 300-ஐ கடந்தது
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tamil Nadu daily dengue infections have crossed 300.
article.articleSummary: Daily dengue infections in Tamil Nadu have crossed 300, with 301 cases reported on 22 September 2026. The statewide tally reaches 17,649 dengue fever cases and 9 deaths. In the first week of September the numbers were 283 (16 Sept), 244 (17 Sept), 253 (18 Sept), 224 (19 Sept), and 228 (20 Sept), averaging between 200 and 300 per day, before the 301-case spike on 22 Sept. Authorities attribute the surge to warm conditions persisting despite a delayed northeast monsoon, with hot days followed by sudden afternoon showers. Water stagnation and continued household water storage are increasing Aedes mosquito breeding, sustaining dengue transmission. The report does not provide details on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州、デング熱の日次感染者数が300人を超える
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州で季節性デング熱の患者数・死亡者数が増加しているが、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、現時点では地域内の流行状況の推移を注視する段階と判断する。
triage.notes: デング熱はタミル・ナードゥ州における季節性の流行であり、雨季の遅延と水たまりの発生が蚊の繁殖を促進していると当局が説明。輸入/輸出例の記載はなく、国際的な拡大の証拠はない。累計17,649例、死亡9例と規模は大きいが、例年の季節的パターンの範囲内とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: सिटी के हॉट स्पॉट आपकी अवेयरनेस से बच सकते कूल स्पॉट, शहर में ये हैं डेंगू के हॉट स्पॉट अवेयरनेस रखेगी आपको 'कूल'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City's hot spots can be kept cool by your awareness; in the city, these are dengue hot spots—awareness will keep you cool.
article.articleSummary: Kanpur reports 15 dengue hotspots across the city after 114 dengue-positive cases in the last month. Kakadeo's Ambedkar Nagar records the highest with 12 positives in two weeks, followed by Siningwa (9), Kalyanpur (8), and Dehli Sujanpur (8). Other hotspots include Gujaini Colony (7), Panki (6), Barra (6), Swaroop Nagar (4), Ratnalal Nagar (6), and Kalyanpur Uttari (5). Health authorities intensified surveillance and awareness, with fever help desks in all government hospitals and dengue wards reserved in three major hospitals: Kanshiram, HALT, and Ursala. All Community Health Centers now have dengue wards (five beds each) with mosquito nets, plus regular sanitation and indoor larvicide spraying around patients. Home surveillance teams visit positive cases to manage treatment and arrange admission if needed. Symptoms include high fever (101–105°F), severe headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgias, rash, and nausea.

triage.headline_ja: 市の意識向上で「ホットスポット」を「クールスポット」に―市内のデング熱ホットスポットに注意を
triage.triage_reason: カンプール市内で季節性デング熱の複数ホットスポットが報告され当局が対応強化しているが、国際的拡大リスクや異常性は認められず、社会的関心も限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱流行で、地方自治体レベルでのサーベイランス強化・病床確保などの対応がとられている。重症度（死亡例等）の詳細情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Tubarão intensifica combate à dengue após 697 focos do mosquito
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tubarão steps up the fight against dengue after 697 mosquito foci.
article.articleSummary: 697 Aedes aegypti breeding hotspots identified across Tubarão, Brazil, prompting intensified dengue control. Year-to-date, Tubarão reports 147 dengue notifications with 11 locally transmitted cases; 131 suspected cases were ruled out by laboratory analysis, while 5 remain under investigation. Imported (alóctones) cases were not recorded. Two residents required hospitalization. Hotspots are heavily clustered in Centro (76), Humaitá de Cima (67), Revoredo (58), Vila Moema (56), Oficinas (51), Humaitá (49), Recife (45), and Dehon (39); other notable areas include Morrotes (36), São João Margem Esquerda (33), Monte Castelo (27), Vila Esperança (24), and Santo Antônio de Pádua (21). Health Secretary Carina Portão urged community participation to eliminate breeding sites, emphasizing weekly inspections of yards, gutters, plant pots, and other containers to prevent mosquito proliferation and new cases.

triage.headline_ja: トゥバランでデング熱対策強化、蚊の発生源697カ所確認後
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部の一都市における地域的なデング熱対策活動の報告であり、症例数・重症度ともに限定的で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで流行性があり媒介蚊対策は継続課題だが、本記事は地方自治体レベルの通常業務報告であり、症例数（147件、うち死亡なし・入院2名）から見て深刻度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Raises Ebola Alert as Deadly Outbreak Spreads Massively in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, prompting Nigeria to raise a national alert. As of Sept 20 (data up to Sept 19), the DRC reported 7,672 confirmed cases and 3,699 related deaths, with 886 patients in isolation; 58 new confirmed cases and 23 additional deaths since the previous update. Latest cases were in Ituri (38), North Kivu (14), Haut-Uélé (5) and Tshopo (1). There have been 1,879 recoveries among those who tested positive, and 79.9% of identified contacts remain under follow-up. Nigeria’s NCDC issued a health advisory to strengthen preparedness and response, led by Director-General Jide Idris. Enhanced surveillance includes Health Declaration Forms for travelers from countries with active or relevant Ebola transmission; others are not required. Nigerians are urged to monitor for symptoms and seek prompt medical care with travel or exposure details.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、コンゴ民主共和国での致死的アウトブレイク拡大を受けエボラ警戒レベルを上げる
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが大規模に拡大しており（累計7,672例、死亡3,699例）、複数州への拡大とヒト-ヒト感染の継続が確認され、近隣国ナイジェリアが国家警戒を発令するなど国際的な関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクの実際の発生地はDRC（Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo等の複数州）。ナイジェリアは感染確認国ではなく、警戒レベルを上げ渡航者向け健康申告フォームを導入した対応国であるため、verified_locationsには含めない。CFR約48%と極めて高く、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が明確。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: U centrima za ebolu u Kongu nedostaje ljudi, epidemija se i dalje širi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: In Ebola treatment centers in Congo, there is a shortage of staff, the epidemic is still spreading.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, with 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths across seven provinces, led by North Kivu in the east. The World Health Organization warns transmission remains widespread and this is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history. Some regional gains are noted: Ituri cases fell 26% and Haut-Uele 15% between Aug 31 and Sep 20, but the epidemic remains widespread and uncontrolled. Staff shortages are a critical bottleneck: a treatment center requires about 300 specialists (anesthesiologists, hygienists, nurses, doctors), yet workers are scarce and many have not been paid; strikes in Ituri complicate care. Mortality is highest among children under five (over 60%), adults around 40%. WHO warns the outbreak could surpass the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴのエボラ治療センターで人員不足、流行は依然拡大中
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで7,773例・死亡3,759例に達し、史上最速の拡大速度と評価されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（北キブ、イトゥリ、オートウエレ等7州）でのエボラ流行を主題としている。アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文で言及がないため除外。人員不足・資金不足が対応能力の限界を示しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: São João de Meriti cria comissão intersetorial para fortalecer enfrentamento à tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São João de Meriti creates an intersectoral commission to strengthen the fight against tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: São João de Meriti, a city in Rio de Janeiro state, established the Intersectoral Commission for Tuberculosis Control, formed by 12 members from the Municipal Social Assistance and Health Secretariats, during the joint action 'Tuberculosis: Care and Social Protection' at Centro Cultural Meritiense. The municipality becomes the first among 15 priority cities in the state to formalize and implement a public policy with integrated Health and Social Assistance to address tuberculosis, a disease with cure but ongoing cases and deaths. The commission aims to strengthen patient follow-up and the coordination of care and social protection policies to prevent treatment abandonment, with monitoring until cure. In recognition, the State Health Secretariat will issue the Intersectoral Certificate of Tuberculosis Control of Rio de Janeiro to the municipality.

triage.headline_ja: サンジョアン・デ・メリチ市、結核対策強化のため部門横断委員会を設立
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患である結核に対する行政的な対策強化（委員会設立）に関する記事であり、異常な公衆衛生事象や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが（3469034）、記事内容は結核の日常的な行政対応・体制整備であり、感染症の急性発生や異常事象ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: காங்கயத்தில் ஹெச்ஐவி தொற்று குறித்து விழிப்புணா்வு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Awareness about HIV infection in Kangeyam
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-23, Kangeyam hosted an HIV and sexually transmitted infection (STI) awareness program at the District Government Head Office Hospital. In-charge Chief Municipal Medical Officer Thiyagarajan led the event, with Medical Officer Sowmya in support. Twenty-three beneficiaries undergoing STI treatment received food supplies. A follow-up outreach near the bus stand extended awareness to auto-rickshaws, with stickers, placards, and pamphlets distributed to drivers. Attendees included Dr. Karthikeyan, Medical Counselor Suresh, Laboratory Technician Karunanithi, TB Senior Treatment Supervisor Jagadish, Auto Union Leader Saravanan, and Wellness Center Counselor Karuppusami. The program sought to increase knowledge on HIV transmission, prevention, and care, reinforcing ongoing public health outreach in Kangeyam to address HIV/STIs.

triage.headline_ja: カーンガヤムでHIV感染に関する啓発活動
triage.triage_reason: 定例的なHIV/STI啓発プログラムの報道であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規発生を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定地域(カーンガヤム、インド)での日常的な公衆衛生啓発活動であり、疾患の異常発生や流行を示すものではないため、対象国であっても発生地域として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Bocah 7 Tahun Penderita DBD Sempat Ditolak Puskesmas di Lebak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7-year-old dengue fever patient turned away by a community health center in Lebak.
article.articleSummary: Seven-year-old DF from Kampung Cipasung, Sukarendah, Warunggunung, Lebak Regency, Banten, tested positive for dengue fever (DBD) after a blood test at a Kalanganyar clinic on 21 September 2026. DF had a high fever up to 40C, intermittent delirium, and fainting; he was initially turned away at Puskesmas Warunggunung, with staff deeming it merely fever and sending him home. After seeking help from a village health worker, DF received IV fluids at home and briefly improved, but fever and weakness returned the following day. The family paid out-of-pocket since the child’s BPJS Health card was inactive, incurring about Rp 300,000 for home care plus Rp 120,000 for a blood test, Rp 100,000 for a doctor consultation, and Rp 90,000 for medicines. Parents request fogging around their home and environmental checks. Puskesmas Warunggunung says inpatient space was full, and doctors/midwives will visit DF at home to assess him and his surroundings.

triage.headline_ja: 7歳のデング熱患者、レバックの保健所で受診を断られる
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。地域医療体制への懸念を示す事例報道に留まる。
triage.notes: デング熱は同地域で流行性疾患であるが、本記事は個別患者の医療アクセス問題（保健所での受診拒否）に焦点を当てた事例報道であり、集団発生や異常な増加を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mudanças climáticas exigem planos de contingência municipais e atenção redobrada contra aumento das arboviroses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate change requires municipal contingency plans and heightened vigilance against rising arboviral diseases.
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces rising arboviral threats as extreme climate and the Super El Niño push dengue projections to 1.7 million in coming months, according to Fiocruz-based government estimates. Dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmitted by Aedes aegypti are of concern; the Ministry of Health warns of increasing arboviruses. Peak transmission historically December–April/May, but climate anomalies could raise cases outside the typical season, though large-scale epidemics this period are unlikely. Early diagnosis and rapid testing are crucial for correct treatment, vector control, and case notification to slow transmission. Pregnant women require heightened vigilance due to Zika’s risk of fetal malformations. Contingency planning is urged for public and private sectors, including reorganizing services for rapid care, hydration hubs to reduce dengue complications, and healthcare worker training to differentiate arbovirus symptoms. Vaccination remains key for primary prevention; elimination of standing water continues as essential.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動が自治体の緊急対応計画とアルボウイルス感染症増加への警戒強化を要求
triage.triage_reason: デング熱などアルボウイルス感染症の増加予測に関する一般的な公衆衛生上の注意喚起記事であり、急性の異常事態や国際的拡大の兆候は明確ではないが、季節外の感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 気候変動によるデング熱等アルボウイルス感染症の季節外増加リスクに関する予防的・啓発的記事。具体的な症例数急増や異常事態の報告ではなく、政府の準備計画に関する内容。

article.articleHeadline: Cutar Ebola kan iya ɓarkewa nan kusa a Najeriya - NCDC
article.articleSummary: Nigeria’s NCDC warns Ebola could break out in the country soon and has intensified surveillance and border health checks, especially for travelers arriving from high‑risk countries. The alert comes as Congo’s Ebola outbreak, which began earlier this year in May, has killed over 3,699 people initially and, by latest counts, about 7,672 deaths nationwide, with the virus spreading to seven provinces. No spread to other West African nations has been reported yet. Nigeria emphasizes community vigilance to report Ebola-like symptoms and urges health checks for all entrants. Key symptoms include fever, severe headache, muscle pain, fatigue, and loss of appetite, with potential progression to vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding, and eye color changes within 4–5 days. Vaccination with Ervebo began at the start of the week. The warning follows consultations with experts and Nigeria’s health agency; Nigeria’s last Ebola outbreak was in 2014, linked to an imported case in Lagos (and Fatakwal).

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでエボラ出血熱が近く発生する可能性 - NCDC警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7,672人以上の死者を出す大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、国境を越えた拡大リスクや渡航制限措置（国境検疫強化）が既に生じているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアの警戒強化だが、実際にエボラ患者・死者が発生しているのはDRCのみであり、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。ナイジェリア国内での確定症例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 看上冷鏈與標案經驗 安特羅與泰國製藥廠簽腸病毒71型疫苗合約
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With an eye on cold-chain and bidding experience, Antro signs an EV71 vaccine contract with a Thai pharmaceutical company.
article.articleSummary: EV71 vaccine deal in Thailand: Antro, a subsidiary of Guoguang Biotech, signed an exclusive Thai distribution agreement on Sep 22, 2026 with Biogenetech to bring Antro’s enterovirus 71 (EV71) vaccine to the Thai market, targeting about 3 million infants for self-pay and government tender channels. The partnership leverages Biogenetech’s 30+ years in Thailand, national cold-chain logistics, and strong government-bid experience to expedite regulatory filing and listing. EV71 is highly neurotropic and can cause meningitis, encephalitis, and cardiopulmonary failure; Thai HFMD cases via Jan–Sep 2025 totaled 94,670, with EV71 comprising 18–19% of detections. Thailand’s 0–4-year-old population is ~2.64 million, with ~400,000 newborns annually, indicating a sizable potential market for both self-pay and public funding. The vaccine is under Thai FDA registration, with an application filed in August of the previous year.

triage.headline_ja: 冷鎖と入札実績に着目、アントロがタイ製薬会社とEV71ワクチン契約を締結
triage.triage_reason: 疾病発生イベントではなく、EV71ワクチンの販売代理店契約に関するビジネスニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な感染拡大の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン供給契約に関する商業ニュース。タイのHFMD/EV71症例数に言及があるが、これは市場背景説明であり新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 安特羅與泰國製藥廠　簽腸病毒71型疫苗合約
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Antro and a Thai pharmaceutical company sign an EV71 vaccine contract.
article.articleSummary: Antro, a subsidiary of Guoguang Biotech, signed an exclusive Thailand distribution agreement with Biogenetech for its enterovirus 71 (EV71) vaccine on September 22, 2026, targeting about 3 million self-pay and government-funded infants and young children. Antro plans to complete Thai FDA registration filed last August to obtain licensing and market launch. Biogenetech, a long-standing Thai biopharma with nationwide cold-chain logistics and government tender experience, will leverage its channels to hospitals and clinics and relationships with KOLs. EV71 is highly neurotropic and can cause encephalitis and cardiopulmonary failure; 2025 Jan–Sep Thailand HFMD cases totaled 94,670, with EV71 comprising 18–19% of detections. Thailand’s 0–4 year population is ~2.64 million, with ~400,000 newborns annually, creating a sizable self-pay and public-funded vaccine market. Biogenetech’s rabies vaccine already holds >30% market share in Thailand, signaling strong potential for the EV71 vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 安特羅とタイ製薬会社、EV71型ワクチン契約を締結
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン販売契約に関するビジネスニュースであり、新規の公衆衛生上の異常事態や流行の急拡大を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン供給契約に関する商業ニュースであり、HFMD/EV71の既存流行状況（2025年のタイでの症例数）は背景情報として言及されているのみで、新規の緊急事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: 197 New Cases, 94 Deaths Trigger Fresh Nigeria Alert
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo virus) reports 197 new confirmed cases and 94 deaths, prompting renewed Nigeria alert. As of Sept 20, total DRC cases reach 7,672 with 3,699 deaths (data through Sept 19). 886 patients are in isolation; 1,879 recovered from Bundibugyo infection. Four provinces are affected; Ituri accounts for 38 of 58 cases in the latest daily update and remains the epicenter with 5,913 cases and 2,703 deaths across 28 of 36 health zones, followed by North Kivu (14), Haut-Uélé (5), and Tshopo (1). Nigeria’s NCDC, led by Director-General Dr Jide Idris, has raised high alert and intensified surveillance, including requiring travellers from affected countries to complete Health Declaration Forms; other countries are exempt for now. ECDC deployed two epidemiologists to DRC on Sept 21; ongoing risk of regional importation underscores need for vigilant screening.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：新たに197症例・94人死亡、ナイジェリアで警戒強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が継続し累計7,672症例・3,699人死亡と致死率が高く、国際的な警戒（ナイジェリアの渡航者健康申告義務化、ECDC専門家派遣）も発生しているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリアは自国内での症例発生ではなく、DRCからの越境リスクに対する警戒措置（渡航者への健康申告義務化）を講じている段階のため、verified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: 安特羅與泰國製藥廠　簽腸病毒71型疫苗合約 - 財經新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Antero signs Enterovirus 71 vaccine contract with Thai pharmaceutical company - Financial News - PChome Online News.
article.articleSummary: Enterovirus 71 (EV71) vaccine developed by Guoguang Biotech's subsidiary Antelo has signed an exclusive Thai distribution deal with Biogenetech to serve an estimated 3 million infants and young children in Thailand through self-pay and public-funding channels. Antelo CEO Zhang Zhe-wei said the agreement marks a strategic entry into ASEAN, with an August filing for Thai FDA new drug registration aiming for rapid listing. EV71 carries high neurotropism and fatal risk, causing encephalitis and cardiopulmonary failure; official Thai lab data show 2025 Jan–Sep HFMD total 94,670 cases, with EV71 comprising 18–19% of tested samples, and sporadic fatalities from severe EV71. Thailand's 0–4 age group numbers about 2.64 million, with roughly 400,000 births annually, indicating a sizable blue‑ocean market for both self‑pay and government tenders. Biogenetech's established cold chain and government tender track record (rabies vaccine >30% market share) are expected to accelerate regulatory clearance and market launch.

triage.headline_ja: アンテロ、タイの製薬会社とEV71ワクチンの独占販売契約を締結
triage.triage_reason: 記事はワクチン製薬企業間の商業契約に関する内容であり、新規の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報ではない。既存の疫学データ引用にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン販売契約に関する財経ニュースであり、感染症の異常発生を報じるものではないため、地域検証の対象外（発生地域としてタイが付与されているが、シグナルとしての価値はない）。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு காய்ச்சல் பரவுவதை தடுக்க நடவடிக்கை எடுக்க வேண்டும்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measures must be taken to prevent the spread of dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Annavasal Thamarajan House hosted a Pudukkottai district unit meeting of the Indian Communist Party, chaired by M. Rajendran to urge action against dengue fever spread. Union Secretary M. Meera Moydeen spoke on the party’s work report, while District Treasurer K. AR. Tharmarajan outlined current political issues and future party actions. Deputy Secretaries D. Marimuthu and C. Ananth, along with district committee member P. Raman and union members K. Kanesan, N. Nagaraj, S. Parameswari, and Iluppur Town Secretary K. Murugaiya, participated. The resolutions include a demand to declare Pudukkottai district drought-affected and to hold a protest on Sept 30 in front of the Iluppur Tahsildar office. They also urged the health department to implement proactive dengue prevention measures to curb the rapidly spreading outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の拡大防止に向けた対策が必要
triage.triage_reason: 地方政党会合でのデング熱対策要求に関する記事であり、具体的な症例数や重症度の情報がなく、政治的声明の域を出ないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は政党によるデング熱対策要求の政治的声明が主内容であり、具体的な感染者数・死亡者数などの疫学データは記載されていない。インド・タミルナードゥ州プドゥコッタイ県での地域的な訴えに留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Shrimp-Killing Vibrio Genomes Reveal Toxin and Secretion Weaponry Are Not
article.articleSummary: Acute Hepatopancreatic Necrosis Disease (AHPND) in shrimp, blamed for wiping out farms across Asia and the Americas, is not as genetically simple as once thought. A BMC Genomics study by Contante and colleagues shows the type VI secretion system (T6SS) is not a reliable driver of AHPND. The team sequenced four Philippine isolates—Vibrio parahaemolyticus PH1339 and PH1273, and Vibrio campbellii PH1401 and PH1409—and analyzed 807 public genomes. They found three T6SS clusters (T6SS1–T6SS3). T6SS1 appears in both AHPND-causing and non-AHPND strains; T6SS2 is present in all four; T6SS3 is limited to V. campbellii. Although pirAB toxin genes on a ~70 kb plasmid co-occurred with T6SS1/2 at first glance, a phylogeny-aware analysis showed no significant link after accounting for shared ancestry. Thus, T6SS is not a reliable diagnostic marker for AHPND; surveillance should focus on the pirAB toxin rather than T6SS presence.

triage.headline_ja: エビを死滅させるビブリオ属菌のゲノム解析、毒素と分泌装置は直接関連しないことが判明
triage.triage_reason: エビの養殖業に影響する動物疾病(AHPND)に関する学術的なゲノム研究であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はヒト感染症ではなく、エビの養殖業に影響するビブリオ属菌（AHPND）の分子生物学的研究に関する内容。フィリピンの分離株を用いた研究のため同国を発生地域として記載するが、公衆衛生上の懸念はない。

article.articleHeadline: Exame confirma caso de hantavirose após morte de homem que entrou em unidade de saúde com febre intensa em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test confirms hantavirus case after death of man who entered a health facility with high fever in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: On 23 September 2026, a 28-year-old man who died after presenting fever in Itajaí, northern coast of Santa Catarina, was confirmed to have hantavirus infection by the Santa Catarina State Public Health Laboratory (Lacen-SC). Initial dengue and leptospirosis tests were suspected; dengue was non-reactive and a new blood sample was sent to Lacen for confirmation. Following confirmation, Itajaí’s Epidemiological Surveillance and Zoonoses Control launched an environmental investigation to identify exposure source, assess risk, and implement prevention and control measures. The last hantavirus case in Itajaí occurred in 2007. Hantavirus disease is a viral zoonosis that can manifest as Hantavirus Cardiopulmonary Syndrome (HCPS), potentially causing rapid respiratory failure and cardiovascular compromise. Rodents are reservoirs; transmission occurs mainly by inhalation of contaminated excreta in enclosed, poorly ventilated spaces. High-frequency regions include Alto Uruguai Catarinense, Oeste, Meio-Oeste, Alto Vale, and Médio Vale do Itajaí.
