Symptoms include fever above 38°C, headache, myalgia, GI symptoms, and respiratory distress; exposure within 60 days prior warrants medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州で高熱を訴え医療機関を受診した男性が死亡、検査でハンタウイルス感染症と確認
triage.triage_reason: 単発の死亡例で、19年ぶりの発生という点で異常性はあるがヒト-ヒト感染性はなく、現時点で国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ハンタウイルスはげっ歯類からの人獣共通感染症でヒト-ヒト感染は基本的にないため、拡大リスクは限定的。地域の環境調査結果次第で追加感染の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: James Swan calls for a strengthened response to Ebola in Greater Nord-Kivu - ACP
article.articleSummary: On Sept. 23, 2026, in Beni, Nord-Kivu, MONUSCO head James Swan urged heightened vigilance and a strengthened Ebola response as cases rise across the Greater North. He affirmed ongoing UN, WHO, and humanitarian support under Congolese leadership, praising frontline healthcare workers facing difficult conditions. The briefing emphasized continued mobilization to contain the epidemic and protect affected communities. Swan warned that the Allied Democratic Forces pose a grave threat, contributing to civilian displacement and insecurity in Beni and the broader Far North. He called for improved early-warning, information-sharing, and operational coordination between MONUSCO, the FARDC, and Congolese security forces. In support of security operations, nearly 4,900 joint FARDC patrols were conducted from January to September 2026 in the Force Intervention Brigade sector, with six mobile bases deployed to strengthen response capacity.

triage.headline_ja: ジェームズ・スワン氏、北キブ州広域におけるエボラ対応の強化を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でエボラ感染者数が増加しており、国連・WHOが対応強化を呼びかけている。治安不安定な地域での流行拡大リスクが高く、既知の重篤な疾患であるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 武装勢力ADFによる治安悪化・住民避難が対応の障害となっており、感染拡大リスクを高めている。具体的な症例数・死亡者数の記載はなく、詳細情報は続報待ち。

article.articleHeadline: US pledges $267 million more to fight Ebola in central Africa
article.articleSummary: On Sept. 23, 2026, the United States pledged an additional $267 million to fight the Ebola outbreak in central Africa, mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. This brings US commitment to $886 million, including $107 million from HHS. The funding aims to contain the outbreak at its source by building treatment facilities, providing diagnostics, and supplying medical countermeasures for health workers. The pledge was announced on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, as officials seek to reach a $2 billion funding target. The outbreak, detected in May, is the second most lethal on record after the West Africa Ebola outbreak of 2014-2016.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、中央アフリカのエボラ対策に2億6700万ドルの追加拠出を表明
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行に対し米国が巨額支援を追加拠出しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援の必要性が明確に認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事は2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行に次ぐ致死的なアウトブレイクと報じており、DRCを中心とした流行が主題。Angola、United Statesは発生地域として付与されているが記事の主題はDRCでの流行であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: கும்பகோணம் மாநகராட்சியில் டெங்கு காய்ச்சலை கட்டுப்படுத்த 1 டன் பழைய டயர்கள் அகற்றம்..!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kumbakonam Municipal Corporation removes 1 ton of old tyres to curb dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Kumbakonam Municipal Corporation has removed about 1 ton of old tyres to curb dengue fever in Kumbakonam, Tamil Nadu. Commissioner Sudha stated that dengue control involves vector surveillance in homes, shops, schools, and commercial areas, with joint cleaning campaigns to remove larvae from plastic cups, coconut shells, tyres, and broken utensils. As a northeast monsoon precaution, around 1 ton of unused tyres were collected and removed in the municipal area. 153 field workers inspected cement pots and drums in households to prevent larval development. Workers are advised to close open items and apply bleaching powder weekly, and to deploy insecticide to kill mature mosquitoes. The measures aim to limit Aedes aegypti breeding and dengue transmission.

triage.headline_ja: クンバコナム市が登熱防止のため古タイヤ1トンを撤去
triage.triage_reason: デング熱に対する日常的な予防的ベクター対策の実施報告であり、異常な発生や重症例、公衆衛生上の危機を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による季節性の予防的デング熱ベクター対策（タイヤ除去、幼虫調査、殺虫剤散布）の通常業務報告。感染者数や症例情報の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil terá reserva para produzir 10 milhões de doses contra febre aftosa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil will have a reserve to produce 10 million doses of foot-and-mouth disease vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Brazil will maintain a reserve of frozen foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccine antigens capable of producing up to 10 million doses in an emergency. The stock is stored at Biogénesis Bagó’s laboratory in Garín, Greater Buenos Aires, through a partnership with Brazil’s MAPA, the Paraná Institute of Technology (Tecpar), and Biogénesis Bagó. Antigens, not ready vaccines, enable rapid vaccine formulation while reducing expiry risk. If an outbreak occurs, the antigen can be thawed and vaccine formulated within four days, with doses reaching the affected region within seven days, contingent on production readiness. Brazil suspended FMD vaccination in May 2024; in May 2025, the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) recognized the country as FMD-free without vaccination. Surveillance continues, and producers must maintain biosafety and report suspicions. Vaccination would be reintroduced only after virus identification and official assessment by MAPA and Panaftosa. The reserve is part of broader emergency preparedness to protect exports while maintaining FMD-free status.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、口蹄疫ワクチン1000万回分を生産可能な備蓄体制を確立
triage.triage_reason: 現時点で口蹄疫の発生は報告されておらず、ブラジルはワクチン非接種清浄国の地位を維持したまま緊急時対応体制を強化しているという予防的措置の記事であり、動物疾病でヒトへの公衆衛生上の懸念もない。
triage.notes: 記事は口蹄疫の実際の発生ではなく、ブラジルが清浄国ステータスを維持しつつ緊急時のワクチン抗原備蓄体制を整備しているという予防的準備に関する内容。動物疾病であり、ヒトへの感染症危機管理対象ではないため対象国リストにも該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：刚果（金）埃博拉疫情总体仍未得到控制
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has not yet been brought under overall control.
article.articleSummary: WHO Africa regional office on 23 September 2026 said the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak remains not under overall control. Some areas show relief, but transmission is uneven: North Kivu Province has seen a sharp rise in cases, while Ituri Province and Haut-Uele Province declined by about 26% and 15% respectively from 31 August to 20 September. As of 21 September, the outbreak totals 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths. Children under five are the highest-risk group, with case fatality rates above 60%, far higher than adults at about 40%. Contact tracing coverage has reached 88%, but many new infections lack a clear epidemiological link, highlighting ongoing surveillance gaps and persistent transmission in eastern DRC."} {{description:

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は依然として全体的に制御下にない
triage.triage_reason: WHOが公式に流行制御が未達成と表明し、確定7,773例・死亡3,759例、5歳未満致死率60%超という重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、地域間で感染動向が不均一で拡大リスクも継続しているため。
triage.notes: 北キブ州で症例増加、イツリ州・オートウエレ州では減少傾向だが、接触者追跡率88%にも関わらず感染経路不明の新規感染が多く、サーベイランスの隙間と持続的な感染連鎖が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Beni-Mangina : quinze écoles dotées de matériels pour renforcer la prévention contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni-Mangina: Fifteen schools equipped with supplies to strengthen Ebola prevention - ACP
article.articleSummary: Fifteen schools in Mangina, a rural commune of Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, received Ebola prevention kits as part of ongoing response amid resistance to some control measures. The effort targets 12 primary and 3 secondary schools, providing handwashing stations, soap, and infrared thermometers, and strengthens Ebola awareness activities. Each school serves about 500–600 students, with pupils acting as community sensitizers to relay messages to families and the broader Mangina area. Church leaders were urged to contribute to mobilization. Persistent doubts about Ebola hinder care-seeking, and attacks on response teams endanger personnel and complicate interventions. Deputy Jules Mumbere Mathe emphasized using health facilities at the first signs of illness and adhering to protective measures. He called for constructive dialogue between communities and response teams to improve interventions and save lives.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ・マンギナ:エボラ予防強化のため15校に資材が提供される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 既存のエボラ対応（学校への予防資材配布）に関する報告であり新規感染急増等の情報はないが、コミュニティの抵抗や対応チームへの攻撃が言及されており継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ対応活動（予防キット配布、啓発活動）に関する内容で、新規感染者数や発生規模の情報はない。コミュニティの疑念や対応チームへの攻撃が対応の障害となっている点は懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 中英對照讀新聞》WHO warns DRC Ebola outbreak intensifying at 'exceptional' pace 世衛警告 民主剛果伊波拉疫情以「非比尋常」速度加劇
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is intensifying at an unprecedented pace
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating at an 'exceptional' pace, according to the World Health Organization on 2026-09-24, which is calling for a major scale-up of the health response. Declared May 15, the current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. As of July 30, 2026, the DRC has reported 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths, a case fatality rate of 44%. The WHO notes that insecurity, population displacement and mobility, and cross-border movements complicate response operations and raise the risk of further geographic spread beyond current areas. The agency emphasizes urgent expansion of surveillance, infection control, and cross-border coordination to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO警告、民主剛果のエボラ出血熱流行が「非比尋常」な速度で加速
triage.triage_reason: WHOが「非比尋常」な速度での拡大と致死率44%を警告しており、ワクチン・治療薬未承認の株による大規模流行かつ国境を越えた拡大リスクがあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬のないBundibugyo株による流行で、致死率44%、症例数3,605例・死亡1,587例。治安不安・人口移動・越境移動が対応を複雑化させ、地理的拡大リスクを増大させている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le nombre de guéris approche les 2 000 - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the number of recoveries approaches 2,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 September 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths, with 1,935 recoveries—65 short of 2,000—after 33 new recoveries in the last 24 hours. Recoveries by province: North Kivu (17), Ituri (12), and Upper Uele (4). Currently, 839 patients are in isolation or hospitalized. The response spans seven provinces and 63 health zones, with contact tracing at 84.5%. The Matanda Ebola Treatment Center in Katwa has opened, and capacity is being expanded in Butembo to support the hardest-hit areas. In Bas-Uele, prevention efforts include training 542 school officials in prevention and detection, and educating youth for early Ebola recognition to bolster vigilance as the school year begins. Sixty-five more recoveries are needed to reach 2,000.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国：回復者数が2,000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例7,773例、死亡3,759例に及ぶ大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が7州・63保健地区にわたり継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く（約48%）、7州・63保健地区にわたる大規模流行で、接触者追跡率84.5%と対応体制は継続中。学校関係者へのトレーニングなど地域社会での予防活動も進行しているが、依然として症例数・死亡者数が増加傾向にあり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Expert urges caution despite 'encouraging signs' in Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) shows 7,733 cases and 3,732 deaths as of Sept. 20, 2026. The outbreak originated in Ituri and has had the largest Bundibugyo 100‑day caseload to date (5,458 cases, 2,606 deaths); week‑by‑week trend is mixed, with a 25.8% decline in Ituri but a 72.7% rise in North Kivu, limiting overall progress. There are no licensed vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo; Ervebo (Zaire strain) has been allocated—70,000 doses last month—and used in trials, with 4,944 people vaccinated in this outbreak. Investigational Bundibugyro vaccines (ChAdOx1 and mRNA-1469) and therapies are under study. The PARTNERS treatment trial (515 participants) and EBO-PEP trial (299 participants) are expected to yield preliminary data within six weeks; officials urge cautious optimism as transmission remains high.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家、エボラ流行における『好ましい兆候』にもかかわらず警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブジョ株エボラ流行が7,733例・3,732人死亡と大規模化し、地域によって感染拡大が続いており、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないため公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブジョ株には承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、北キブ州で症例が72.7%増加している点が特に懸念される。臨床試験（PARTNERS試験、EBO-PEP試験）の結果が今後6週間以内に判明予定であり、続報の追跡が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri: l'UNHAS facilite l'accès des humanitaires aux zones affectées en Ituri - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: UNHAS facilitates humanitarian access to the affected areas in Ituri - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: UNHAS, the United Nations Humanitarian Air Service managed by the World Food Programme (WFP), facilitates access for humanitarian teams to Ebola-affected areas in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. With widespread displacement, violence, and loss of livelihoods creating ground-access challenges, aerial transport enables faster deployment of staff and critical medical and logistical supplies to Ebola response operations. The service helps bring responders closer to communities facing the outbreak and supports urgent interventions where terrestrial routes are unsafe or impractical. Beyond medical response, UNHAS logistics sustain the presence of humanitarian actors amid security crises, ensuring timely delivery of assistance. In the Ebola response, rapid access to affected zones remains a key element to implementing activities promptly. UNHAS provides a dedicated mechanism to support operations in contexts with difficult road access and security concerns.

triage.headline_ja: イツリでのエボラ出血熱：UNHASが人道支援団体の被災地アクセスを支援 - LePotentiel
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する続報であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的な人道支援が必要とされているため。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ対応における人道支援アクセスに関する内容であり、新規発生情報ではなく既存アウトブレイクの状況報告。治安悪化・住民避難により地上アクセスが困難な状況が続いていることから、感染拡大・対応の長期化リスクが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Morte misteriosa de jovem foi causada por doença que havia sumido de cidade em SC há quase 20 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mysterious death of a young man was caused by a disease that had disappeared from the city in Santa Catarina nearly 20 years ago.
article.articleSummary: On Sept 15, a 28-year-old Itajaí resident died from hantavirus disease, the so-called 'rat disease,' a zoonosis not recorded in the city since 2007. He presented fever and sought municipal care on Sept 13; death followed two days later. Leptospirosis was initially suspected, but the Laboratory Central of Public Health of Santa Catarina (Lacen) in Florianópolis confirmed hantavirus. Wild rodents are the main reservoirs, shedding virus in urine, feces and saliva; transmission occurs primarily by inhalation of contaminated particles in enclosed, poorly ventilated spaces. Hantavirus disease can progress rapidly, with respiratory failure or cardiovascular involvement in the first 72 hours. Authorities are conducting epidemiological and environmental investigations to identify exposure sources and implement prevention and control measures. In Santa Catarina, hantavirus occurs year-round, with higher activity in Oeste and Alto Vale; Itajaí’s last case was nearly 20 years ago. Symptoms include fever, headache, myalgia, cough, and shortness of breath.

triage.headline_ja: 謎の若者の死因は、サンタカタリーナ州の都市で約20年ぶりに発生した疾患だった
triage.triage_reason: 単発の致死例でヒト-ヒト感染はないが、約20年ぶりの発生であり異常性があるため、環境調査の続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ハンタウイルスはげっ歯類からヒトへの感染で、ヒト-ヒト感染はしないため国際的拡大リスクは低い。単発の死亡例であり、地域の環境調査結果の続報を待つべき。

article.articleHeadline: OMS reporta avances en la lucha contra el ébola en la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports progress in the fight against Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows uneven regional patterns, with the World Health Organization reporting early containment progress. In Ituri, confirmed cases declined by 26% and in Haut-Uele by 15% over the past three weeks, while North Kivu infections surged by 73%. Operational hurdles persist, including staff shortages at treatment centers, diagnostic gaps in pediatric cases, and challenges in moving care closer to rural populations. The official tally stands at 7,773 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths since the emergency began in May. The outbreak remains the second-deadliest Ebola epidemic on record globally. As of 23 September 2026, public health authorities are continuing to monitor geographic variability and adapt response strategies.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱対策の進展を報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7,773例の検査確定例、3,759人の死者を出す史上2番目に致死的なエボラ流行が継続中であり、北キブ州で感染が73%急増するなど地域的拡大リスクが高いため。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模エボラ流行の継続報道であり、地域別（イトゥリ・オートウエレで減少、北キブで急増）の状況変化が報告されている。人材不足や小児診断のギャップなど運用上の課題も継続。

article.articleHeadline: Casos prováveis de Chikungunya sofrem aumento de 369,3% na Bahia; afirma Sesab - Metro 1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Probable Chikungunya cases rise by 369.3% in Bahia; Sesab says - Metro 1.
article.articleSummary: Bahia, Brazil records a sharp rise in probable Chikungunya cases this year, with 10,264 notified between January 4, 2022 and September 22, 2026, and 3 deaths; officials say a formal outbreak has not been declared. The Sesab notes rising arbovirus risk across the state amid El Niño-driven higher temperatures and altered rainfall. Dengue shows a 15.4% decline, totaling 28,199 probable cases in 2025 and 23,844 through September 22, 2026. Zika virus cases rose 2% to 260 this year (vs. 255 in 2025). The highest chikungunya incidence is in Alagoinhas, with an incidence coefficient of 2,534.18 per 100,000. A total of 201 municipalities are monitoring infections. Prevention emphasizes eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites, including removing standing water from tires, bottles, cans, and plant pots, and sealing water tanks; residents should report risk spots to authorities.

triage.headline_ja: バイア州でチクングニア熱の推定症例が369.3%増加、セサブ（バイア州保健局）が発表 - Metro 1
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱の症例が大幅増加しているが、当局は正式なアウトブレイク宣言をしておらず、季節性・エルニーニョ関連の媒介動物増加によるものとみられる。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは示唆されていない。
triage.notes: バイア州保健局（Sesab）は媒介蚊（Aedes aegypti）対策を強化中。デング熱は減少傾向、ジカ熱は微増。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項としての性質は低いが、州内の症例動向は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு பரவலைத் தடுப்போம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent the spread of dengue.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever dominates Tamil Nadu’s fever burden. By Sept 15, 133 dengue cases were confirmed statewide; on Sept 17, 244 dengue cases were reported in a single day. Through Sept 22, 17,277 dengue cases and 9 deaths had occurred in the state, with 1,320 fever-related hospitalizations. Chennai remained the epicenter, reporting 87 dengue cases on Sept 17 and 156 cases of malaria, chikungunya, and influenza-like fever. Affected districts include Chennai, Chengalpattu, Coimbatore, Tiruvallur, Tiruvannamalai, Krishnagiri, Salem, Kanchipuram, Thanjavur, and Viluppuram. Dengue virus transmission occurs via Aedes mosquitoes that breed in standing water around homes, flower pots, old tires, coconut husks, and water containers. Public health authorities have mobilized over 25,000 workers for vector control; residents should eliminate standing water and seek medical advice rather than self-medicate. Seek care if fever lasts 3–4 days. Annual influenza vaccination is advised by physicians.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の拡大を防ごう
triage.triage_reason: タミルナドゥ州で17,277例・9名死亡という大規模なデング熱流行が続いており、重症度・曝露継続・流行しやすさの基準に該当し、地元での社会的関心も高いためフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで季節性に毎年発生する疾患であり、IHR上の異常性・国際拡大リスクは低いが、州全体での症例数・死亡者数の規模から公衆衛生上の負荷は大きく、続報の確認が望ましい。マラリア・チクングニア・インフルエンザ様疾患も併発報告あり。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. Pledges Extra Health Aid for Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 23 September 2026, the United States pledged an additional $267 million in direct health and humanitarian assistance to the Ebola outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The total U.S. support reaches about $887 million, including more than $780 million from the Department of State, and funds a rapid, multi‑agency response with new Ebola treatment units, safe and dignified burial teams, mass procurement of personal protective equipment, expanded surveillance, essential health commodities, and contact tracing in support of the DRC, Uganda, and regional partners. Activated within 48 hours of first reports in May 2026—the fastest U.S. Ebola response to date—the effort covers 292 metric tons of humanitarian supplies, 8.6 million health screenings, 184,000 pieces of disease prevention equipment, 23 treatment centers, and support to 235 facilities, alongside earlier $350 million in humanitarian aid and a broader $1.8 billion UN OCHA package.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱の流行に対し追加の保健支援を約束
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での進行中のエボラ出血熱流行に対し、米国が大規模な追加支援を表明しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダ等地域への波及）がIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 2026年5月に発生が報告された既存のエボラアウトブレイクで、米国は多額の追加資金（2億6700万ドル）を拠出し、総額約8.87億ドルの支援を実施。ウガンダや地域パートナーへの支援も含まれるが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta mundial: explosão de casos de HIV faz Fiji declarar emergência nacional - Brazil Urgente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global alert: surge in HIV cases prompts Fiji to declare a national emergency - Brazil Urgente
article.articleSummary: Fiji declared a national emergency over HIV after 2,016 new diagnoses in 2025, the highest annual total and a 27% rise from 2024. The surge is concentrated among 20–24-year-olds (646 cases, 32% of 2025 diagnoses). The adult burden rose from about 1 in 167 five years ago to roughly 1 in 60. Pediatric diagnoses reached 67, with 56 linked to mother-to-child transmission. HIV-related deaths totaled 117 in 2025, with 67 diagnosed and dying in the same year, indicating late detection. Transmission is driven by sexual spread, shared injection equipment, and limited treatment access, exacerbated by stigma. A new diagnosis does not always reflect a recent infection, and expanded testing may contribute to rising counts. Brazil reported 39,216 HIV cases in 2024, underscoring prevention measures (PrEP, PEP, condoms, testing). With treatment, people can reach undetectable viral loads and prevent sexual transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的警鐘：HIV感染急増によりフィジーが国家非常事態を宣言 - Brazil Urgente
triage.triage_reason: フィジーで2025年にHIV新規診断が過去最多となり27%増加、国家非常事態が宣言されるなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 主題はフィジーにおけるHIV流行であり、ブラジルは比較統計として言及されているのみで発生地域の主題ではない。フィジー・ブラジルともに対象国リストに含まれない（フィジーは対象外、ブラジルは主題国でないため除外）。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de chikungunya crescem mais de 310% na Bahia - Folha do Estado da Bahia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya cases rise more than 310% in Bahia - Folha do Estado da Bahia.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya cases in Bahia surge 310.8% in 2026, reaching 9,990 probable cases as of September 15, with 2 confirmed deaths; 201 municipalities reported cases, and 22 had incidence above 100 per 100,000. Dengue notifications fell 16.5% to 23,285 probable cases, with 12 deaths; Zika rose slightly to 260 probable cases (vs 252 in 2025). These arboviruses, transmitted by Aedes aegypti, are being driven by El Niño-linked higher temperatures and water-storage practices that promote mosquito breeding across Brazil. Preventive guidance emphasizes safe water storage, eliminating standing water in tires, containers, and plant pots, sealing water tanks, and proper pool maintenance, plus reporting vacant lots with potential water accumulation. Dengue vaccine is recommended for priority groups in the public system and for ages 4–60 in private networks. Sabin has developed a PCR-based assay that detects six arboviruses (Dengue, Zika, Chikungunya, Oropouche, Yellow Fever, Mayaro) from one blood sample, available in Bahia via Sabin clinics and the mobile unit, with scheduling at sabin.com.br/agendamentos or WhatsApp.

triage.headline_ja: バイオアのチクングニア症例が310%以上増加 - Folha do Estado da Bahia
triage.triage_reason: バイオア州でチクングニア症例が前年比310%増加し、死亡例も発生。WPRO基準を複数満たし、気候要因による媒介蚊感染症の拡大傾向が見られるため、フルRRAでの評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・バイオア州における複数のアルボウイルス感染症（チクングニア、デング、ジカ）の状況を報告。チクングニアが顕著に増加している一方、デングは減少傾向。気候変動(エルニーニョ)や水貯留習慣が媒介蚊繁殖を助長していると分析。国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候は現時点で確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Primavera aumenta alerta para criadouros do Aedes aegypti em Guararema | Hoje Diário
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spring heightens alert for Aedes aegypti breeding grounds in Guararema | Hoje Diário
article.articleSummary: As of 23 September 2026, spring arrives in Guararema, heightening the risk of Aedes aegypti breeding as warmer temperatures and increased rainfall create favorable conditions for dengue, Zika and chikungunya transmission. The Municipal Health Secretariat urges residents to intensify home and backyard inspections to eliminate standing water where the mosquito reproduces. Daily checks should target containers that can hold even small amounts of water, including plant pots and saucers, bottles, tires, gutters, drains, and water tanks, plus other outdoor items. Standing-water containers must be emptied; water tanks kept closed; gutters and drains cleaned; tires and bottles sheltered from rain; pools kept clean and treated. Seek less obvious water-holding sites and discard unused items that could become breeding grounds. Local teams survey homes, businesses and industries and carry out education and fogging in areas with confirmed cases. Dengue vaccination is available for 10–14-year-olds; guidance at Guararema Health Units, Mon-Fri 7–17.

triage.headline_ja: 春の訪れによりグアララマでネッタイシマカ発生源への警戒強化 | Hoje Diário
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱等ベクター対策に関する予防的な注意喚起であり、異常な流行や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性のベクター媒介感染症予防に関する地方自治体の通常の広報活動であり、確認された症例数や異常な増加についての具体的データは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ludhiana Health Department steps up efforts to check spread of TB among children - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Punjab's Ludhiana district intensifies paediatric TB control by expanding diagnosis, management and prevention through a dedicated training programme for healthcare workers. Organised by World Health Partners (WHP) and SAATHII in collaboration with the District TB Cell, the workshop trained over 60 paediatricians, medical officers, nurses and other staff on paediatric TB guidelines, diagnosis, molecular tests under NTEP, treatment strategies, and weight-based fixed-dose combinations for children. Civil Surgeon Dr Ramandeep Kaur stressed timely diagnosis and early treatment as essential to reducing complications and stopping transmission, aligning with India's TB elimination goal. Sessions by Dr Ruby Singh on extrapulmonary TB, Dr Jaskaran Singh Bhasin on symptoms and diagnostics, and WHO consultant Dr Prabhjit Samra on TB Preventive Treatment (TPT) and household-contact screening highlighted importance of preventive care. Emphasis on enhanced public-private coordination to accelerate TB elimination in Punjab and nationally.

triage.headline_ja: ルディアナ保健局、小児結核の感染拡大阻止に向けた取り組みを強化
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に対する通常の医療従事者研修・啓発活動の報道であり、異常性や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核（Tuberculosis）の通常のプログラム的対応（研修・能力構築）を報じたものであり、アウトブレイクや異常事象の報告ではない。地方保健当局とWHO協力による既存の結核撲滅事業の一環。

article.articleHeadline: Exame confirma hantavirose em jovem que morreu dois dias após dar entrada em posto de saúde, em Itajaí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test confirms hantavirus infection in a young person who died two days after being admitted to a health post in Itajaí.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus infection confirmed in a 28-year-old man in Itajaí, Santa Catarina, Brazil. Laboratory confirmation by Lacen followed initial dengue and leptospirosis testing with negative results; fever began on Sunday and death occurred two days after admission. Itajaí’s Municipal Health Department (DVE and Zoonoses Control) is tracing exposure sites and at‑risk contacts; the city had no hantavirus diagnoses since 2007 (SINAN Net). Hantavirus disease is a zoonosis transmitted by wild rodents via urine, feces, and saliva, typically through inhalation of dust in enclosed, poorly ventilated spaces. In Brazil, it often presents as Hantavirus Cardiopulmonary Syndrome (SCPH), potentially causing severe respiratory failure and cardiovascular compromise within 72 hours. Symptoms include fever, headache, myalgia, chills, weakness, GI symptoms, cough, and dyspnea. Notifiable with 24-hour reporting; prevention emphasizes avoiding rodent excreta, secure food storage, reducing clutter, and using masks/ventilation when cleaning closed spaces. Regional risk areas in Santa Catarina include Alto Vale, Médio Vale do Itajaí, and Oeste.

triage.headline_ja: イタジャイの保健所受診2日後に死亡した若者、ハンタウイルス感染検査で陽性確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州イタジャイで単発のハンタウイルス感染死亡例が確認され地域的には2007年以来の症例で異常性はあるが、ヒト-ヒト感染性は低く国際的拡大リスクは低いため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 単一症例（28歳男性）の死亡例。ハンタウイルスは齧歯類由来でヒト-ヒト感染は基本的に稀。地域保健当局が曝露源と接触者を追跡中。2007年以来市内で症例なしという点で局所的異常性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Far From A Hospital, Even A Deadly Outbreak May Go Undetected
article.articleSummary: Nature study (Gibb et al.) analyzed 58,319 infection records for 32 diseases across 169 countries and found the geography of reported outbreaks largely reflects healthcare access and detection rather than forest loss or climate. After correcting for surveillance, proximity to clinics and the density of built-up land best explain where outbreaks are recorded; for the median disease, each extra hour to the nearest health facility reduces the odds of a recorded outbreak by about one third, with reductions of 90%+ for MERS and Argentine hemorrhagic fever. About a quarter to over a third of those at risk live more than two hours from care. Ebola spillovers in Congo illustrate under-detection; previous estimates of undetected spillovers were high, suggesting a ubiquitous, ongoing nature of spillover. triage.triage_reason: 本記事は特定の現行アウトブレイクの発生報告ではなく、医療アクセスと発生検知率の関係を分析した学術研究（Nature誌）の紹介記事であり、具体的な感染症イベントの発生を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はGibb et al.のNature研究を紹介する学術・政策的内容であり、特定の現行アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。コンゴのエボラは過去のスピルオーバー検知率の例示として言及されているのみで、現行イベントではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: The Organization Fighting Ebola Has Never Been More Worried | Tech Biz Web
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with more than 7,000 cases since May and about 50% mortality. The outbreak is the fastest-growing Bundibugyo episode on record, prompting alarm from public-health leaders such as Nicole Lurie of CEPI. Uganda managed an Ebola surge with traditional public-health tools, but the DRC faces mass displacement, ongoing violence, and constant movement that hamper contact tracing. Distrust of external aid workers has led to attacks on Red Cross volunteers, destruction of ambulances, and delayed safe burial teams—crucial to halting transmission. Vaccine development is accelerating: CEPI redirected $100 million to fund Oxford University’s ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine production at Serum Institute of India, and Moderna’s candidate, with safety trials underway and efficacy trials planned this month. A vaccine’s success depends on acceptance by frightened communities. Teresa Lambe, leading Oxford’s vaccine effort, pivoted from a hantavirus project to Ebola in response to the crisis.

triage.headline_ja: エボラと戦う組織がこれまでで最も懸念を強めている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスが5月以降7,000例超・死亡率約50%と過去最速の拡大を見せ、暴力・住民移動により対策が困難化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: インド（Serum Institute of India）はワクチン生産拠点として言及されているのみで、実際の感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ウガンダ・英国も同様に発生地ではなく対応拠点として言及されているため対象国リストにも該当せず除外。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு பரவலைத் தடுப்போம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Let's prevent the spread of dengue.
article.articleSummary: Dengue remains the leading health concern in Tamil Nadu, with Chennai reporting 87 dengue fever cases as of September 17; malaria, chikungunya, and flu-like fever together total 156 cases. Ongoing transmission is reported across districts including Chennai, Chengalpattu, Coimbatore, Tiruvannamalai, Krishnagiri, Salem, Tiruvallur, Kanchipuram, Thanjavur, and Viluppuram. Dengue virus spreads when Aedes mosquitoes bite an infected person and then bite another, injecting the virus into blood; vectors bite mainly during daytime. Breeding around homes occurs in clean standing water, in containers such as flower pots, old tires, coconut husks, and water tanks. The report emphasizes preventive measures to curb spread, highlighting vector control and the reduction of standing water to tackle the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の拡大を防ごう
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱・マラリア・チクングニア熱等の通常の季節性媒介感染症が報告されているが、症例数は限定的で予防啓発が主眼の記事であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱等媒介感染症の予防啓発記事。毎年インドで報告される通常の流行パターンであり、既知の対応可能な公衆衛生課題と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: Οι ΗΠΑ δεσμεύονται για πρόσθετη χρηματοδότηση
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: The United States commits to additional funding.
article.articleSummary: United States commits an additional $267 million to fight Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), bringing total U.S. health and humanitarian assistance to $887 million and underscoring the largest global contribution. The State Department urged other resource-rich countries to scale up burden-sharing amid the urgent health crisis. In August, UN Secretary-General António Guterres called for about $1.1 billion to support a comprehensive aid plan. Despite efforts, MSF warns the outbreak is not subsiding but moving. The DRC faces its 17th Ebola outbreak in history, the deadliest documented there, centered in a province and officially declared late, according to experts. The national INSP in Kinshasa reports 3,639 deaths out of 7,541 laboratory-confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：米国が追加資金拠出を表明
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続し死者3,639人・確認症例7,541人に達しており、国際的な資金支援・拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける第17次エボラ流行と国際資金拠出に関するもの。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: US releases additional US$267mil to combat Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread to new areas. The United States announced an additional US$267 million in funding to support the response, bringing total US health and humanitarian aid to US$887 million and making Washington the largest contributor for the latest outbreak. The announcement was made on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, as UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres seeks about US$1.1 billion in additional funding. Congolese public health officials report the epidemic has killed more than 3,600 people and infected about 7,500 since mid-May, marking the DRC’s worst recorded Ebola outbreak. MSF notes continued geographic spread within the DRC. The report provides no laboratory confirmation details, infection source, or imported/exported-case information.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱の流行対策に追加で2億6700万米ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における過去最悪規模のエボラ出血熱流行が継続的に拡大しており、国際的な資金支援が行われるなど社会的・政治的関心が極めて高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 米国はDRCのエボラ対応への資金拠出国であり発生国ではないため、verified_locationsから除外した。記事には検査確認情報や感染源、輸出入症例に関する情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: HIV diagnoses drop, but 128,000 Filipinos may be unaware they're infected
article.articleSummary: HIV diagnoses in the Philippines fell to 2,994 in April–June 2026, down 39% from Q2 2025, though infections may not mirror diagnosis trends. As of June, about 288,000 people live with HIV, with 159,997 diagnosed (56%), leaving roughly 128,000 potentially unaware of their status. In Cordillera, an estimated 2,700 PLHIV had 1,403 diagnosed (52%). Nationally, 111,154 were on antiretroviral therapy, while 32,610 were lost to follow-up (no refill within 30 days). Among treated individuals who had a viral load test in the past 12 months, 97% were suppressed, but only 59% had a recorded test, leaving outcomes unknown for many. Age distribution among new diagnoses: 15–24 years = 918 (31%), 25–34 years = 1,294. Preventive efforts showed progress with 9,640 new PrEP enrollments in the quarter, up 10%.

triage.headline_ja: HIV診断数は減少するも、フィリピン人約12万8000人が感染に気づいていない可能性
triage.triage_reason: HIVの慢性的・既知の流行状況に関する統計報告であり、新規性・緊急性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 定例的な保健統計報告であり、既知の慢性感染症（HIV）の動向に関する内容。突発的な公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。

article.articleHeadline: One-Pot CRISPR Test Spots Deadly Mpox Clade in 40 Minutes
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) clade I outbreaks, including the 2024 Ib sublineage and widespread 2025 cases worldwide (52,845 confirmed, 215 deaths), underscore the need for rapid, field-ready diagnostics. Researchers report a one-pot diagnostic that combines recombinase polymerase amplification (RPA) with CRISPR/Cas12a, delivering a fluorescent signal readable by smartphone in about 40 minutes without thermal cyclers. The assay discriminates clade I by using crRNA-I-2 and clade I–targeted primers; it uses a compartmentalized tube sleeve to keep RPA and CRISPR reagents separate during the 20-minute amplification at 39°C and then release the CRISPR mix into the reaction for a 20-minute readout at 37°C. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, pediatric cases dominate, with ~70% of confirmed cases in under-15s and ~88% of fatalities, highlighting higher virulence and the need for rapid genomic surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: One-Potで動くCRISPR検査、致死性Mpoxクレードを40分で検出
triage.triage_reason: 新規診断技術に関する記事であり、DRCにおけるMpox clade Iの疫学情報は既知の背景情報として言及されているのみで新規事象ではないため、続報を注視するレベルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は診断技術（CRISPR検査法）の開発であり、DRCの疫学データは背景説明として引用されている。既存のMpox clade Iアウトブレイクに関する新規情報はないため、フルRRAよりも技術動向としての経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: A serious outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus is one of the largest on record, with more than 7,200 confirmed cases and about 3,500 deaths as of mid‑September 2026. Declared in May 2026, it spans seven provinces and 62 health zones; WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. The crude case fatality ratio is ~48%. In the first 100 days, the DRC reported 5,458 cases and 2,606 deaths. About 60% of Ebola deaths occur outside treatment facilities, with hunger and HIV/AIDS care disruptions reported. International response includes over 330 tonnes of emergency supplies and 300+ experts; laboratory capacity reached ~3,000 tests per day, but the $1.3 billion plan is only about 49% funded. No approved tools for Bundibugyo; Ervebo vaccine used for frontline workers but not routinely recommended for Bundibugyo; two candidate vaccines are in early UK/Canada safety trials. Limited spread beyond Central Africa includes 20 cases and two deaths in Uganda and one case diagnosed in France.

triage.headline_ja: 深刻な感染爆発
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる大規模流行（7,200例超、致死率約48%）でWHOがPHEICを宣言、ウガンダ・フランスへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・フランスへの拡大は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めず。資金は必要額の約49%しか確保されておらず、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: A Single Histone Tag Decides Whether Malaria Parasites Commit to
article.articleSummary: Malaria parasite Plasmodium yoelii uses a ubiquitin-dependent epigenetic switch to decide sexual commitment (gametocytogenesis), essential for transmission to mosquitoes. In a Nature Microbiology study by Zhiwei Jiao, Lirong Lin, Ruoyu Tang and colleagues from Xiamen University and Tongji University (China), deletion of E2 enzyme Rad6B disrupted gametocyte production and severely impaired oocyst formation in the mosquito midgut, with parasite levels in mice similar to wild-type, indicating a transmission-specific defect. Rad6B partners with RING-type E3 ligase Tex1; both require catalytic activity. The Rad6B-Tex1 complex monoubiquitinates histone H2B, enabling H3K4me3 at the ap2-g promoter and triggering ap2-g expression; loss of this modification suppresses sexual commitment. ChIP-seq and CUT&Tag-seq show reduced H2B monoubiquitination at target loci in mutants. The mechanism is conserved in Plasmodium falciparum, linking a single histone modification to malaria transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 単一のヒストン修飾がマラリア原虫の伝播への運命を決定する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリア原虫の遺伝子・エピジェネティクス機構に関する基礎研究論文であり、実際の感染症発生・アウトブレイクに関する情報ではない。
triage.notes: 研究は中国・厦門大学等で実施されたが、実際のマラリア発生事例ではなく基礎研究であるため、地域は対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: அண்ணாமலைப் பல்கலை. வளாகத்தில் டெங்கு தடுப்புப் பணிகள்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue prevention measures on the Annamalai University campus.
article.articleSummary: On September 23, 2026, dengue prevention measures were implemented at the Annamalai University campus in Chidambaram, within the Annamalai Nagar municipality, Tamil Nadu, as dengue fever cases rise. District authorities ordered intensified sanitation to curb transmission. At the university, dengue-control teams conducted vector-control operations at the Golden Jubilee Hostel and surrounding government buildings. They identified and eliminated mosquito-breeding sites across water storage tanks, rooftops, kitchens, parking-area parapets, and the hostel precincts. The operation was led by Municipal Executive Officer S. Sakul Ameetu, with junior assistants T. Ramesh and R. Bharathidasan, solid-waste supervisors Senthilnathan and Sathyanathan, and office staff participating. The efforts aim to reduce campus mosquito breeding and prevent dengue outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: アンナーマライ大学キャンパスでデング熱予防対策実施
triage.triage_reason: 地方大学キャンパスでの通常のデング熱媒介蚊対策・衛生対応であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: デング熱症例数の増加が言及されているが具体的な患者数・重症度データは記事に含まれず、通常の季節的な予防活動に関する報道と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: Επιπλέον 267 εκατ. δολάρια από τις ΗΠΑ για την αντιμετώπιση της επιδημίας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: An additional $267 million from the United States to combat the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: United States allocates an additional $267 million to combat the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The funding, announced at the United Nations General Assembly in New York, will bolster containment and response efforts across the country. With this tranche, Washington has provided $887 million in direct health and humanitarian assistance to fight the Ebola epidemic to date, the largest contribution to the effort. At the end of August, UN Secretary-General António Guterres urged raising about $1.1 billion to implement an aid plan for the outbreak. The DRC’s Ebola outbreak, the 17th in the nation’s history and the deadliest in recent memory, has claimed 3,639 lives among 7,541 laboratory-confirmed infections, according to the National Institute of Public Health (INSP) in Kinshasa. Doctors Without Borders warned the outbreak is moving rather than subsiding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で流行：米国が疫病対策のためさらに2億6700万ドルを追加拠出
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7,541例の確定感染・3,639人の死亡という大規模かつ致死的なエボラ流行が継続中であり、国際的な資金支援・国連関与が発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 史上17回目のDRCエボラ流行で過去最悪の致死数。国境なき医師団が流行拡大（収束していない）と警告しており、フルRRAでの継続評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Indea confirma seis casos de raiva animal em cavalos e bovinos em duas cidades de Mato Grosso - Só Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indea confirms six cases of animal rabies in horses and cattle in two cities in Mato Grosso - Só Notícias
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in Mato Grosso, Brazil: six cases—one horse and five cattle—across two rural properties in Dom Aquino and Rondonópolis. Following confirmation, authorities implemented vaccination within a six-kilometer radius of the affected properties; the Dom Aquino control area covers 48 rural properties, while Rondonópolis encompasses 139 farms. Cases were identified after animals died; samples tested positive for the rabies virus. Rabies is a severe, fatal disease affecting the central nervous system of mammals, capable of impacting livestock and humans; transmission occurs through bites from infected animals, primarily bats. The article notes the disease is not contagious.

triage.headline_ja: インデアがマトグロッソ州の2都市で馬と牛に動物狂犬病6例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 家畜（馬・牛）における動物狂犬病の発生であり、人間感染例の報告はなく、当局が既にワクチン接種等の対応を実施している。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、社会的関心も限定的と考えられる。
triage.notes: 動物間（馬・牛）での狂犬病発生であり、人への感染事例は報告されていない。地方当局によるワクチン接種等の対応が既に実施されており、管理可能な事案と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 추석 해외여행 감염병 주의보...든든한 방역계획 필수[명절 e건강~쏙]
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chuseok Overseas Travel Infectious Disease Alert... A Solid Infection Control Plan Is Essential [Holiday e-Health: Quick Take]
article.articleSummary: Japan reports 549 measles cases through August; travelers to Japan should verify prior measles immunization (MMR) and seek vaccination advice if not fully vaccinated. An earlier-than-usual influenza season is underway in Japan; travelers should practice hand hygiene and wear masks if symptomatic. For Southeast Asia trips (Vietnam, Thailand, Philippines), dengue fever risk exists; prevent mosquito bites with long-sleeved clothing and effective repellents, following product instructions. In China, vigilance for human infections with avian influenza is advised; avoid poultry farms and live poultry markets, and confirm entry quarantine requirements and designated quarantine areas. Food and water safety is emphasized: wash hands with soap for 30 seconds, cook foods thoroughly, boil water, and thoroughly wash vegetables and fruit. After returning, report fever or other symptoms to quarantine officers; within 2 weeks of Southeast Asia travel, inform providers of travel history and exposures if dengue is suspected. Check KDCA’s Overseas Infectious Diseases NOW; 24-hour call center 1339 operates during holidays.

triage.headline_ja: 秋夕(チュソク)海外旅行感染症注意報...万全な防疫計画が必須[名節 e健康チェック]
triage.triage_reason: 新規のアウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、既知の季節性・地域的感染症リスク（日本の麻疹・インフル、東南アジアのデング熱、中国の鳥インフル警戒）についての旅行者向け一般的注意喚起記事であるため、シグナルとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は韓国KDCAによる旅行者向け一般的な感染症予防ガイダンスであり、特定の新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。日本(麻疹549例、早期インフル流行)は対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tidak Seberbahaya Covid; Ini Kisah Nyata Terserang Influenza Tipe A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not as Dangerous as COVID; A Real-Life Story of Contracting Influenza Type A.
article.articleSummary: Influenza Type A infection described in a user-generated account from Palembang, Indonesia, contrasting with COVID-19. The author recounts days of self-isolation after onset following normal activity, with sore throat, fatigue, and fever rising to 39.3°C, plus chills and body aches. Fever prompted self-treatment with paracetamol; the author notes preserved sense of smell, unlike their prior COVID-19 experience. The narrative emphasizes that, when managed properly, Influenza A is not as dangerous as COVID. It also contextualizes air quality in Palembang, which has been poor for weeks due to forest-fire smoke (haze). There is no mention of laboratory confirmation or vaccination information. No formal diagnosis or reported case counts are provided beyond this personal account, published on 24 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: COVIDほど危険ではない;インフルエンザA型に感染した実体験の物語
triage.triage_reason: 個人のブログ記事による単一の体験談であり、検査確定や症例数の報告もなく、公衆衛生上の異常性や社会的関心の高まりを示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 個人ブログの体験談であり、検査確認・症例数・公的機関の関与に関する情報なし。インフルエンザAは季節性疾患として一般的であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Kiểm soát nguy cơ sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Controlling the Risk of Dengue Fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Thanh Hóa Province, Vietnam, as of 13 September 2026, totals 104 cases or suspected cases, down 32 from the same period in 2025. Week 37 (7–13 Sept) recorded 4 cases, down 6 from the previous week; no deaths and no community outbreak, with case numbers remaining low for several weeks. Authorities emphasize proactive, ground-level prevention: risk surveillance, community guidance on eliminating mosquito breeding sites, and early intervention. Hà Trung District’s Health Center directs health stations to spray disinfectants and clean environments. In 9 months of 2026, communes under Hà Trung reported no dengue cases, yet preventive measures persist; in Hà Tiến, June surveillance flagged two high larval indices, prompting chemical spraying, environmental sanitation, and larval control in two villages with ongoing monitoring. Public education urges covering water containers, removing stagnant water, releasing fish, and reporting risk factors. Northern regions report 240 dengue cases, down 55% weekly, year-to-date 5,225 cases, up 64% YoY; Thanh Hóa remains lower, underscoring the need for sustained surveillance and community action. Dr. Đỗ Thái Hòa highlights continued cross-sector risk management and household vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱リスクの管理
triage.triage_reason: タンホア省でのデング熱症例は前年より減少し、死亡例や集団発生もなく、通常の予防活動が行われている状況であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 地方衛生当局による定例的な予防活動の報告記事であり、症例数は前年同期比で減少傾向。北部地域全体では前年比64%増加しているが、タンホア省自体は低水準を維持している。

article.articleHeadline: 彰化出現本土登革熱！30多歲男無出國史　「發燒未改善」二度就醫確診 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Local dengue fever appears in Changhua! A man in his 30s with no history of international travel—“Fever did not improve” diagnosed on his second medical visit - Minshi News Network.
article.articleSummary: One locally transmitted dengue fever case was confirmed in Changhua City, Changhua County, Taiwan. A man in his 30s with no international travel history developed fever in early September and was diagnosed with dengue virus type 1 on September 17; he is hospitalized and his close contacts show no symptoms. The source of infection remains undetermined. Local health authorities have implemented emergency vector-control measures around the patient’s residence and activity areas, conducted mosquito density surveys, environmental risk assessments, and intensified breeding-site elimination and public education. Nationally, 2026’s dengue total stands at 11 cases—10 in Kaohsiung, 1 in Changhua—out of 168 confirmed cases by Sept 17, including 157 imported cases from Vietnam (38), Indonesia (28), the Philippines (20), and other Southeast Asian nations. Globally, dengue activity remains high; by August 2026, over 2.22 million cases were reported, with rising trends in Vietnam, Malaysia, Bangladesh, the Philippines, Cambodia, and Sri Lanka.

triage.headline_ja: 彰化で本土感染の登革熱（デング熱）確認！海外渡航歴のない30代男性、「発熱が改善せず」2度目の受診で確定診断
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（対象国外）での局地的な本土感染1例であり、感染源は不明だが重症化や拡大の明確な証拠はない。東南アジア各国（ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピン等）での登革熱増加傾向は言及されているが、これらは輸入症例の由来国としての言及であり、当該国での新規発生事象ではないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（彰化・高雄）における本土感染デング熱症例であり、台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピンは輸入症例の由来国として言及されているのみで、当該記事の発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: पटना में 23 दिन में डेंगू के 140 मरीज मिलने से हड़कंप, पोस्टल पार्क और कंकड़बाग समेत इन इलाकों में बढ़ रहे मरीज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panic in Patna as 140 dengue patients detected in 23 days; cases rising in areas including Postal Park and Kankarbagh.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is surging in Patna, Bihar, with 140 new dengue patients detected in the first 23 days of September, bringing the city’s seasonal total to 307. The outbreak is spreading to areas including Postal Park and Kankarbagh, with nine new cases reported on a recent day and daily tallies of 9–12. Severe illness is seen in some patients, including rapid platelet decline requiring hospitalization. Patna Medical College and Hospital (PMCH) has admitted 55 dengue patients this season and set up a 20-bed dengue ward; Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences (IGIMS) has admitted 79 dengue patients, with five dedicated beds. Civil Surgeon Dr. Yogendra Prasad Mandal urges those with persistent high fever, body pains, weakness, or vomiting to seek medical testing rather than self-medicating, and to eliminate standing water around homes.

triage.headline_ja: パトナで23日間にデング熱患者140人発生、ポスタルパーク・カンカルバーグなどで患者増加し騒動に
triage.triage_reason: インドのビハール州パトナで季節性デング熱の増加が見られるが、既知の風土病であり異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低く、地域医療体制内で対応可能とみられる。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年インドの当該地域で季節的に発生する疾患であり、重症例や入院患者増加は見られるが、外部支援の必要性や国際的拡大の兆候は記事から確認できない。続報で症例数の推移や重症度の変化を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Εμπολα - ΛΔ Κονγκό: Οι ΗΠΑ υπόσχονται επιπλέον βοήθεια 267 εκατομμυρίων δολαρίων
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - DR Congo: US pledges $267 million in additional aid.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: the United States pledges an additional $267 million to help fight the epidemic. To date, Washington has provided $887 million in direct health and humanitarian aid for the outbreak, according to the State Department. At the United Nations General Assembly, Secretary-General Antonio Guterres urged donors to raise about $1.1 billion to implement the aid plan. The outbreak—the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history—continues and has become the deadliest on record for the country, having emerged in a province and been declared official after a delayed response. The latest figures from the national public health institute in Kinshasa report 3,639 deaths among 7,541 laboratory-confirmed infections. RSF warned the outbreak is not subsiding but moving.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 - コンゴ民主共和国：米国が2億6700万ドルの追加支援を約束
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（死者3,639名、感染確認7,541名）が継続しており、国際的な資金支援・関心が高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 米国がDRCのエボラ流行対応に追加資金拠出を表明。史上最悪の流行規模であり、国連事務総長も国際的な資金調達を呼びかけている。RSF（国境なき記者団か関連団体）が流行の拡大継続を警告。

article.articleHeadline: Попова заявила о пике заболеваемости гриппом в России на новогодние праздники
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Popova announced a peak in influenza incidence in Russia during the New Year holidays.
article.articleSummary: Russia's Rospotrebnadzor chief Anna Popova forecasts maximum influenza activity during the New Year holidays and mid-January in the current epidemiological season. The peak may begin as early as the last week of December, depending on which influenza strains predominate. Popova emphasized timely vaccination, noting that post-vaccination immunity should provide reliable protection by the peak period, especially since all three components of the Russian influenza vaccine have been updated. The agency also warned about the risk of spread of new Hong Kong flu and swine flu variants. In response, Health Minister Mikhail Murashko announced procurement of more than 56 million vaccine doses for regional distribution to bolster coverage ahead of the anticipated surge.

triage.headline_ja: ポポワ氏、ロシアにおけるインフルエンザ流行のピークが年末年始にあると発表
triage.triage_reason: ロシアにおける季節性インフルエンザの流行予測であり、対象国での発生事例ではない。異常性や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアの季節性インフルエンザ流行予測。香港型・豚インフルエンザ変異株への言及はリスク警戒としてのものであり、香港・中国での実際の発生事例を示すものではないため、対象国verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Chuva e calor da primavera aceleram criadouros do Aedes em Uberaba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rain and spring warmth accelerate Aedes breeding sites in Uberaba.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 September 2026, Uberaba, Brazil faces increased dengue and other arbovirus risk as spring rains and warmer temperatures accelerate Aedes aegypti breeding. The Municipal Health Department urges ongoing prevention, noting that water accumulation in containers and other sites creates mosquito breeding grounds. Fernanda Luiza Mendonça Oliveira, Director of Health Surveillance, says prevention must be year round and relies on resident cooperation; access for vector control agents to properties is essential for effective work. The department maintains measures including ovitrap monitoring to identify hotspots and guide control efforts. Residents should regularly check yards, plant pots, gutters, water tanks, drains, and other water-holding sites, dedicating a few minutes weekly to eliminate potential breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: 春の雨と暖かさがウベラバでのネッタイシマカ発生源を加速
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の発生ではなく、季節的なAedes蚊の繁殖リスクに関する予防喚起・注意喚起記事であり、具体的な患者数や異常な事態の報告がない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的な蚊媒介性疾患予防の一般的な公衆衛生広報であり、実際のデング熱発生・症例数の報告は含まれていない。ブラジルでは毎年恒例の季節的注意喚起であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo is running short of health workers as Ebola remains out of control, WHO says
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-23, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths across seven provinces, with North Kivu reporting a 73% surge in three weeks. Ituri remains the outbreak’s epicenter, yet the problem is not contained: cases have fallen 26% in Ituri and 15% in Haut-Uele from Aug 31 to Sep 20, while transmission continues to rise in other areas. The outbreak is spreading under difficult conditions due to insecurity, displacement, a health workers’ strike and large population movements. WHO notes the epidemic is still not under control and could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak in deaths if trends persist. Although new Ebola treatment centers are being established, a critical gap persists in staffing: each center requires about 300 health professionals, including anesthetists, hygienists, nurses and GPs, who must be paid to operate.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ制御不能が続く中で医療従事者が不足とWHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで多州にわたり拡大し、死亡者数が2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性があるとWHOが警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行（Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uele等7州）に焦点を当てており、Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されていないため除外。対象国リストにAngolaは含まれないため元々対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Les Etats-Unis débloquent des fonds supplémentaires pour lutter contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States unlocks additional funding to fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 September 2026, the United States announced an additional $267 million to fight the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), bringing total U.S. health and humanitarian aid to $887 million, the largest contribution to date. Washington urged other capable countries to share the burden to address the emergency. The outbreak—DRC’s 17th Ebola epidemic and the deadliest in the country—continues to move rather than recede, according to MSF. It began in Ituri province and was officially declared in mid-May. The latest official tally from the Congolese National Institute of Public Health reports 3,639 deaths and 7,541 cases. In parallel, UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres had called for about $1.1 billion to complete an aid plan.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ対策のため追加資金を拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における過去最悪規模（死者3,639人、症例7,541人）のエボラ流行が継続中で、米国が2億6700万ドルを追加拠出し国連も11億ドルの支援を要請するなど国際的な関心・支援の必要性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 米国は資金拠出国であり流行発生国ではないため対象国リストから除外。イツリ州はDRC国内の一地域として扱い、DRCとして集約。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Nigeria Introduces Health Declaration Forms For Travellers From Affected Countries
article.articleSummary: On 23 September 2026, Nigeria's Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) introduced health declaration forms for travellers arriving from countries with active or relevant Ebola transmission, as part of an updated risk assessment in response to the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The policy requires travellers from Congo and other affected countries to complete the health declaration forms on arrival, while travellers from non-affected countries are exempt from the requirement. Nigeria remains on high alert, with surveillance and preparedness measures continuing as the Ebola situation evolves. The change affects travellers from affected countries only; others remain unaffected.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリアが感染国からの渡航者に対する健康申告書を導入
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での進行中のエボラ出血熱流行を受け、ナイジェリアが渡航制限措置（健康申告書）を導入したことはIHR基準の複数（国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当する。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題は、DRCでのエボラ流行を受けたナイジェリアの渡航対策（健康申告書導入）であり、ナイジェリア国内でのエボラ発生を示すものではない。そのためverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ナイジェリアはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 11 Kasus 'Super Flu' Terdeteksi di Jakarta, Pemprov Minta Warga Tak Panik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 11 Cases of 'Super Flu' Detected in Jakarta, Provincial Government Urges Residents Not to Panic
article.articleSummary: Jakarta reports 11 influenza A(H3N2) subclade K cases as of 19 September 2026, cumulative since January 2026. The national Health Ministry classifies influenza activity as low and seasonal; subclade K is not a new virus but a mutation of seasonal influenza. DKI Jakarta’s Health Department conducts sentinel surveillance for Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) and Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) at five puskesmas and one referral hospital, linked to national and WHO networks to detect upticks early. Influenza vaccines are available at health facilities, including RSUD, but not yet in the program and remain paid; vaccination is said to reduce transmission and severity, with no evidence of subclade K vaccine resistance. Prevention emphasizes handwashing, masking when sick, cough etiquette, rest, and hydration. High-risk groups: young children, elderly, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities. Seek care for rapid breathing, chest retractions, or SpO2 <92%. Nationwide counts: East Java 18; South Kalimantan 18; West Java 12; Jakarta 11; South Sumatra 5; North Sumatra 3; Bali 2; East Nusa Tenggara 2; West Nusa Tenggara 1; North Sulawesi 1; Central Java 1; South Sulawesi 1; Yogyakarta 1.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタで「スーパーフル」11例検出、州政府は住民に冷静な対応を要請
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA(H3N2)亜系統Kの発生だが、インドネシア保健省は季節性・低活動レベルと評価しており重症例やワクチン耐性の証拠はない。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性はあるものの、現時点では深刻度・異常性ともに限定的であり、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 「スーパーフル」という通称がメディア・住民の関心を集めているが、保健当局は既存の季節性インフルエンザの変異株であり新種ではないと説明。全国的な症例数は少数（累計76例、1月以降）で、監視体制（ILI/SARIセンチネル）も機能している。H3N2亜系統Kは国際的にも報告例があるため、今後の拡大動向やワクチン適合性について継続的な情報収集が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: US pledges $267 million more to fight Ebola in central Africa
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-24, the United States pledged an additional $267 million to fight the Ebola outbreak in central Africa, focused mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), bringing the Trump administration’s total commitment to $886 million (including $107 million from HHS). Announced on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, the funds aim to help reach a $2 billion target to contain the disease at its source, including building treatment facilities and providing diagnostics and medical countermeasures for health workers in the field. The outbreak was detected in May and is the second most lethal on record, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. Congolese Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka described it as a major test, noting mobilization of scientific and operational expertise and recently tangible response results.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、中央アフリカのエボラ対策にさらに2億6700万ドルを追加拠出
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行は史上2番目に致死的とされ、米国が巨額の追加支援を表明するなど国際的な政治的関心が高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行への米国の資金拠出が主題。Angola・United Statesは発生地域に含まれるが、記事本文はDRCでの流行に焦点を当てており、Angolaでの発生は言及されていないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழக மக்களே உஷார்! காய்ச்சல் வந்தால் அலட்சியம் வேண்டாம்; இதையெல்லாம் உடனே செய்யுங்க
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tamilians, listen up! If you get a fever, don’t neglect it; do all of these immediately.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases are rising in Tamil Nadu, India, with 301 infections confirmed yesterday, lifting the season total to 17,649 and 9 deaths reported to date. The Tamil Nadu Public Health Department and municipal field teams are intensifying prevention and surveillance, targeting high-incidence areas. Those with fever should seek medical advice promptly, especially children, pregnant women, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals; avoid unnecessary outings, and if symptoms persist, visit a hospital or nearby government health facility. Do not send feverish children to school. Home monitoring is advised; seek care for persistent fever, vomiting, abdominal pain, severe fatigue, or bleeding. Dengue is spread by mosquitoes that breed in standing water around homes; prevention includes door-to-door surveys, removing standing water, covering water storage, and cleaning containers. Use indoor mosquito nets, seal doors/windows, and wear full-coverage clothing. Seasonal rains elevate breeding; community cooperation and timely reporting to health authorities are essential.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥの皆さん、注意を！発熱したら軽視せず、すぐにこれらを実行してください
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の季節的増加であり地域の公衆衛生対応の範囲内だが、感染者数増加と死亡例があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性デング熱の流行で、インド国内の地方保健当局が対応中。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Boletim das Arboviroses: Vitória da Conquista registra 24 casos prováveis de dengue na 37ª Semana Epidemiológica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arboviral Diseases Bulletin: Vitória da Conquista Records 24 Probable Dengue Cases in the 37th Epidemiological Week.
article.articleSummary: Vitória da Conquista, Brazil, reports 24 probable dengue cases in the 37th epidemiological week (Sept 13–19, 2026), with 29 suspected and 5 discarded; 24 remain under investigation as of Sept 21, with no confirmed cases or hospitalizations yet. Dengue cases are distributed across neighborhoods: Patagônia (3), Airton Sena, Bateias, Cruzeiro, Espírito Santo, Jatobá and Kadija (2 each); other areas include Boa Vista, Campinhos, Candeias, Centro Industrial, Felícia, Lagoa das Flores, Primavera, Zabele, and one with no neighborhood specified. Five probable chikungunya cases were reported that week, all under investigation; no hospitalizations. No zika cases were recorded that week. For 2026 to date, Vitória da Conquista has 1,034 dengue notifications, 793 probable, 27 confirmed, and no dengue deaths; chikungunya shows 92 notifications (86 probable, 1 confirmed); zika has 2 notifications (2 probable, 1 confirmed, 1 under investigation). Data from Sinan Online; figures may change with investigations.

triage.headline_ja: アルボウイルス感染症速報：ヴィトーリア・ダ・コンキスタで第37週にデング熱疑い症例24件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 地域の定例疫学週報レベルの情報であり、死亡や入院の報告もなく、異常な増加や国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア熱ともに例年の地方自治体レベルの定例報告であり、重症例・死亡例の報告なし。ジカ熱の新規症例もなし。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: Οι ΗΠΑ δίνουν επιπλέον 267 εκατ. δολάρια για την αντιμετώπιση της επιδημίας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: The United States provides an additional $267 million to combat the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues as the United States pledges an additional $267 million to combat the outbreak, bringing its direct health and humanitarian assistance to $887 million. The State Department said Washington has the largest contribution. At the same time, UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres urged international partners to contribute toward a roughly $1.1 billion relief plan. The outbreak is not receding but moving geographically. DR Congo is facing its 17th Ebola outbreak in its history and, within months, has become the deadliest on record for central Africa. As of 24 September 2026, INSP Kinshasa reports 7,541 laboratory-confirmed infections and 3,639 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：米国が流行対策に2億6700万ドルを追加供与
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続し、7,541例・3,639名の死亡と致死的規模であり、国際的資金拠出や国連事務総長の関与など国際的関心・支援ニーズも高いため、フルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 米国はイベント発生国ではなく資金拠出国であるため、verified_locationsから除外。DRCにおける史上最悪規模のエボラ流行として継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Weasel Bite Linked to Deadly Tick-Borne Virus in Rare Chinese Case
article.articleSummary: Five days after a bite from a Siberian weasel (Mustela sibirica) in Dalian, Liaoning Province, China, a 55-year-old woman developed fever, malaise and diarrhea. Laboratory tests showed thrombocytopenia and multi-organ dysfunction. On day 12 of illness, metagenomic next-generation sequencing detected SFTSV (severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus) in peripheral blood, confirming infection. SFTSV, a Bandavirus in Phenuiviridae, is traditionally tick-borne and primarily transmitted by Haemaphysalis longicornis; outbreaks have been reported in China, South Korea, Japan and Vietnam, with case-fatality rates ranging about 5-20%. While ticks are the main vector, the virus circulates in cattle, goats, dogs, cats, and wild mammals. This case documents a direct mammal-to-human transmission via a bite, implying that wild carnivores could contribute to human exposure, particularly in rural northeastern China.

triage.headline_ja: イタチの咬傷が中国の稀な致死性マダニ媒介ウイルス感染症例と関連
triage.triage_reason: 野生哺乳類（イタチ）咬傷によるSFTSV感染という異例の伝播経路を示す単一症例報告であり、重症化事例だが集団発生やヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はなく、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は中国遼寧省大連での単一症例報告。韓国・日本・ベトナムは既知のSFTS流行地として言及されているのみで、本イベントの発生国ではないため除外。野生哺乳類からの直接感染経路という点で科学的関心は高いが、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Update Terbaru Influenza A 'Subclade K' di RI, Ada 184 Kasus Sejak 2025
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Latest Update on Influenza A 'Subclade K' in Indonesia: 184 Cases Since 2025
article.articleSummary: Influenza A H3N2 Subclade K, nicknamed 'Super Flu', is a mutated subclade of influenza A(H3N2), not a novel virus. Indonesia’s Ministry of Health reports 184 cases from 2025 through week 36 of 2026 across 20 provinces, with the highest counts in DKI Jakarta, East Java, and South Kalimantan. Age distribution among cases: 0–4 years 38%, 5–9 23.4%, 10–17 21.2%, 18–59 15.8%, and >60 1.6%. In week 1–36 of 2026, 22 cases were reported across six provinces, most in DKI Jakarta, Central Java, and South Papua. Surveillance underpinning these figures comes from sentinel ILI-SARI data for 2025 through week 36, 2026. The report focuses on counts and geographic spread; it does not provide details on disease severity or patient outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアにおけるインフルエンザA『サブクレードK』の最新情報：2025年以降184例
triage.triage_reason: 既存のH3N2の変異サブクレードであり新型ウイルスではないと明記されているが、重症度・転帰の情報が欠如しており、複数州にわたる継続的な症例報告のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のH3N2の変異サブクレードであり新規ウイルスではないと明言。メディアが『Super Flu』と呼称し関心を集めているが、重症度データが記載されておらずリスク評価には情報不足。小児（0-9歳）で症例の6割以上を占める点は注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 安特羅與泰國生醫廠簽訂腸病毒71型疫苗經銷合約 明年上半年取證後出貨 | 鉅亨網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Antro signs distribution agreement for Enterovirus 71 (EV71) vaccine with a Thai biomedical manufacturer; shipments to begin after regulatory approval in the first half of next year.
article.articleSummary: Guoguang Biotech's subsidiary Antro signs an exclusive Thailand distribution deal with Biogenetech to introduce the Enterovirus 71 (EV71) vaccine in Thailand. Regulatory approval expected in the first half of 2027, with shipments and market launch planned for Q3 2027. Target market includes about 3 million Thai infants for self-pay and public tender uptake. Thailand HFMD outbreaks in 2025 Jan–Sep totaled around 94,000 cases, with EV71 accounting for roughly 18–19%. The 0–4 year age group at risk is about 2.64 million, with roughly 400,000 newborns annually. Antro highlights Biogenetech’s regulatory, cold-chain, and government-tender expertise to accelerate registration and sales in Thailand. Other overseas markets: Macau approved this year; Vietnam approval imminent; ongoing discussions with Singapore and Malaysia.

triage.headline_ja: 安特羅、タイの生物医薬品メーカーとエンテロウイルス71型（EV71）ワクチンの販売契約を締結、来年上半期の認可取得後に出荷開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン販売契約に関する商業ニュースであり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。タイのHFMD/EV71データは既存の疫学的背景情報として言及されているのみで、異常性や緊急性を示す内容はない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン商業契約のニュースであり、感染症発生の報告ではないため、対象国は特定しなかった。タイの2025年HFMD統計（約94,000例、EV71が約18-19%）は市場背景説明として引用されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: EPS flays government over rise in dengue cases
article.articleSummary: Rising dengue activity in Tamil Nadu is cited amid political dispute over preventive measures. As of September 21, 2026, 17,348 people have been confirmed with dengue in Tamil Nadu, alongside 4,653 scrub typhus cases. AIADMK general secretary Edappadi K. Palaniswami criticized the government and urged a war footing in prevention to contain the spread. Health Minister KG Arunraj countered with historical data, noting that 2017 under Palaniswami's tenure recorded 23,294 dengue cases and 65 deaths. He attributed current detection to 131 testing centres that conducted about 2.23 lakh tests, enabling early treatment. He also stated that medicines and platelet stocks are adequate to manage dengue. The report underscores public health actions in Tamil Nadu while highlighting political controversy surrounding the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: EPS、デング熱患者増加を巡り政府を非難
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱・つつが虫病の症例数は多いが、既知の季節性流行であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められないため、フルRRAには至らないが引き続き経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 政治的논争が主眼の記事であり、感染症そのものの重大な異常性は報告されていない。デング熱・つつが虫病は季節性流行として毎年報告される疾患であり、当局は対応可能としている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Nigeria on red alert
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to expand, with Ituri Province as the epicentre and new cases in North Kivu, Haut-Uélé and Tshopo. As of 20 Sep, the ECDC reports 7,672 confirmed cases and 3,699 deaths, with 886 in isolation and 1,879 recovered; Ituri alone accounts for 5,913 cases and 2,703 deaths across 28 of 36 health zones. The latest period adds 58 cases and 23 deaths. There are currently no licensed vaccines or specific treatments; surveillance, early identification, isolation, contact tracing and infection prevention remain central. Two epidemiologists were deployed to the DRC on 21 Sep to bolster response. Nigeria responds with high alert and enhanced border surveillance: travelers from affected countries must complete the Nigeria Health Declaration Form; others are exempt. The measures aim to reduce importation risk amid regional spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリア、レッドアラート発令
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（7,672症例、3,699死亡）が継続的に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアの水際対策（健康申告書義務化等）を報じているが、実際の流行はDRC国内（イトゥリ州が中心、北キブ・オー＝ウエレ・チョポ州にも拡大）で発生しており、ナイジェリア国内での症例確認は言及されていない。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。致死率が高く、ワクチン・特効薬が未承認である点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 67 dengue cases in Tambaram in 21 days; clogged drains blamed
article.articleSummary: 67 dengue cases in the first 21 days of September in Tambaram, Chennai, account for about one-third of the year’s dengue cases within Tambaram City Municipal Corporation (TCMC) limits. From Jan 1 to Sep 21, TCMC reported 198 dengue cases, with 67 this month. Health officials blame ongoing breeding grounds—garbage, sewage and stagnant water, and clogged drains—for transmission, despite claims of intensified inspections across five zones. The issue was raised at the Aug 31 corporation council meeting; Mayor Vasanthakumari Kamalakannan and former commissioner S Balachander pledged action, though Balachander was transferred on Sep 15 amid tender irregularities. Ward councillors contend numbers may be higher, noting about 20 residents in Ward 65 treated at private hospitals around Tambaram. The report highlights environmental sanitation lapses as a key driver and questions the sufficiency of the municipal response.

triage.headline_ja: タンバラムで21日間に67件のデング熱症例、詰まった排水溝が原因
triage.triage_reason: インド・チェンナイ地域での季節的なデング熱症例増加を報じるローカルニュースであり、WPRO基準の一部（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当するが、IHR基準は該当せず国際的な公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: チェンナイ・タンバラム地区における環境衛生（排水溝の詰まり、ゴミ、汚水）に起因する季節的なデング熱症例増加を報じるローカルニュース。市議会レベルでの対応が議論されているが、重症度（死亡・重症例数）についての具体的情報はなく、国際的拡大の兆候はない。
