article.articleHeadline: Mumbai sees sharp fall in chikungunya, dengue and COVID-19 cases
article.articleSummary: Mumbai’s Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) reports a sharp year-on-year drop in dengue, chikungunya, leptospirosis, gastroenteritis and COVID-19 for June 1–Sept 15, 2026, vs the same period in 2025. Chikungunya fell from 427 to 49; leptospirosis from 493 to 277; dengue from 2377 to 2161; gastroenteritis from 2412 to 2050; COVID-19 from 677 to 162. Malaria rose from 4304 to 5948; H1N1 increased from 65 to 488. With monsoon withdrawal expected around Oct 15, officials credit premonsoon preparedness, surveillance, vector-control, fever surveys, prophylaxis in flood-prone areas, and strict anti-larval measures, plus ward-level and NGO collaboration to curb spread. Healthcare experts advocate broader adult influenza vaccination amid climate-driven shifts in disease patterns. The report focuses on Mumbai’s efforts and outcomes within the cited period.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ、チクングニア熱・デング熱・COVID-19の症例が急減
triage.triage_reason: 多くの疾患は減少傾向だが、マラリアとH1N1が大幅増加しており、季節性感染症の動向として経過観察が必要。緊急性の高い異常事態とは言えない。
triage.notes: 全体として多くの感染症は減少しているが、マラリア（4304→5948）とH1N1（65→488）が顕著に増加している点は注視が必要。ムンバイ市当局は対策の成果を強調しており、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いと判断される。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Heboh Influenza A : makhluk apa lagi itu?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Frenzy: What Other Creature Is That?
article.articleSummary: As of Sept 18, 2026 (week 36), Indonesian influenza surveillance shows 86 of 190 sentinel specimens positive (51%), up from 37% and 22% in prior weeks. Among positives, influenza A H1N1pdm09 dominates (76 cases), with 8 H3N2 and 2 B/Victoria. The so-called super flu refers to influenza A H3N2 subclade K, detected in 13 provinces, mainly East Java and South Kalimantan; however, 74 of 204 H3N2 specimens collected from 2025 to early 2026 were K, peaking in week 40 of 2025 and declining thereafter, with no new cases since week 52. The rise this month is driven by older strains, not a new variant. Transmission is concentrated in Java—East Java most, then Central and West Java. Toddlers bear the heaviest burden (41.9%). Overall influenza activity remains low; seasonal factors include the dry season, forest fires, and volcanic eruptions. IDAI notes about 5% of infected children require hospitalization, mostly under 2 years; most recover in 5–7 days with rest and fluids.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型騒動：それは一体何の生き物？
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの活動増加であり、いわゆる「スーパーフル」(H3N2亜系統K)は既に2025年末から新規検出がなく、今回の増加は既存株によるもので新変異株ではないと記事が明言している。全体活動も低水準。
triage.notes: 記事は「Heboh（大騒動）」というタイトルで社会的な話題性はあるが、内容自体は季節性インフルエンザのサーベイランス報告で、新変異株の出現を否定し沈静化させる趣旨。IDAIによる小児の重症化情報はあるが全体的にリスクは限定的。

article.articleHeadline: No follow-up action after dengue death & infections in Chennai, allege families
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Tamil Nadu and Chennai: A 66-year-old Mugalivakkam resident died on September 17 after testing positive for dengue hemorrhagic fever. Families allege no health officials visited their homes or surveyed neighborhoods for fever clusters or mosquito-breeding sources, calling into question follow-up on reported cases. A Triplicane family reports no field visits after their seven-year-old son’s dengue diagnosis. Health authorities emphasize dengue is notifiable and field staff must survey affected areas, identify mosquito-breeding sites, eliminate stagnant water, and conduct fever surveillance; lapses hinder control. While some hospitals allegedly fail to report dengue, officials stress timely notification and field action by medical and health officers. Tamil Nadu data show 2023: 56,863 cases, 12 deaths; 2024: 46,971 cases, 13 deaths; 2025: 25,585 cases, 12 deaths; as of Sept 19, 2026: 17,049 cases, 9 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでのデング熱による死亡・感染後、追跡調査が行われていないと家族らが訴え
triage.triage_reason: タミルナドゥ州で例年発生している季節性デング熱に関する記事であり、国際的な異常事態ではないが、行政対応の不備や死亡例が報告されており、公衆衛生対応の観点から続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はタミルナドゥ州で毎年流行しており、今回の記事は例年の季節性発生と地域保健当局の対応不備（家庭訪問・蚊媒介源調査の欠如）を指摘する内容。国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限の可能性は低いが、地域住民や当局間での関心は高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: சுவாசத் தொற்று பரவல்; மருத்துவமனைக்கு வரும் மக்கள் முகக்கவசம் அணிய வேண்டும் - சுகாதாரத்துறை அறிவுறுத்தல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of respiratory infections; people visiting hospitals should wear face masks - Health Department advisory.
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu Health Department advisory (Sept 24, 2026) urges all visitors to government and private hospitals to wear face masks to curb respiratory infections. The article notes seasonal changes have coincided with increased illnesses such as dengue fever, COVID-19, chikungunya, and scrub typhus, with respiratory infections spreading through the air. Officials emphasize that mask-wearing, while not mandatory, helps prevent hospital-based transmission, as patients and accompanying relatives often go without masks. The advisory calls for consistent mask use across healthcare facilities to mitigate spread. The piece does not provide specific case or death counts, laboratory-confirmation details, infection sources, or information on imported/exported cases. Location-focused context centers on Tamil Nadu, India. Keywords: outbreak, infection control, vaccination not mentioned, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: 呼吸器感染症の拡大;病院を訪れる人はマスクを着用すべき - 保健局からの指示
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器感染症・デング熱・COVID-19・チクングニア熱・つつが虫病の増加に関する保健局の一般的な注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数や死亡者数、異常な流行拡大の証拠はないため、フルRRAには至らないが継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 複数の既知の季節性感染症（デング熱、COVID-19、チクングニア熱、つつが虫病）が同時に言及されているが、これは新規異常事象ではなく季節的な増加への一般的な公衆衛生対応。具体的な症例数・死亡者数・検査確定情報が不足しているため不明点が多い。

article.articleHeadline: 別讓一盒月餅變百萬罰單！ 新北動保處籲境外肉製品禁入境防非洲豬瘟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't let a box of mooncakes land you a million-dollar fine! New Taipei City Animal Protection Office urges a ban on overseas meat products entering the country to prevent African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: As of Sep 24, 2026, the New Taipei City Department of Animal Protection and Epidemic Prevention urged banning overseas meat and meat products to prevent African swine fever (ASF) importation. Overseas meat products, including meat floss mooncakes and meat-filled pastries, and vacuum-packed items are prohibited. Under Taiwan's Animal Infectious Disease Prevention and Control Act, travelers violating import rules face NT$10,000–NT$1,000,000 in fines; first offenses by travelers from ASF-affected countries within the past three years carry NT$200,000, with second offenses reaching NT$1,000,000. From 2026 through Aug 23, border checks detected 143 ASF nucleic acid–positive pork products: 137 from China, 2 from Vietnam, 4 from Thailand. New Taipei City reports active biosecurity work: disinfecting 6,332 transport vehicles; 102 pig farms visited; 832 inspections; 132 serology tests. Emphasizes disruptions at source, border, and farm levels to reduce ASF risk.

triage.headline_ja: 月餅一箱で百万罰金に！新北市動物保護処、海外肉製品の持込禁止を呼びかけアフリカ豚熱を防止
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（対象国外）における水際検疫・行政啓発に関する記事であり、動物疾病（ASF）に限定され人への健康影響はなく、新規アウトブレイクの報告でもない。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾（対象国リスト外）における水際検疫の行政措置と罰則強化を報じるもの。中国・ベトナム・タイ産の肉製品からASF陽性が検出されたとの記載はあるが、これは台湾の税関検査結果であり、当該国での新規アウトブレイク発生を報じるものではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。動物疾病であり人的健康リスクなし。

article.articleHeadline: Punjab records 384 confirmed swine flu cases, five deaths in last 2 months
article.articleSummary: Punjab reports 384 confirmed H1N1 swine flu cases and five deaths in the last two months, with 2,101 Category-C suspected cases statewide and 43 fresh suspects, including seven new positives on September 22. Last year through September 30, the state had seven confirmed H1N1 cases and no deaths. Ludhiana accounts for the highest burden (104 confirmed infections; 777 Category-C suspected), followed by Patiala (53 confirmed; 134 suspected), SAS Nagar (50 confirmed; 144 suspected), and Jalandhar (25 confirmed; 126 suspected). Rupnagar has two confirmed deaths—the most—while Ludhiana, Jalandhar and Kapurthala report one death each. H1N1 transmits via respiratory droplets; symptoms include fever, chills, cough, sore throat, headaches, body aches, fatigue. Category-C denotes severe symptoms and testing prioritization; hospitals are urged to create flu screening corners and report ILI and H1N1/H3N2 cases. 2026 influenza regulations require health-department approval for private labs/hospitals testing H1N1/H3N2, with concerns about underreporting; district task forces coordinate controls.

triage.headline_ja: パンジャブ州、過去2ヶ月間で確認済み豚インフルエンザ384例、死亡5例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 前年同期比で確認症例数が大幅に増加（7例→384例）し死亡例も5例発生しており、IHR基準（深刻な影響・異常性）を2つ満たすため、フルリスク評価への移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: インド・パンジャブ州における季節性H1N1豚インフルエンザの急増事例。州内の複数地区（Ludhiana, Patiala, SAS Nagar, Jalandhar, Rupnagar等）で確認症例・死亡例が報告されており、州当局が検査体制強化と地区タスクフォースによる対策を実施中。国際的な拡大・渡航貿易制限のリスクは現時点で示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Palaniswami accuses TN govt of failing to contain dengue surge
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu faces a dengue surge with 17,348 dengue cases and 4,653 scrub typhus cases reported as of September 21, and 71 dengue cases confirmed on September 21, per health department figures. In Chennai, AIADMK General Secretary Edappadi K. Palaniswami accuses the Tamil Nadu government of slow action, saying hospitals are under pressure and urgent expansion of treatment facilities and mosquito control is needed. He calls for timely dengue treatment, adequate medicines, beds and doctors, plus frequent medical camps and household vector-control to identify and remove breeding sites. Palaniswami notes infections rose sharply compared with the first 20 days of September 2025 and accuses the government of shifting focus after a student’s death at Anna University. He urges clear field instructions to inspectors and intensified sanitation to curb transmission amid public anxiety.

triage.headline_ja: パラニサミ氏、タミルナードゥ州政府によるデング熱急増の抑制失敗を非難
triage.triage_reason: タミルナードゥ州でデング熱・ツツガムシ病の症例数が増加しているが、季節性の媒介動物感染症であり異常性は低い。政治的批判が主軸の記事で、公衆衛生上の重症度データや国際的拡大の情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 毎年季節性に発生するデング熱・ツツガムシ病の流行で、記事は政治的批判が主題。重症度（入院率・致死率）に関する具体的データがなく、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai Malaria Cases Rise to 9,298 in 2026, 2 Deaths Reported After 3-Year Zero-Fatality Run
article.articleSummary: Mumbai reports 9,298 malaria cases and 2 deaths in 2026 so far, ending a three-year zero-fatality run. As of Sep 2026, cases are about 91.5% of 2025’s total (10,163). June–Sept 1–15 sees 5,984 cases in 2026, up from 4,304 in the same period in 2025. The rise is not a citywide outbreak but concentrated in pockets such as Dongri, Sion and Parel. Plasmodium falciparum cases rose markedly, from 375 in 2015 to 2,382 in 2025, increasing its share from 5.5% to 25.3% of total malaria. Authorities cite better surveillance and detection, alongside potential breeding sites from stagnant water at construction sites, water leakages, and drainage problems. Fever duration has lengthened for some patients (about five days before treatment), contributing to higher hospital admissions. Historical context: 2004 peak with 14,756 cases and 23 deaths, with 2026 still below that level.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイのマラリア症例が2026年に9,298件に増加、3年間死亡ゼロを経て2名の死亡が報告される
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはインドの風土病であり、局地的な季節性増加にとどまる。当局により監視・対応が行われており、過去のピーク（2004年）を下回る水準で、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ムンバイの特定地区（Dongri, Sion, Parel）に限定した季節性マラリア増加。既知の風土病であり、当局は建設現場等の蚊繁殖源対策を実施中。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: चेहरे पर लाल चकत्ते को न समझें सिर्फ एलर्जी, रूबेला के हो सकते हैं संकेत; ऐसे करें पहचान - rubella symptoms what to know about rashes and risks
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't mistake a red rash on the face for just an allergy; it could be a sign of rubella—here's how to identify it. Rubella symptoms: what to know about rashes and risks.
article.articleSummary: Rubella and measles are two viral infections causing rashes. Rubella typically presents with a mild facial rash on the cheeks that spreads to the body, while measles causes higher fever, dry cough, runny nose, red eyes, and Koplik spots, with rashes often starting behind the ears. Rubella is generally mild but is dangerous for pregnant women because maternal infection can lead to congenital rubella syndrome in the fetus, including hearing loss and heart defects. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets; infected individuals should be separated from pregnant women. Management emphasizes rest, fluids, and symptomatic care under a clinician, plus hygiene and covering coughs to limit spread. The article notes a first rubella case in Simdega, Jharkhand, with a child-focused vaccination drive, and cites Bihar’s vaccine gaps affecting about 58,000 children.

triage.headline_ja: 顔の赤い発疹を単なるアレルギーと思わないで、風疹の兆候かもしれません。風疹の症状：発疹とリスクについて知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: 内容は風疹・麻疹の症状説明を中心とした健康教育記事であり、Simdega（ジャールカンド州）での初発症例とビハール州のワクチン接種ギャップ（約58,000人）に言及しているが、大規模な流行や公衆衛生危機を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は健康教育的な内容が主体で、単発症例（Simdega）とワクチン接種ギャップ（Bihar州約58,000人）への言及があるが、具体的な流行状況やアウトブレイクの規模は記載されていない。ワクチン未接種者数が多い点は継続的な感染リスクを示唆するため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: காஞ்சியில் கடந்த 23 நாட்களில் 103 பேருக்கு டெங்கு பாதிப்பு: சுகாதாரத் துறை தீவிர கண்காணிப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kanchipuram, 103 people infected with dengue in the last 23 days: Health department intensifies surveillance.
article.articleSummary: 103 dengue fever cases confirmed in Kanchipuram district, Tamil Nadu, in the first 23 days of September 2026, signaling an ongoing outbreak. Dengue activity has been reported in several Tamil Nadu districts. Health department has intensified surveillance and preventive measures, including special medical camps in high-incidence areas and door-to-door inspections to detect Aedes mosquito larvae in drinking-water containers. Public health officials are urging residents to keep surroundings clean and to ensure water storage containers are covered and not allowing standing water. This rapid increase in dengue cases within a month underscores the need for sustained vector-control efforts across the district and state to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: カーンチプラムで過去23日間にデング熱感染者103人：保健当局が監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域で季節的に発生する既知の感染症であり、IHR基準には該当しないが、症例増加と当局の監視強化が見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド・タミルナドゥ州で毎年発生する風土病であり、本記事は地域レベルでの症例増加と対策強化を報じるもの。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威としての性質は低い。

article.articleHeadline: NCDC: Travellers From Ebola-Hit Countries May Be Required To Complete Health Forms
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-24, Nigeria’s NCDC issued an interim public health advisory requiring travellers arriving from countries with active or relevant Ebola transmission to complete Health Declaration Forms at points of entry to bolster surveillance and prevent importation. Passengers from all other countries are exempt; the form will aid enhanced follow-up for travellers of public health interest. The public is urged to seek medical attention for Ebola-like symptoms and provide travel or exposure history to health authorities. Nigeria remains on high alert; high-risk states include Lagos, FCT, Rivers, Kano, Enugu, Borno, Akwa Ibom, Cross River, Taraba, and Adamawa, with Ogun, Nasarawa, Kaduna, Plateau, Kogi, Niger, Jigawa, Katsina, Bauchi, Ebonyi, Abia, and Bayelsa as moderate risk. WHO declared the Bundibugyo EVD outbreak in DRC a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola spreads via direct contact with body fluids, contaminated materials, or infected animals, not airborne. Nigeria’s National Emergency Operations Centre is activated, coordinating with federal and state actors and international partners (FAAN, Port Health Services, NIS, NCAA, WHO, Africa CDC).

triage.headline_ja: NCDC:エボラ流行国からの渡航者に健康申告書の記入を求める可能性
triage.triage_reason: WHOがDRCのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行をPHEICと宣言しており、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限措置（ナイジェリアでの水際対策強化）が確認されるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアの水際対策（NCDCの健康申告書要求）であり、ナイジェリア国内でのエボラ発生は報告されていない。実際の流行地はDRC（ブンディブギョ型エボラ、WHOがPHEIC宣言）。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Abuja Airport Steps Up Surveillance, Sensitisation
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo virus) triggers Nigeria high alert; Abuja's Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport intensifies sensitisation and preventive measures. FAAN confirms extensive passenger and staff awareness, expanded screening, monitoring, and contact tracing capabilities; completion of health declaration forms is required for travellers at departure, per NCDC alert. NCDC DG Jide Idris says preparedness activities will be reviewed as the epidemiological situation evolves. Travellers from high-risk countries are urged to complete Health Declaration Forms and comply with follow-up; others are exempt for now. In the DRC, as of 20 September 2026, 7,672 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,699 deaths; 886 hospitalised; 1,879 recovered; 58 new cases and 23 deaths since 19 September. Breakdowns: Ituri 38, North Kivu 14, Haut-Uélé 5, Tshopo 1; 79.9% of identified contacts remain under follow-up. Port Harcourt International Airport develops jingles to sensitize travellers, with thermal screening and information reporting similar to COVID-19 measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：アブジャ空港、監視体制と啓発活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で大規模なエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）アウトブレイクが継続しており、確定症例7,672例・死亡3,699例と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、近隣国ナイジェリアが渡航者スクリーニングを強化するなど国際的拡大リスクも認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（アブジャ・ポートハーコート空港）における水際対策強化だが、感染症イベント自体はDRCで発生しているエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo等）。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。死者数・症例数から見て極めて深刻な状況であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya at centre of EAC push to protect trade from disease outbreaks
article.articleSummary: As of 24 September 2026, the East African Community (EAC) estimates $45 million is needed to effectively respond to Ebola and other viral haemorrhagic fever outbreaks, safeguarding cross-border trade centered on Kenya. Uncontained outbreaks threaten regional movement of people and goods, disrupting transport, trade, tourism and business. The EAC trains 120 frontline health workers from eight Partner States in high-consequence diseases (Ebola, Marburg) in Nairobi under the tEACh programme with GIZ and Aga Khan University; experts from Charité Berlin and WHO participate. A Mobile Laboratory Network of 10 labs across seven states supports rapid diagnostics; expansion to 34 by 2027 is planned with KfW. Germany has pledged Sh724.8 million (€4.8m) for Ebola preparedness: training 500 workers, PPE procurement, sensitisation in eastern DRC, and vaccine registration support once WHO approves. Kenya, as a regional trade hub, seeks stronger border readiness to maintain corridors during health emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが東アフリカ共同体（EAC）による感染症流行から貿易を守る取り組みの中心に
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は実際の感染症アウトブレイク発生の報告ではなく、EACによる将来的なエボラ・マールブルグ等の流行に備えた訓練・資金調達・検査体制強化に関する準備活動の記事であるため、シグナルとして扱う根拠が乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアを拠点とするEACの地域準備体制強化（訓練プログラム、モバイル検査室ネットワーク、ドイツからの資金援助）についてであり、実際のエボラ・マールブルグ症例発生の報告ではない。DRC東部への言及も啓発活動支援に関するものであり、現地での実際の発生報告ではないため除外した。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: सात दिवसीय रेबीज जागरूकता कार्यक्रम का हुआ शुभारंभ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Inauguration of a seven-day rabies awareness program.
article.articleSummary: Rabies awareness week inaugurated at Banda Agricultural and Technology University’s Veterinary and Animal Sciences College in Banda, Uttar Pradesh, with a seven-day program from 22 to 28 September 2026. The event targets rural communities and students, including a rabies awareness program and a dog vaccination camp in Mavai Buzurg village. Subject experts Dr. Renu Singh, Dr. Umakant Verma, Dr. Jitendra Singh, and Dr. Deepesh Bharat Mishra discussed rabies causes, transmission, symptoms, and urgent post-exposure steps, emphasizing immediate washing of wounds with soap and running water and seeking medical care promptly. The second phase provided animal health and vaccination guidance to livestock keepers and carried out canine rabies vaccination. Attendees included Associate Dean Dr. Shailendra Chaursia, Dr. Upendra Singh, Dr. Mayank Dubey, and other faculty, students, and staff.

triage.headline_ja: 7日間の狂犬病啓発プログラムが開始
triage.triage_reason: 実際の症例発生報告ではなく、狂犬病啓発週間・予防接種キャンペーンという通常の公衆衛生啓発活動の報道であり、緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な症例発生や感染拡大を報告するものではなく、大学主催の啓発イベント・ワクチン接種キャンペーンの紹介記事であるため、対象国リストへの計上は不要と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Naik di Jatim, Dinkes Kota Probolinggo Antisipasi Sebelum Kasus Muncul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A on the Rise in East Java, Probolinggo City Health Office Anticipates Before Cases Appear
article.articleSummary: East Java sees rising influenza activity; Probolinggo City Health Office has issued preventive education about Influenza A. As of 24 September 2026, there are no reported Influenza A cases in Probolinggo. Authorities emphasize basic prevention: mask use when needed, handwashing, and avoiding unnecessary antibiotics. Educational materials note transmission via coughs/sneezes, close contact, and contact with contaminated hands or objects, with heightened vigilance for young children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with chronic illnesses. Traditional warm drinks are only comforting, not substitutes for medical care. No special outbreak measures are in place; local facilities already use standard influenza SOPs, and would follow them if a case is detected. No influenza A cases were recorded in Probolinggo in the previous year. The outreach aims to raise awareness ahead of broader influenza activity in Jawa Timur.

triage.headline_ja: 東ジャワでインフルエンザA型が増加、プロボリンゴ市保健局が症例発生前に対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: プロボリンゴ市では実際のインフルエンザA症例は報告されておらず、予防的な啓発活動の段階に留まる。特別な発生対策は取られておらず、社会的関心や公衆衛生への深刻な影響も確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザA型に対する予防的教育活動を報じたもので、プロボリンゴ市では症例自体が報告されていない。東ジャワ全体での増加傾向が述べられているが具体的な症例数・重症度データは提供されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Vĩnh Long: 6 người tử vong do bệnh dại trong 9 tháng đầu năm 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vĩnh Long: 6 people die from rabies in the first nine months of 2026.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Vĩnh Long Province, Vietnam: In the first nine months of 2026, the province recorded 6 deaths from rabies following dog bites and identified 4 animal outbreaks via health surveillance. Laboratory testing confirmed rabies virus in all four outbreaks. Risk factors include roaming dogs and cats, incomplete vaccination coverage, and public complacency toward post-bite vaccination. Authorities issued over 600 alerts to the veterinary sector to prompt outbreak verification; the outbreaks were promptly ring-fenced. To curb transmission, the province aims to vaccinate over 80% of the canine and feline population by 2026 and ensure 100% of animals with suspected rabies are sampled for laboratory testing to enable early warning and community protection.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィンロン省：2026年最初の9ヶ月間で狂犬病により6人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はベトナムで流行している疾患であり異常性は低いが、死亡者数と動物間の感染拡大が続いている点から経過観察が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムの一部地域で地域流行しており、今回の記事は特定省（ヴィンロン省）の年次報告に基づく。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないが、動物のワクチン接種率の低さが継続的リスク要因として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: पलानीस्वामी का आरोप- 'डेंगू के बढ़ते मामलों को रोकने में नाकाम तमिलनाडु सरकार'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Palaniswami's accusation: 'The Tamil Nadu government failed to curb the rising dengue cases'
article.articleSummary: AIADMK general secretary Edappadi K. Palaniswami accused the Tamil Nadu government of failing to curb the dengue surge and said hospitals are under pressure, calling for immediate protection for people. Citing health department data, he noted 17,348 dengue cases and 4,653 scrub typhus in Tamil Nadu as of September 21, with 71 dengue-confirmed cases on that day alone. He criticized the government for ignoring warnings to the public and media, and for focusing on a student’s alleged scrub typhus infection after an Anna University death. Challenging the health minister’s claim that dengue is down, Palaniswami asserted infections are rising faster than the first 20 days of September 2025 and accused officials of using outdated data. He urged timely treatment, adequate medicines, beds, doctors, and aggressive vector-control campaigns, including door-to-door campaigns and neighborhood inspections to destroy breeding sites; noting past AIADMK-led measures.

triage.headline_ja: パラニスワミ氏の非難：『デング熱急増を抑制できなかったタミル・ナードゥ州政府』
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・つつが虫病の症例数が多数報告され、病院の逼迫や政治的批判など社会的関心が高まっているため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心ありでフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 本記事は野党政治家による州政府批判が主体であり、疫学的な新規性・異常性は低いが、症例数の多さと病院逼迫、政治的注目度からWATCH以上と判断。今後の症例推移や公式データを注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: पलानीस्वामी का आरोप- 'डेंगू के बढ़ते मामलों को रोकने में नाकाम तमिलनाडु सरकार' | Chennai: AIADMK MLAs leave Assembly after Tamil Nadu floor test
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Palaniswami's allegation - 'The Tamil Nadu government failed to curb the rising dengue cases' | Chennai: AIADMK MLAs leave Assembly after Tamil Nadu floor test.
article.articleSummary: Dengue continues to surge in Tamil Nadu, India, with 17,348 dengue cases and 4,653 scrub typhus cases reported in the state as of 21 September 2026; 21 September alone saw 71 dengue confirmations. AIADMK general secretary Edappadi K. Palaniswami accuses the state government of failing to act swiftly to curb transmission, citing overwhelmed public and private hospitals. He urged immediate expansion of treatment facilities, mosquito control, and vector elimination, including field-based camps and door-to-door awareness. He criticized the absence of the health minister at a disease-control meeting led by the Director of Public Health and accused the government of downplaying warnings. Palaniswami disputed the minister’s claim that dengue is down compared with previous years, asserting infections are rising faster than in September 2025 during the first 20 days. He also linked a recent Anna University student death to scrub typhus concerns and called for rapid emergency actions.

triage.headline_ja: パラニスワミ氏の主張：『タミルナードゥ州政府はデング熱の増加を抑制できていない』｜チェンナイ：AIADMK州議会議員、フロアテスト後に議場を退席
triage.triage_reason: タミルナードゥ州でデング熱17,348例・ツツガムシ病4,653例と報告数が多く、医療機関の逼迫と政治問題化により社会的関心が高まっているため、フルRRAでの精査が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱・ツツガムシ病流行だが、症例数の急増、病院の逼迫、大学生の死亡例、野党による州政府批判など政治的関心の高まりが見られる。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: पलानीस्वामी का आरोप- 'डेंगू के बढ़ते मामलों को रोकने में नाकाम तमिलनाडु सरकार' - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Palaniswami's allegation - 'Tamil Nadu government failed to curb the rising dengue cases' - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu, India, faces rising dengue cases as AIADMK general secretary Edappadi K. Palaniswami accuses the state government of failing to curb spread, warning hospital beds are filling up and urgent protection is needed. Health department data show 17,348 dengue and 4,653 scrub typhus cases in the state up to 21 September, with 71 dengue cases confirmed on 21 September. Palaniswami criticized the government for ignoring public warnings and cited a student’s death at Anna University to claim focus shifted to scrub typhus. He noted the Health Minister Arunraj was absent from a dengue-control meeting chaired by the Director of Public Health, and challenged the minister’s claim that dengue is down from previous years, saying infections surged faster in the first 20 days of September 2025. He urged immediate field action: timely treatment, adequate medicines, beds, and doctors, plus door-to-door campaigns to locate and destroy breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: パラニスワミ氏の非難：『タミルナドゥ州政府はデング熱の増加を抑えるのに失敗した』 - Punjab Kesari
triage.triage_reason: タミルナドゥ州でデング熱1.7万件超、つつが虫病4,600件超と多数の症例が報告され、病院病床逼迫や州政府対応への政治的批判が高まっているため、WPRO基準（重症度・流行しやすさ）と社会的関心の両方に該当する。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱・つつが虫病の増加であり新規性・国際拡大リスクは低いが、症例数の急増と政治的関心の高まりからフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai Malaria Surge 2026: मुंबई में मलेरिया का प्रकोप; मरीजों की संख्या 9,298 पार, 3 साल बाद संक्रमण से 2 मौतें दर्ज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mumbai Malaria Surge 2026: Malaria outbreak in Mumbai; patient count surpasses 9,298, two deaths from infection recorded after 3 years.
article.articleSummary: Malaria surge in Mumbai, India, as of Sep 15, 2026: total malaria cases 9,298; 2 deaths this year after zero in 2023–2025. Monsoon period (Jun–Sep) accounts for 5,984 cases, up from 4,304 last year. Plasmodium falciparum cases rise 535% since 2015 (375 to 2,382 by 2025), now 25.3% of total malaria in Mumbai, risking cerebral malaria and organ failure. Symptoms now include fever lasting 4–5 days, severe chills, and weakness, with longer hospitalizations. Public health officials say the outbreak is not citywide but concentrated in hot spots Dongri, Sion, and Parel. Key drivers: water stagnation at construction sites (metro, flyovers, redevelopment), pipe leaks, and clogged drains. Public health advice: eliminate standing water, regularly clean coolers and planters, and seek blood tests rather than self-medicating; blood tests for confirmation. Data current to Sep 15, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ・マラリア急増2026：ムンバイでマラリア発生、患者数が9,298人を超え、3年ぶりに感染による死者2人を記録
triage.triage_reason: ムンバイでマラリア患者数が9,298人に達し3年ぶりに死者が発生、P.falciparum比率が急増し重症化リスクが高まっているため、社会的関心とWPRO基準複数該当によりフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にJammu and Kashmir、Madhya Pradeshが含まれるが、記事の主題はムンバイ（マハーラーシュトラ州）に限定されているため、Indiaとしてまとめて計上。

article.articleHeadline: Trì hoãn phẫu thuật 3 năm, người phụ nữ nhiễm trùng huyết, áp xe cột sống
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three-year delay in surgery leaves a woman with sepsis and spinal abscess.
article.articleSummary: 62-year-old woman from Vinh Long, Vietnam, presented after a three-year delay in spine surgery due to fear, with epidural abscess compressing neural structures and bilateral psoas abscess. MRI and labs showed severe infection; culture grew Escherichia coli. She has type 2 diabetes, hypertension, osteoporosis, and chronic adrenal insufficiency. Management followed a stepwise approach: resuscitation, glycemic control, correction of systemic derangements, and culture-guided antibiotics. Once stabilized, surgeons performed decompression, abscess drainage, and posterior spinal stabilization across the lumbar–sacral region. The six-hour operation faced inflamed tissue, nerve edema, osteopenia, and significant bleeding; infected tissue was removed, nerves freed, and the spine stabilized. Postoperatively, antibiotics continued and wound healing progressed. At discharge, lower-limb strength remained 2/5, but she could sit with a brace and begin standing and ambulating with assistance. The report stresses timely surgical evaluation and warns against delaying surgery in elderly or immunocompromised patients.

triage.headline_ja: 手術を3年間延期した結果、女性が敗血症と脊椎膿瘍を発症
triage.triage_reason: 個別患者の症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の脅威や集団発生を示す内容ではないため、シグナルとしての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は個別患者（62歳女性）の症例報告であり、E. coliによる敗血症・脊椎膿瘍という個人の医療事例。感染症のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上のリスクを示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 외교부, 에볼라 대응에 1천800만달러 규모 지원 발표
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foreign Ministry Announces $18 Million in Support for Ebola Response
article.articleSummary: Ebola response funded with US$18 million to address the outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. On Sept 23, at a New York G20 foreign ministers meeting, Jang Uk-jin, Global Multilateral Diplomacy Coordinator, announced the pledge and said Seoul will continue contributing to the international Ebola response. The commitment recalls lessons from the 2014 Ebola crisis and emphasizes international cooperation led by the G20. The meeting followed the G7 Evian Summit declaration urging action on Ebola outbreaks and discussed international collaboration and financial contributions for Ebola containment. The report provides no details on case counts, deaths, or laboratory confirmation. Published Sept 24, 2026 by Yonhap News Agency.

triage.headline_ja: 外交部、エボラ対応に1800万ドル規模の支援を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対し、G20外相会合で韓国が1800万ドルの追加支援を表明するなど、国際的な関心・対応が高まっていることから、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的拡大リスクの観点でIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱への国際支援（韓国の資金拠出）に関する外交ニュースであり、症例数・死亡者数など疫学的詳細は記載されていない。ニューヨーク・米国・韓国は会議開催地・支援表明国であり、発生地域には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: US Pledges $267 Million More in Ebola Aid to Congo
article.articleSummary: United States pledges an additional $267 million in direct life-saving health and humanitarian assistance to Congo’s Ebola outbreak, bringing total U.S. aid to $887 million. Announced at the U.N. General Assembly, the package is coordinated with the CDC alongside Congo, Uganda, and regional partners. Funds will supply health commodities, Ebola treatment units, health facilities, burial teams, PPE, and expanded surveillance and contact tracing. The outbreak began in Ituri province, northeastern Congo, and has spread to Uganda; WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. As of Sept. 22, the UN counts at least 3,700 deaths. The UN plan totals $2.13 billion with 48% funded, leaving about $1.1 billion in gaps. The pledge supports a G7 commitment and comes with a five-year Congo health MOU (up to $900 million) covering HIV, TB, malaria, maternal/child health, and surveillance. The situation is described as multiple outbreaks rather than a single epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴのエボラ支援に2億6700万ドルを追加拠出
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴからウガンダへ国境を越えて拡大し、WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済みで、死者数も多数（3,700人以上）に上るため、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国はイベントの主題ではなく支援拠出国であるため対象国リストに含めない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHOはPHEICを宣言済みであり、既にフルRRA相当の重大イベントとして継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 276 Fall Ill in Suspected Free Meal Food Poisoning in Central Java
article.articleSummary: At least 276 people, ranging from a 10‑month‑old infant to the elderly, fell ill in Batang, Central Java, in a suspected mass food poisoning linked to Indonesia's Free Nutritious Meals program (MBG) in Bawang district. No deaths reported. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and weakness; some required hospital treatment as facilities were strained. The MBG kitchen serves about 2,700 beneficiaries across 11 institutions; affected individuals include students and parents, with some meals brought home by children. The kitchen has been temporarily suspended pending laboratory testing to identify the cause. Local government will cover medical costs. Investigations examine preparation and distribution; cooking occurred circa 2–9 a.m. on Wednesday before lunchtime. This incident adds to broader MBG food-safety concerns; JPPI records 43,838 MBG-related cases across 36 provinces since January 2025 through August 2026, with prior suspensions in Sidoarjo.

triage.headline_ja: 中部ジャワで無料給食による集団食中毒疑い、276人が発症
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒による集団発症事例であり感染症（人-人感染）ではないが、大規模給食プログラムの構造的な食品安全問題を示唆するため継続監視が望ましい。
triage.notes: 本事例は食中毒（食品由来）であり感染症の伝播事案ではないが、Free Nutritious Meals(MBG)プログラム全体で2025年1月から2026年8月までに36州で43,838件の関連事例が記録されているとの記述があり、構造的な食品安全リスクとして経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A pada Anak: Tanda Harus ke IGD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A in Children: Signs That Require an ER Visit
article.articleSummary: Influenza cases surge in Indonesia. Ministry of Health surveillance shows influenza positivity at 46% as of 19 September 2026, up from 35% previously. Of 185 specimens in week 36, 86 were positive, dominated by A(H1N1)pdm09 (76), with A(H3N2) (8) and B/Victoria (2); COVID-19 positivity remained 1.45%. IDAI warned on Instagram during 18 September seminar that children 0–17 are twice as likely to develop flu symptoms due to immature immunity, shorter stature, and developing airways. Flu spreads by droplets and surfaces; the virus can persist up to 48 hours on hard surfaces and 8–12 hours on soft. Seek care if three signs appear: reduced activity after fever ends, poor fluid intake, or no urine for >4 hours despite fluids. ER is urgent for breathing with chest retractions, cyanosis, seizures, dehydration, or drowsiness. Contagious period starts 24 hours before to 5 days after onset; return after 1 fever-free day. Medan, Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: 小児のA型インフルエンザ：救急外来受診が必要なサイン
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで季節性インフルエンザ（主にA(H1N1)pdm09）の陽性率が上昇しているが、新規株や異常な重症化の報告はなく、通常の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（A(H1N1)pdm09が優勢）の陽性率上昇に関する保健省サーベイランスデータと小児科医会からの注意喚起。重症例・死亡例の具体的報告はなく、通常の季節性流行として経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: NCDC places Nigeria on high alert - Blueprint Newspapers Limited
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak risk prompts Nigeria's NCDC to place the country on high alert. An interim public health advisory dated September 22, 2026 restricts completion of Nigeria's Health Declaration Form to travelers arriving from countries with active or relevant EVD transmission; travelers from all other countries are exempt. The measure follows a dynamic risk assessment of the EVD outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and consultations with public health experts and the Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare. Nigerians are urged to remain vigilant for EVD symptoms and seek medical attention promptly if they occur; travelers should disclose relevant travel or exposure history where applicable. Nigeria's preparedness and response measures continue in collaboration with FAAN, Port Health Services, Nigeria Immigration Service, Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority, State Ministries of Health, WHO and Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリアNCDCが警戒レベルを引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを受け、ナイジェリアが渡航者への健康申告制度を導入するなど国際的な対応措置が取られており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生中のエボラアウトブレイクに対するナイジェリアの予防的水際対策であり、ナイジーリア国内での発生は報告されていない。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Hari Rabies, KPKP Jaksel beri layanan kesehatan hewan di Blok M
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies Day, South Jakarta's KPKP provides veterinary health services in Blok M.
article.articleSummary: Rabies Day activities in South Jakarta's Blok M see Sudin KPKP Jakarta Selatan delivering veterinary health services to stray cats, including health checks, light treatment, and rabies vaccination, ahead of World Rabies Day on 28 September. The drive aims to reach 200 stray cats across five service points: Pasaraya, Blok M Hub/Taman Literasi, Blok M Square, Melawai Plaza/Taman Sepeda, and Area Gereja/Sentraya/BNI. About 60 volunteers from the district’s KPKP office, cat-lover groups, local authorities, and sponsors are joining to provide care, food, medicines, and cat identification. The initiative reinforces Jakarta’s rabies-free status since 2004 and forms part of ongoing rabies control efforts in the capital.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病デー、南ジャカルタKPKPがブロックMで動物医療サービスを提供
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は世界狂犬病デーに向けた予防的な動物ワクチン接種活動の紹介であり、ジャカルタは2004年以降狂犬病フリーの状態を維持しているため、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の発生事例ではなく、予防的な動物ワクチン接種キャンペーン（World Rabies Day関連）の広報記事である。ジャカルタは狂犬病フリー地域として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Ungkap 7 Gejala Influenza A, Cek Kelompok yang Rentan Terkena
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Reveals 7 Symptoms of Influenza A, Check Which Groups Are at Risk of Infection
article.articleSummary: Indonesia reports rising influenza activity, with Week 36 specimens testing positive at 51%, up from 37% the prior week. The dominant influenza A subtype is H1N1pdm09. Most cases are in East Java, Central Java, and West Java, while toddlers account for 41.9% of detections. Despite the uptick in detection, influenza activity in health facilities nationwide remains low and appears to follow normal seasonal patterns, with ongoing government surveillance. Symptoms of influenza A can range from mild to more severe, and most cases recover on their own; monitoring is advised for worsening or persistent symptoms. The data come from the Ministry of Health’s surveillance and a September 23, 2026 public update, indicating sustained monitoring across 38 provinces. No details on infection source or imported/exported cases are provided in this report.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がインフルエンザAの7つの症状を発表、感染しやすい層を確認
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1pdm09)の検出率上昇が報告されているが、医療機関での活動は依然低く例年通りの季節パターンとされ、重症度・異常性・国際的拡大のいずれも認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD di Ciamis, 5 Orang Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Cases in Ciamis, 5 People Have Died.
article.articleSummary: Ciamis Regency Health Office, West Java, reports dengue cases declined January–August 2026, but fatalities rose to five. A total of 322 residents were confirmed positive, with most recovering after hospital care; fatalities mainly involve children and adolescents. Monthly counts: Jan 47, Feb 44, Mar 43, Apr 51, May 44, Jun 43, Jul 27, Aug 12. Of the cases, 164 were male and 147 female. Health official Edis Herdis notes the dry season has not caused a drastic rise in Aedes aegypti, but urges vigilance for high fever. To prevent rebound, Dinkes Ciamis continues education via One House One Jumantik and Mosquito Nest Eradication, and urges 3M practices (drain, close, bury) and PHBS to curb dengue by year-end.

triage.headline_ja: チアミスでデング熱患者相次ぐ、5人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 西ジャワ州チアミス県で季節性デング熱の報告があり死亡者5名だが、症例数自体は減少傾向で異常性は低く、地域の風土病的流行の範囲内と判断されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアの風土病であり、症例数は前年比で減少傾向。死亡者数増加は懸念材料だが、地方自治体レベルでの対応（3M運動、蚊媒介対策）が継続中であり、外部支援の必要性は現時点で示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 외교부 "에볼라 대응에 1,800만달러 규모 지원
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foreign Ministry to provide $18 million in support for Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: $18 million (about 250 billion won) pledged by the government to support Ebola response focused in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, announced by Global Multilateral Diplomacy Coordinator Jang Uk-jin at the G20 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting in New York on Sept. 23, 2026. The funding aims to bolster international Ebola control efforts and preparedness, highlighting lessons from the 2014 outbreak and stressing G20-led cooperation. The meeting, a follow-up to the G7 Evian Summit Declaration on Ebola response, discussed international collaboration and financial contributions for outbreak response. No Ebola case counts or laboratory confirmation details are provided in the report; the emphasis is on diplomatic and financial support to sustain the global response. Acknowledges ongoing risk and the need for continued international solidarity. Keywords: Ebola, Democratic Republic of the Congo, G20, international cooperation, funding, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 外交部「エボラ対応に1,800万ドル規模の支援」
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ対応への韓国政府の資金拠出を報じる外交ニュースであり、新規症例数や新たなアウトブレイク詳細は含まれていないが、DRCでのエボラ継続リスクを示唆しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はG20外相会合における資金拠出発表という外交ニュースであり、具体的な症例数・感染拡大状況の記載はない。DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクの一次情報ではなく二次的な支援報道のため、フルRRAより続報の注視が適切。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Child with high fever and sore throat, refusing to eat: beware of herpangina.
article.articleSummary: Herpangina is an acute enterovirus infection primarily affecting children under six, per Fujian Center for Disease Control and Prevention. Transmission occurs via fecal-oral, respiratory droplets, and direct contact, with outbreaks common in nurseries and kindergartens. Sudden fever (39–41°C) peaks within 24–48 hours, followed by sore throat and pharyngeal redness with scattered gray-white vesicles (1–2 mm) around a red halo; these vesicles rupture to yellow ulcers within 2–3 days. Young children may refuse meals, drool, and be irritable; swallowing is painful. There is no specific antiviral treatment; management is supportive: antipyretics, cooling, fluids, and soft, cool foods, plus mouth care. The illness is usually self-limiting within about a week; rare cases progress to persistent fever, rapid breathing, somnolence, or tremors requiring medical care. Prevention emphasizes handwashing, reduced gatherings, disinfection, and morning screening in childcare settings.

article.articleHeadline: Kongo od Spojených států dostane 267 milionů dolarů na boj proti ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo will receive $267 million from the United States to fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: At the UN General Assembly in New York on Sept 24, 2026, the United States announced an additional $267 million to fight the Ebola outbreak in Congo, bringing total U.S. health and humanitarian aid to $887 million and reinforcing Washington as the largest contributor. The Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, officially declared in mid-May, has caused 3,639 deaths among 7,541 reported infections. The UN has sought further funding, with Secretary‑General Antonio Guterres calling for about $1.1 billion to supplement the aid plan. Congolese Prime Minister Judith Suminwaová Tulukaová said the response priorities include mobilizing recognized scientific and operational expertise and leveraging nationwide mobilization, with early indications of tangible results. MSF warns that the outbreak is moving and ongoing transmission persists, underscoring the need for sustained international support and coordinated public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ対策のため米国から2億6700万ドルを受け取る
triage.triage_reason: DRCの第17次エボラ流行は7,541症例・3,639死亡と極めて深刻かつ継続中の人-人感染事例であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たし国際的な資金支援・関心も高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国・ワシントン・ニューヨークは資金拠出やUN総会開催地として言及されているのみで、感染発生国はDRCのみ。MSFは流行が拡大・移動していると警告しており、継続的な国際支援が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes antispasi penularan Super Flu di Sulsel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Office anticipates the transmission of Super Flu in South Sulawesi.
article.articleSummary: South Sulawesi’s Health Office is actively monitoring suspected entry of Influenza A H3N2 subclade K, known as 'Super Flu', into Makassar; no suspek cases have been reported yet, but authorities have prepared preventive measures and standby health teams to act on field updates. The virus was first identified by the U.S. CDC in August 2025 and has since spread to Indonesia, with 62 cases in eight provinces by December 2025, led by East Java, South Kalimantan, and West Java. By January 2026, East Java and South Kalimantan each had 18 cases; West Java 12; Jakarta 11; South Sumatra 5; North Sumatra 3; Bali and East Nusa Tenggara 2 each. Week 36 data show 86 positives from 185 specimens: 8 H3N2 and 2 B/Victoria, alongside 76 H1N1pdm09. H3N2 subclade K has been detected in 13 provinces overall. Symptoms are abrupt fever, extreme fatigue, myalgia, headache, and respiratory symptoms, most affecting children; infections arise 1–4 days after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 南スラウェシ州保健局、『スーパーフル』の伝播を警戒
triage.triage_reason: 新型H3N2サブクレードK（通称『スーパーフル』）がインドネシア13州に拡大しており、異常性と国際的拡大リスクの両方でIHR基準を満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国CDCが2025年8月に初めて確認したH3N2サブクレードKが、2025年12月時点でインドネシア8州62例、2026年1月時点で13州に拡大。南スラウェシ州（マカッサル）では現時点で疑い例なしだが、当局は監視体制を強化している。重症度や死亡例に関する情報は記事内になく不明。

article.articleHeadline: ഇടവിട്ടുള്ള മഴ രോഗ വ്യാപനത്തിന് സാധ്യത; ജാഗ്രത പാലിക്കണമെന്ന് മന്ത്രി മുരളീധരൻ | Intermittent rains may spread disease; Minister Muraleedharan urges caution
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Intermittent rains may lead to disease transmission; Minister Muraleedharan urges caution.
article.articleSummary: Intermittent rains in Thiruvananthapuram heighten the risk of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika as Aedes mosquitoes breed in standing water. As of 24 September 2026, the Kerala health department warns of widespread transmission unless sources are eliminated, with Minister K. Muraleedharan urging public compliance with preventive guidelines. Dengue presents with high fever, severe headache, body pains, vomiting, and abdominal pain; those with symptoms should seek hospital care promptly. Self-medication should be avoided. To curb breeding, drives are planned on Fridays in educational institutions, Saturdays at workplaces, and Sundays at homes. Inspect water-holding sites such as behind refrigerators, plant pots, decorative pots, unused containers, tires, drums, buckets, toilets, and washbasins; keep them emptied or covered to prevent stagnation on terraces, sunshades, or rooftops. Protective measures include light clothing, repellents, and mosquito nets.

triage.headline_ja: 断続的な降雨で感染症拡大の恐れ、ムラリーダラン大臣が注意を呼びかけ

article.articleHeadline: Ученые предупредили о появлении более опасного варианта оспы обезьян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists warned of the emergence of a more dangerous monkeypox variant.
article.articleSummary: On 24 September 2026, Sergei Shchelkunov of Vector Center warned that zoonotic orthopoxviruses, including monkeypox, can evolve into highly virulent forms for unvaccinated people as they spill over from animals to humans. He noted active cross-continental spread and regular animal-to-human transmission; Africa has detected hybrid variants of two monkeypox subtypes, complicating the trajectory of future mutations. With smallpox vaccination halted about 45 years ago, people under 45 are particularly vulnerable to zoonotic orthopoxviruses. Vector has developed a fourth-generation domestic vaccine, OrthopoxVak, registered in November 2022, which has demonstrated efficacy against monkeypox. In April, a new recombinant strain was reported in Britain and India. Russia's consumer watchdog head Anna Popova pledged close monitoring of the pathogen’s mutability.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者らがより危険な変異株の出現の可能性について警告（サル痘）
triage.triage_reason: アフリカでのハイブリッド変異株検出や英国・インドでの組換え株報告など、大陸を越えた拡散と異常な変異の兆候がありIHR基準の複数項目に該当するため、フルリスク評価への移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア人科学者による専門的警告であり、具体的な症例数や公衆衛生上の深刻度に関する情報は乏しい。アフリカでの変異株検出は国名が特定されていないため対象国リストに含めていない。英国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。
